Beitzah 14b:13-15a:2: Gemara bishlama tefurin — chazu lemalbush, sheen tefurin name — chazu lechassoye, ella kilayim lemay chazu?
Vechi tema chazu lememach tuteh, vehatanya: "lo yaale alecha", aval atta yachol lehatztzio tachtecha. aval amru chachamim: asur laasot ken, shemma tikkarech lo nima al besaro.

Vechi tema demafsek midde bene bene, vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar rabbi yose ben shaul, amar rabbi mishshum kehala kaddisha devirushalayim: afillu eser matztzaot zo al gabbe zo vechilayim tachtehen — asur lishan alehem (mishshum shenneemar: "lo yaale alecha").
Ella, bevilon. vehaamar ulla: mippene ma amru vilon tame — mippene shehashshammash mitchammem kenegdo.
Ella bekashin, vechi ha deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hay namta gamda denaresh — sharya.

Amar rav pappa: ardalin — en bahen mishshum kilayim. amar rava: hane tzerare difshite — en bahem mishshum kilayim, devizrane — yesh bahen mishshum kilayim. rav ashe amar: echad ze veechad ze en bahen mishshum kilayim, lefi sheen derech chimmum bechach.
Bekhorot 58b:6-59a:1: Gemara tanu rabbanan: bee ze tzad measser? konsan laddir, veose lahem petach katan kede shello yehu shenayim yecholin latzet keechad, immotehem mibbachutz vehem mibbifnim, vegoot, veyotzot likrat imman.
Velishde lehu yarka velippeku levateh! amar rav huna: gezera mishshum lakuach umishshum yatom.

Tanu rabbanan: "kol asher yaavor tachat" — perat latterefa sheenah overet tachat hashshavet. mitzva limnotan beshevet. lo menaan beshevet, o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim, minnayin? talmud lomar: "haasiri kodesh" — mikkol makom.

Veen li ella shekkera shemo "asiri", lo kera shemo "asiri" minnayin? talmud lomar "yihye kodesh" mikkol makom. yachol hayu lo mea venatal asara, asara venatal echad, yachol yihyu meussarin? talmud lomar "asiri", veen ze asiri. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: maaser.

May tameh derabbi yose berabbi yehuda? savar leh keabba elazar ben gomel, detanya: abba elazar ben gomel omer: "venechshav lachem terumatchem" — bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma gedola, veachat terumat maaser.
Keshem shehatteruma gedola nittelet beomed uvemachshava —

Af terumat maaser nittelet beomed uvemachshava, umaaser karyeh rachamana teruma, dichtiv: "ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai teruma natatti lalviyyim lenachala", veittakkash masar behema lemaaser dagan, ma masar dagan nittal beomed uvemachshava — af masar behema nittal beomed uvemachshava.
Berakhot 55a:7-11: Veamar rav yehuda: shelosha devarim mekatztzerim yamav ushenotav shel adam: mi shennotnin lo sefer tora likrot veeno kore, kos shel beracha levarech veeno mevarech, vehammanhig atzmo berabbanut.

Sefer tora likrot veeno kore, dichtiv: "ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha". kos shel beracha levarech veeno mevarech — dichtiv: "vaavarcha mevarchecha". vehammanhig atzmo berabbanut — deamar rabbi chama bar chanina: mippene ma met yosef kodem leechav — mippene shehinhig atzmo berabbanut.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav, shelosha tzerichim rachamim: melech tov, shana tova vachalom tov. melech tov — dichtiv: "palge mayim lev melech beyad Adonai". shana tova — dichtiv: "tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana". chalom tov — dichtiv: "vetachalimeni vetachayeni".

Amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha devarim machriz alehem hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo veellu hen: raav, vesova, ufarnas tov. raav — dichtiv: "ki kara Adonai laraav vegomer". sova — dichtiv: "vekarati el haddagan vehirbeti oto". parnas tov — dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe lemor. ree karati veshem betzalel vegomer".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: en maamidin parnas al hatztzibbur ella im ken nimlachim batztzibbur, shenneemar: "reu kara Adonai beshem betzalel", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe, hagun alecha betzalel? amar lo: ribbono shel olam, im lefanecha hagun — lefanay lo kol shekken! amar lo: af al pi chen, lech emor lahem. halach veamar lahem leyisrael: hagun alechem betzalel? amru lo: im lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ulefanecha hu hagun, lefanenu lo kol shekken!

Mishnah Makhshirin 1:1-2:
Kol mashke shettechillato leratzon af al pi sheen sofo leratzon, o shessofo leratzon af al pi sheen techillato leratzon, hare ze vechi yuttan. mashkin temeim metammein leratzon veshello leratzon: 
Hammarid et hailan lehashshir mimmennu ochalin o et hattuma, enan bechi yuttan. lehashshir mimmennu mashkin, bet shammay omrim, hayyotzin veet shebbo, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, hayyotzin, bechi yuttan, veet shebbo, enan bechi yuttan, mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu mikkullo:
Mishnah Makhshirin 1:3-6:
Hammarid et hailan venafal al chavero, o socha venafla al chavertah, vetachtehen zeraim o yerakot hamechubbarin lakkarka, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enan bechi yuttan. amar rabbi yehoshua mishshum abba yose chale kuferi ish tivon, tema atzmecha im yesh mashke tame vattora, ad sheyyitkavven veyitten, shenneemar (Vayikra 11), vechi yuttan mayim al zera: 
Hannoer agudda shel yarak veyardu mitztzad haelyon lattachton, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enam bechi yuttan. amru vet hillel levet shammay, vahalo hannoer et hakkelach, choshshin anu shemma yatzu min heale leale. amru lahen bet shammay, shehakkelach echad, vaagudda kelachim harebe. amru lahem bet hillel, hare hammaale sak male ferot unetano al gav hannahar, choshshin anu shemma yardu mitztzad haelyon lattachton. aval im heela shenayim unetanan ze al gav ze, hattachton bechi yuttan. verabbi yose omer, hattachton tahor: 
Hamemachek et hakkeresha, vehassochet searo bichsuto, rabbi yose omer, hayyotzin bechi yuttan, veet shebbo enan bechi yuttan, mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu mikkullo: 
Hannofeach baadashim levadkan im yafot hen, rabbi shimon omer, enan bechi yuttan. vachachamim omrim, bechi yuttan. vehaochel shumshemin beetzbao, mashkin sheal yado, rabbi shimon omer, enan bechi yuttan. vachachamim omrim, bechi yuttan. hattomen perotav bammayim mippene haggannavim, enan bechi yuttan. maase veanshe yerushalayim shettamnu develatan bammayim mippene hassikarin, vetiharu lahen chachamim. hannoten perotav beshibbolet hannahar lahavian immo, enan bechi yuttan:
Mishnah Niddah 10:2-6:
Nidda shebbadka atzmah yom shevii shacharit umatzta tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar yamim badka umatzta temea, hare hi vechezkat tohora. badka atzmah bayyom hashshevii beshacharit umatzta temea, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar zeman badka umatzta tehora, hare zo vechezkat tuma, umetammea meet leet umippekida lifkida. veim yesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shello hifrisha vetohora min hammincha ulemala, hare zo vechezkat tuma. vachachamim omrim, afillu vashsheniyya leniddatah badka umatzta tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar zeman badka umatza temea, hare zo vechezkat tohora: 
Hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman beyom rishon umatzu tahor, uvayyom hashshevii umatzu tahor, ushear yamim shebbentayim lo vadku, rabbi eliezer omer, hare hen bechezkat tohora. rabbi yehoshua omer, en lahem ella yom rishon veyom shevii vilvad. rabbi akiva omer, en lahem ella yom shevii vilvad: 
Hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet vehametzora shemmetu, metammein bemassa ad sheyyimmok habbasar. nachri shemmet, tahor milletamme vemassa. bet shammay omrim, kol hannashim metot niddot. uvet hillel omrim, en nidda ella shemmeta nidda: 
Haishsha shemmeta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam, metammea mishshum ketem, umetammea veohel. rabbi yehuda omer, enah metammea mishshum ketem, mippene shenneekar mishshemmeta. umode rabbi yehuda beyoshevet al mashber umeta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam, shehi metammea mishshum ketem. amar rabbi yose, lefichach enah metammea veohel: 
Barishona hayu omrim, hayyoshevet al dam tohar, hayta meara mayim lappesach. chazru lomar, hare hi chemagga teme met lakkadashim, kedivre vet hillel. bet shammay omrim, af kitme met:
Mishnah Niddah 10:7-8:
Umodim shehi ochelet bammaaser, vekotza lah challa, umakkefet vekora lah shem. veim nafal merukkah umiddam tohorah al kikkar shel teruma, shehu tahor. bet shammay omrim, tzericha tevila baacharona. uvet hillel omrim, enah tzericha tevila baacharona: 
Haroa yom achad asar vetavla laerev veshimmesha, bet shammay omrim, metammein mishkav umoshav, vechayyavin bakkarban. uvet hillel omrim, peturin min hakkarban. tavla vayom shelleacharav veshimmesha et betah veachar kach raata, bet shammay omrim, metammein mishkav umoshav ufeturim min hakkarban. uvet hillel omrim, hare ze gargeran. umodim beroa vetoch achad asar yom vetavla laerev veshimmesha, shemmetammein mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bakkarban. tavla vayyom shelleacharav veshimmesha, hare zo tarbut raa, umaggaan uveilatan teluyim:
Mishnah Niddah 8:4-9:4:
Ed shehu natun tachat hakkar venimtza alav dam, agol, tahor. mashuch, tame, divre rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok: 
Haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha veraata dam, rabbi meir omer, im omedet, temea. veim yoshevet, tehora. rabbi yose omer, ben kach uven kach, tehora: 
Ish veishsha sheasu tzerachehen letoch hassefel venimtza dam al hammayim, rabbi yose metaher. verabbi shimon metamme, sheen derech haish lehotzi dam, ella shechezkat damim min haishsha: 
Hishila chalukah lenachrit o lenidda, hare zo tola vah. shalosh nashim shellavshu chaluk echad o sheyyashvu al safsal echad, venimtza alav dam, kullan temeot. yashvu al safsal shel even o al haitztabba shel merchatz, rabbi nechemya metaher, shehaya rabbi nechemya omer, kol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, eno mekabbel ketamim: 
Shalosh nashim shehayu yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat achat mehen, kullan temeot. badka achat mehen venimtzet temea, hi temea ushetehen tehorot, vetolot zo vazo. veim lo hayu reuyot lirot, roin otan keillu hen reuyot:
Mishnah Niddah 9:5-8:
Shalosh nashim shehayu yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat haemtzait, kullan temeot. tachat happenimit, shetayim happenimiyyot temeot vehachitzona tehora. tachat hachitzona, shetayim hachitzonot temeot vehappenimit tehora. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheavru derech margelot hammitta. aval im avru shelashtan derech aleha, kullan temeot. badka achat mehen venimtzet tehora, hi tehora ushetayim temeot. badku shetayim umatzu tehorot, hen tehorot vehashshelishit temea. shelashtan umatzu tehorot, kullan temeot. lema haddavar dome, legal tame shennitarev ben shene gallim tehorim, uvadku achad mehen umatzu tahor, hu tahor ushenayim temein. shenayim umatzu tehorim, hem tehorim vehashshelishi tame. shelashtan umatzu tehorim, kullan temeim, divre rabbi meir, shehaya rabbi meir omer, kol davar shehu vechezkat tuma, leolam hu vetumato, ad sheyyivvada lecha, tuma hechan hi. vachachamim omrim, bodek ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula: 
Shiva sammanin maavirin al hakketem. rok tafel, ume gerisin, ume raglayim, veneter, uvorit, kemuneya, veeshlag. hitbilo veasa al gabbav tohorot, heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar, hare ze tzeva, hattohorot tehorot, veeno tzarich lehatebil. avar o sheddeha, hare ze chetem, vehattohorot temeot, vetzarich lehatebil: 
Ezehu rok tafel, kol shello taam kelum. me gerisin, leissat gerisin shel pol, chalukat nafesh. me raglayim, shehechemitzu. vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim lechol echad veechad. heeviran shello chesidran, o sheheevir shiva sammanin keachat, lo asa velo chelum: 
Kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. veellu hen havvesatot, mefaheket, umeatteshet, vechosheshet befi cheresah, uveshippule meeha, veshofaat, uchemin tzemarmorot ochazin otah, vechen kayyotze vahen. vechol shekkava lah shalosh peamim, hare zo vaset:
Mishnah Niddah 9:9-10:1:
Hayta lemuda lihyot roa vitchillat havvesatot, kol hattohorot sheasta vetoch havvesatot, temeot. besof havvesatot, kol hattohorot sheasta vetoch havvesatot, tehorot. rabbi yose omer, af yamim veshaot, vesatot. hayta lemuda lihyot roa im hanetz hachamma, enah asura ella im hanetz hachamma. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hayyom shellah: 
Hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom chamishsha asar veshinneta lihyot roa leyom esrim, ze vaze asurin. shinneta faamayim leyom esrim, ze vaze asurin. shinneta shalosh peamim leyom esrim, huttar chamishsha asar vekava lah yom esrim, sheen ishsha kovaat lah veset, ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim. veenah mittaheret havveset, ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim: 
Nashim bivtulehem kaggefanim. yesh gefen sheyyenah adom, veyesh gefen sheyyenah shachor, veyesh gefen sheyyenah merubbe, veyesh gefen sheyyenah muat. rabbi yehuda omer, kol gefen yesh bah yayin. vesheen bah yayin, hare ze dorketi: 
Tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim, notnin lah arbaa lelot. uvet hillel omrim, ad shettichye hammakka. higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim, notnin lah layla harishon. uvet hillel omrim, ad motzae shabbat, arbaa lelot. raata veodah bevet aviha, bet shammay omrim, notnin lah beilat mitzva. uvet hillel omrim, kol hallayla kullah:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:4-7:
Barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom. paam achat nishtahu haedim millavo, venitkalkelu haleviyyim bashshir. hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella ad hammincha. veim bau edim min hammincha ulemala, nohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulemachar kodesh. mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheyyehu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom. amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha, veod zot hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheafillu rosh bet din bechol makom, shello yehu haedim holchin ella limkom havvaad: 
Seder berachot, omer avot ugevurot ukedushshat hashshem, vecholel malchuyot immahen, veeno tokea. kedushshat hayyom, vetokea. zichronot, vetokea. shofarot, vetokea. veomer avoda vehodaa uvirkat kohanim, divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri. amar lo rabbi akiva, im eno tokea lammalchuyot, lamma hu mazkir. ella omer avot ugevurot ukedushshat hashshem, vecholel malchuyot im kedushshat hayyom, vetokea. zichronot, vetokea. shofarot, vetokea. veomer avoda vehodaa uvirkat kohanim: 
En pochatin measara malchuyot, measara zichronot, measara shofarot. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, im amar shalosh shalosh mikkullan, yatza. en mazkirin zikkaron malchut veshofar shel puranut. matchil battora umashlim bannavi. rabbi yose omer, im hishlim battora, yatza: 
Haover lifne hatteva beyom tov shel rosh hashshana, hashsheni matkia. uvishat hahallel, rishon makre et hahallel:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:8-9:
Shofar shel rosh hashshana, en maavirin alav et hattechum, veen mefakkechin alav et haggal, lo olin beilan, velo rochvin al gabbe vehema, velo shatin al pene hammayim, veen chotchin oto ben bedavar shehu mishshum shevut, uven bedavar shehu mishshum lo taase. aval im ratza litten letocho mayim o yayin, yitten. en meakkevin et hattinokot millitkoa, aval mitassekin immahen ad sheyyilmedu. vehammitassek, lo yatza, vehashshomea min hammitassek, lo yatza: 
Seder tekiot, shalosh, shel shalosh shalosh. shiur tekia keshalosh teruot. shiur terua keshalosh yevavot. taka barishona, umashach bashsheniyya chishtayim, en beyado ella echat. mi shebberach veachar kach nitmanna lo shofar, tokea umeria vetokea shalosh peamim. keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyav, kach kol yachid veyachid chayyav. rabban gamliel omer, sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatan:
Mishnah Ta'anit 1:1-2:
Meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim. rabbi eliezer omer, miyyom tov harishon shel chag. rabbi yehoshua omer, miyyom tov haacharon shel chag. amar lo rabbi yehoshua. hoil veen haggeshamim ella siman kelala bechag, lamma mazkir. amar lo rabbi eliezer, af ani lo amarti lishol, ella lehazekir mashshiv haruach umorid haggeshem beonato. amar lo, im ken, leolam yehe mazkir: 
En shoalin et haggeshamim ella samuch laggeshamim. rabbi yehuda omer, haover lifne hatteva beyom tov haacharon shel chag, haacharon mazkir, harishon eno mazkir. beyom tov harishon shel pesach, harishon mazkir, haacharon eno mazkir. ad ematay shoalin et haggeshamim, rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyaavor happasach. rabbi meir omer, ad sheyyetze nisan, shenneemar (Yoel b) vayyored lachem geshem, more umalkosh barishon:
Mishnah Ta'anit 1:3-7:
Bishlosha vemarcheshvan shoalin et haggeshamim. rabban gamliel omer, beshiva vo, chamishsha asar yom achar hechag, kede sheyyaggia acharon shebbeyisrael linhar perat: 
Higgia shiva asar bemarcheshvan velo yardu geshamim, hitchilu hayechidim mitannin shalosh taaniyyot. ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha, umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta: 
Higgia rosh chodesh kislev velo yardu geshamim, bet din gozrin shalosh taaniot al hatztzibbur. ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha, umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta: 
Avru ellu velo naanu, bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur. ochlin veshotin mibbeod yom, vaasurin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta, venoalin et hammerchatzaot. avru ellu velo naanu, bet din gozrin alehem od sheva, shehen shelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur. hare ellu yeterot al harishonot, shebbaellu matriin venoalin et hachanuyot, bashsheni mattin im chashecha, uvachamishi muttarin mippene chevod hashshabbat: 
Avru ellu velo naanu, memaatin bemassa umattan, bevinyan uvintia, beerusin uvenissuin uvishelat shalom ben adam lachavero, kivne adam hannezufin lammakom. hayechidim chozrim umitannim ad sheyyetze nisan. yatza nisan velo yardu geshamim, siman kelala, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 12) halo ketzir chittim hayyom, vegomer:
Mishnah Ta'anit 2:1-4: Seder taaniyyot ketzad, motziin et hatteva lirchovah shel ir, venotnin efer mikle al gabbe hatteva, uverosh hannasi uverosh av bet din, vechol echad veechad noten berosho. hazzaken shebbahen omer lifnehen divre chibbushin, achenu, lo neemar beanshe ninve, vayyar haelohim et sakkam veet taanitam, ella (Yona 3) vayyar haelohim et maasehem, ki shavu middarkam haraa. uvakkabbala hu omer (Yoel b) vekiru levavchem veal bigdechem:

Amdu vitfilla, moridin lifne hatteva zaken veragil, veyesh lo vanim, uveto rekam, kede sheyyehe libbo shalem battefilla, veomer lifnehem esrim vearba berachot, shemone esre shebbechol yom, umosif alehen od shesh:

Veellu hen, zichronot, veshofarot, el Adonai batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni (Tehillim 120:1), essa enay el heharim vegomer (sham 121), mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai (sham 130), tefilla leani chi yaatof (sham kav). rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya tzarich lomar zichronot veshofarot, ella omer tachtehen, raav ki yihye vaaretz (Melachim 1 8, 37), dever ki yihye vegomer, asher haya devar Adonai el yirmeyahu al divre habbatztzarot (yirmeya yad). veomer chotmehen:

Al harishona hu omer, mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael. al hashsheniyya hu omer, mi sheana et avotenu al yam sof, hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai zocher hannishkachot. al hashshelishit hu omer, mi sheana et yehoshua baggilgal, hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea terua. al harviit hu omer, mi sheana et shemuel bammitzpa, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea tzeaka. al hachamishit hu omer, mi sheana et eliyyahu behar hakkarmel, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla. al hashshishshit hu omer, mi sheana et yona mimmee haddaga, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai haone beet tzara. al hashsheviit hu omer, mi sheana et david veet shelomo veno birushalayim, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai hamerachem al haaretz:
Mishnah Ta'anit 2:5-8: Maase vime rabbi chalafta verabbi chananya ven teradyon, sheavar echad lifne hatteva vegamar et habberacha chullah, velo anu acharav amen. tiku hakkohanim tekau. mi sheana et avraham avinu behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. hariu bene aharon hariu. mi sheana et avotenu al yam sof, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. ucheshebba davar etzel chachamim, amru, lo hayinu nohagin ken ella veshaar mizrach uvehar habbayit:

Shalosh taaniyyot harishonot, anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin, veanshe vet av lo hayu mitannin kelal. shalosh sheniyyot, anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin, veanshe vet av mitannin velo mashlimin. sheva acharonot, ellu vaellu mitannin umashlimin, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, shalosh taaniyyot harishonot, ellu vaellu lo hayu mitannin kelal. shalosh sheniyyot, anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin, veanshe vet av lo hayu mitannin kelal. sheva acharonot, anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin, veanshe vet av mitannin velo mashlimin:

Anshe mishmar muttarim lishtot yayin ballelot, aval lo vayyamim. veanshe vet av, lo vayyom velo vallayla. anshe mishmar veanshe maamad asurin millesapper umillechabbes, uvachamishi muttarin mippene chevod hashshabbat:

Kol hakkatuv bimgillat taanit delo lemispad, lefanav asur, leacharav muttar. rabbi yose omer, lefanav uleacharav asur. delo lehitannaa vehon, lefanav uleacharav muttar. rabbi yose omer, lefanav asur, leacharav muttar:
Mishnah Ta'anit 2:9-3:3:
En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur battechilla bachamishi, shello lehafekia hashshearim, ella shalosh taaniyyot harishonot sheni vachamishi vesheni, veshalosh sheniyyot chamishi sheni vachamishi. rabbi yose omer, keshem sheen harishonot bachamishi, kach lo sheniyyot velo acharonot:  
En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur berosh chodesh, bachanukka uvefurim, veim hitchilu, en mafsikin, divre rabban gamliel. amar rabbi meir, af al pi sheamar rabban gamliel en mafsikin, mode haya sheen mashlimin. vechen tisha veav shechal lihyot beerev shabbat:  
Seder taaniyyot elu haamur, birvia rishona. aval tzemachim sheshshanu, matriin alehem miyyad. vechen sheppasku geshamim ben geshem legeshem arbaim yom, matriin alehem miyyad, mippene shehi makkat batztzoret: 
Yardu latztzemachin aval lo yardu lailan, lailan velo latztzemachim, laze velaze aval lo labborot lashshichin velammearot, matriin alehen miyyad: 
Vechen ir shello yardu aleha geshamim, dichtiv (Amos 4) vehimtarti al ir echat veal ir achat lo amtir, chelka achat timmater vegomer, otah hair mitanna umatraat, vechol sevivoteha, mitannot velo matriot. rabbi akiva omer, matriot velo mitannot:
Mishnah Zevachim 3:6-4:3:
Shechato al menat lehanniach damo o et emurav lemachar, o lehotzian lachutz, rabbi yehuda fosel, vachachamim machshirin. shechato al menat litteno al gabbe hakkevesh shello cheneged hayesod, litten et hannittanin lematta, lemala, veet hannittanin lemala, lematta, et hannittanin bifnim, bachutz, veet hannittanin bachutz, bifnim, sheyyochluhu temeim, sheyyakrivuhu temeim, sheyyochluhu arelim, sheyyakrivuhu arelim, leshabber atzmot happesach veleechol hemennu na, learev damo vedam pesulin, kasher, sheen hammachashava foselet ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, vehappesach vehachattat shello lishman:  
Bet shammay omrim, kol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon, sheim netanan mattana achat, kipper. uvechattat, shete mattanot. uvet hillel omrim, af chattat shennetanah mattana achat, kipper. lefichach, im natan et harishona chetiknah veet hashsheniyya chutz lizmannah, kipper. natan et harishona chutz lizmannah veet hashsheniyya chutz limkomah, piggul, vechayyavin alav karet: 
Kol hannittanin al mizbeach happenimi, sheim chissar achat min hammattanot, lo chipper. lefichach, im natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello chetiknah, pasul, veen bo charet: 
Ellu devarim sheen chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul. hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, (uminchat nesachim), vehaddam, vehannesachim habbaim bifne atzman, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, af habbaim im habbehema. log shemen shel metzora, rabbi shimon omer, en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul. verabbi meir omer, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, sheddam haasham mattiro. vechol sheyyesh lo mattirim ben laadam ben lammizbeach, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul:
Mishnah Zevachim 4:4-5:2:
Haola, damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach veorah lakkohanim. olat haof, damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach. chattat haof, damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim. parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim, daman mattir et emurehen likkarev. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim, en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul: 
Kadshe nachrim, en chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame. vehashshochatan bachutz, patur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose mechayyev. devarim sheen chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, chayyavim alehem mishshum notar, mishshum tame, chutz min haddam. rabbi shimon omer, bedavar sheddarkan leheachel. aval kegon haetzim vehallevona vehakketoret, en chayyavin alehem mishshum tuma: 
Leshem shishsha devarim hazzevach nizbach, leshem zevach, leshem zoveach, leshem hashshem, leshem ishshim, leshem reach, leshem nichoach. vehachattat vehaasham, leshem chet. amar rabbi yose, af mi shello haya velibbo leshem achad mikkol ellu, kasher, shehu tenay bet din, sheen hammachashava holechet ella achar haoved: 
Ezehu mekoman shel zevachim, kadshe kadashim shechitatan batztzafon, par vesair shel yom hakkippurim shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun hazzaya al ben habbaddim veal happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav. mattana achat mehen meakkavet. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon. im lo natan, lo ikkev: 
Parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun hazzaya al happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav. mattana achat mehen meakkavet. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon. im lo natan, lo ikkev. ellu vaellu nisrafin bevet haddashen:
Mishnah Zevachim 5:3-6:
Chattovt hatztzibbur vehayyachid. ellu hen chattovt hatztzibbur, seire rashe chodashim veshel moadot, shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun arba mattanot al arba keranot. ketzad. ala vakkevesh ufana lassovev, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod deromi. veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna bechol maachol leyom valayla ad chatzot: 
Haola, kadshe kadashim, shechitatah batztzafon, vekibbul damah bichli sharet batztzafon, vedamah taun shete mattanot shehen arba, uteuna hefshet venittuach vechalil laishshim: 
Zivche shalme tzibbur vaashamot. ellu hen ashamot, asham gezelot, asham meilot, asham shifcha charufa, asham nazir, asham metzora, asham taluy, shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna bechol maachol leyom valayla ad chatzot: 
Hattoda veel nazir, kadashim kallim, shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalim bechol hair lechol adam, bechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot. hammuram mehem kayyotze vahem, ella shehammuram neechol lakkohanim, linshehem velivnehem uleavdehem:
Mishnah Zevachim 5:7-6:2:
Shelamim, kadashim kallim, shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalin bechol hair lechol adam, bechol maachol, lishne yamim velayla echad. hammuram mehem kayyotze vahen, ella shehammuram neechol lakkohanim, linshehem velivnehem uleavdehem: 
Habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach, kadashim kallim, shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun mattana achat, uvilvad sheyyitten keneged hayesod. shinna vaachilatan, habbechor neechol lakkohanim, vehammaaser lechol adam, veneechalin bechol hair, lechol adam, bechol maachol, lishne yamim velayla echad. happesach eno neechol ella vallayla, veeno neechol ella ad chatzot, veeno neechol ella limnuyav, veeno neechol ella tzali: 
Kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan berosh hammizbeach, rabbi yose omer, keillu nishchatu vatztzafon. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, mechatzi hammizbeach velatztzafon, katztzafon. mechatzi hammizbeach veladdarom, kaddarom. hammenachot hayu nikmatzot bechol makom baazara, veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna, bechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot: 
Chattat haof hayta naaset al keren deromit maaravit. bechol makom hayta cheshera, ella ze haya mekomah. ushelosha devarim hayta otah hakkeren meshammeshet millemattan, ushelosha milmalan. millemattan, chattat haof vehahaggashot usheyare haddam. milmalan, nissuch hammayim vehayyayin veolat haof keshehi rabba vammizrach:
Mishnah Zevachim 6:3-7:
Kol haolim lammizbeach, olin derech yamin, umakkifin veyordin derech semol, chutz min haole lishlosha devarim ellu, shehayu olim vechozrim leakev: 
Chattat haof ketzad hayta naaset. haya molek et roshah mimmul arpah veeno mavdil, umazze middamah al kir hammizbeach. sheyare haddam, haya mitmatztze al hayesod. en lammizbeach ella damah, vechullah lakkohanim: 
Olat haof ketzad hayta naaset. ala vakkevesh ufana lassovev, ba lo lekeren deromit mizrachit, haya molek et roshah mimmul arpah umavdil, umematztze et damah al kir hammizbeach. natal et harosh, vehikkif bet melikato lammizbeach, usefago vemelach, uzerako al gabbe haishshim, ba lo lagguf vehesir et hammura veet hannotza veet bene meayim hayyotzim immah, vehishlichan levet haddashen. shissa velo hivdil. veim hivdil, kasher. usefago vemelach, uzerako al gabbe haishshim: 
Lo hesir lo et hammura velo et hannotza velo et bene meayim hayyotzin immah velo sefago vemelach, kol sheshshinna vah meachar shemmitztza et damah, keshera. hivdil bachattat velo hivdil baola, pasal. mitztza dam harosh velo mitztza dam hagguf, pesula. mitztza dam hagguf velo mitztza dam harosh, keshera: 
Chattat haof shemmelakah shello lishmah, mitztza damah shello lishmah, o lishmah veshello lishmah, o shello lishmah velishmah, pesula. olat haof, keshera, uvilvad shello alta labbealim. echad chattat haof veechad olat haof shemmelakan veshemmitztza daman leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo, pasul, veen bo charet. chutz lizmanno, piggul, vechayyavin alav karet, uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato. malak bishtika umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno, o shemmalak chutz lizmanno umitztza haddam bishtika, o shemmalak umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno, ze hu shekkarav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato. malak chutz limkomo umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno, o shemalak chutz lizmanno umitztza haddam chutz limkomo, o shemmalak umitztza haddam chutz limkomo, chattat haof shemmelakah shello lishmah umitztza damah chutz lizmannah, o shemmelakah chutz lizmannah umitztza damah shello lishmah, o shemmelakah umitztza damah shello lishmah, ze hu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato. leechol kazzayit bachutz vechazzayit lemachar, kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz, pasul, veen bo charet. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, im machashevet hazzeman kadma lemachashevet hammakom, piggul, vechayyavin alav karet. veim machashevet hammakom kadma lemachashevet hazzeman, pasul, veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze fasul, veen bo charet. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:
Mishnah Zevachim 7:1-4:
Chattat haof sheasaah lematta, kemaase chattat leshem chattat, keshera. kemaase chattat leshem ola, kemaase ola leshem chattat, kemaase ola leshem ola, pesula. asaah lemala kemaase chullam, pesula: 
Olat haof sheasaah lemala, kemaase ola leshem ola, keshera, kemaase ola leshem chattat, keshera, uvilvad shello alta labbealim. kemaase chattat leshem ola, kemaase chattat leshem chattat, pesula. asaah lematta kemaase chullan, pesula: 
Vechullan enan metammeot bevet habbelia, umoalin bahen, chutz mechattat haof sheasaah lematta, kemaase chattat leshem chattat: 
Olat haof sheasaah lematta, kemaase chattat leshem chattat, rabbi eliezer omer, moalin bah. rabbi yehoshua omer, en moalin bah. amar rabbi eliezer, ma im chattat, sheen moalin bah lishmah, kesheshshinna et shemah, moalin bah, ola, shemmoalin bah lishmah, kesheshshinna et shemah, eno din sheyyimalu vah. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta vechattat sheshshinna et shemah leshem ola shekken shinna et shemah ledavar sheyyesh bo meila, tomar beola sheshshinna et shemah leshem chattat, shekken shinna et shemah ledavar sheen bo meila. amar lo rabbi eliezer, vahare kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom ushechatan leshem kadashim kallim yochichu, shekken shinna et sheman ledavar sheen bo meila, umoalin bahen, af atta al titma al haola, sheaf al pi sheshshinna et shemah ledavar sheen bo meila, sheyyimalu vah. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta vekadshe kadashim, sheshchatan baddarom ushechatan leshem kadashim kallim, shekken shinna et sheman bedavar sheyyesh bo issur vehetter, tomar beola sheshshinna et shemah bedavar shekkullo hetter:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 2:12-13: Shachach velo hizkir beshabbat o beyom tov kedushshat hayyom. im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil bivracha reviit beshabbat omer baruch Adonai asher natan menucha leammo yisrael leot velivrit kodesh baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. beyom tov omer baruch asher natan yamim tovim leammo yisrael lesashon ulesimcha baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. umatchil bevirkat reviit vegomer. veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit posek vechozer larosh shehu birkat hazzan:

Berashe chodashim shachach velo amar yaale veyavo im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil beracha reviit omer baruch asher natan rashe chodashim leammo yisrael lezikkaron veeno chotem bah umatchil bivracha reviit vegomer. veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit gomer otah veeno chozer. vechen bechullo shel moed uvachanukka uvefurim, shachach velo hizkir hainyan bevirkat hammazon eno chozer:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 2:14-3:1: Mi sheachal veshachach velo berech. im nizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammaachol shebbemeav chozer umevarech. nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav eno chozer umevarech. vechen im neelam mimmennu velo yada im berech o lo berech chozer umevarech vehu shello nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav:

Chamishsha minin hen. hachittin vehasseorin vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshippon. hakkussemin mimmin hachittin veshibbolet shual veshippon mimmin hasseorim. vachamishsha minin haellu keshehen shibbolim nikraim tevua bechol makom. veachar sheddashin vezorin otan nikrain dagan. ucheshettochanin otan velashin et kimchan veofin otan nikrain pat. vehappat hannaase meechad mehen hi hannikret pat bechol makom belo liuuy:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3:2-3: Haochel pat chayyav levarech lefaneha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammotzi lechem min haaretz. uleachareha arba berachot. achal dagan shaluk kemo shehu mevarech lefanav bore peri haadama. uleacharav bore nefashot rabbot. achal kemach mevarech lefanav shehakkol uleacharav bore nefashot rabbot:

Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin sheshshelakuhu veervu bemayim o bishar mashkim im haya ave kede sheyyihye rauy laachila ulelooso mevarech alav battechilla bore mine mezonot ulevassof al hammichya veal hakkalkala. veim haya rach kede sheyyihye rauy lishtiyya mevarech alav battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3:4-5: Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin shebbishshelo bikdera ben levaddo ben sheervo im devarim acherim kegon levivot vechayyotze bahen. vechen haddagan shechilleko o ketasho uvishshelo bikdera kegon harifot vegeres hakkarmel vechayyotze bahen vechol ze hu hannikra maase kedera. vechen kol tavshil sheerev bo mechameshet hamminin ben kemach ben pat. battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammin hazze chashuv etzlo velo haya tefela. aval im haya echad mechameshet hamminin sheerev tefela eno mevarech ella al haikkar ufoter et hattefela. veze kelal bivrachot kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela ben shehayta hattefela meorevet im haikkar ben shello hayta meorevet:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3:6-7: Ketzad hi hattefela hameorevet. kegon lefet o keruv shebbishshelo veerev bo kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin kede ledabbeko eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot shehallefet hu haikkar vekimcho tefela. shekkol davar shemmearvin oto ledabbek o kede litten reach o kede litzboa et hattavshil hare zo tefela. aval im erev kede litten taam battaarovot hare hu ikkar. lefichach mine devash shemmevashshelin otan venotnin bahen chelev chitta kede ledabbek veosin mehen mine metika eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot mippene shehaddevash hu haikkar:

Ketzad hi hattefela sheenah meorevet. hare shetztzarich leechol dag maliach veachal happat immo kede shello yazzik hammelach gerono uleshono hare ze mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat mippene shehappat tefela lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:8-9:
Happotel chavalim min hahutzin umin hachelef o michute tzemer o michute pishtan o chute sear vechayyotze bahen hare ze toledet kosher vechayyav. veshiuro kede sheyyaamod hachevel biftilato belo keshira shennimtzet melachto mitkayyemet. vechen hammafrid et happetil hare ze toledet mattir vechayyav. vehu shello yitkavven lekalkel bilvad. veshiuro keshiur happotel:

Shevuot 30a:11-30b:11: Tanu rabbanan: "veamdu shene haanashim" – mitzva levaale dinin sheyyaamdu. amar rabbi yehuda: shamati sheim ratzu lehoshiv et shenehem – moshivin; ezehu asur? shello yehe echad omed veechad yoshev, echad medabber kol tzarko veechad omer lo "katztzer devarecha".

Tanu rabbanan: "betzedek tishpot amitecha" – shello yehe echad yoshev veechad omed, echad medabber kol tzarko veechad omer lo: "katztzer devarecha". davar acher: "betzedek tishpot amitecha" – heve dan et chavercha lechaf zechut.
Tane rav yosef: "betzedek tishpot amitecha" – im sheittecha betora uvemitzvot, hishtaddel leduno yafe.
Rav ulla bereh derav illay hava leh dina kammeh derav nachman. shelach leh rav yosef: ulla chaverenu amit betora uvemitzvot. amar: lemay shelach li? lechannofe leh?! hadar amar: lemishre betigreh,

Amar ulla: machloket bevaale dinin; aval beedim – divre hakkol baamida, dichtiv: "veamdu shene haanashim". amar rav huna: machloket bishat massa umattan; aval bishat gemar din – divre hakkol dayyaynin bishiva uvaale dinin baamida, dichtiv: "vayyashev moshe lishpot et haam vayyaamod haam".
Lishshana acharina: machloket bishat massa umattan, aval bishat gemar din – divre hakkol dayyaynin bishiva uvaale dinin baamida; deha edim kigmar din damu, uchetiv behu: "veamdu shene haanashim".

Devethu derav huna hava la dina kammeh derav nachman, amar: hechi naaved? i ekum mikkamma – mistatteman taanateh devaal dina. la ekum mikkamma – eshet chaver hare hi kechaver. amar leh leshammaeh: tze veafrach alay bar avavza ushedi illavavy, veekum.

Vehaamar mar: machloket bishat massa umattan, aval bishat gemar din – divre hakkol dayyaynim bishiva uvaale dinin baamida! deyatev keman deshare mesaneh, veamar: "ish peloni atta zakkay", "ish peloni atta chayyayv".
Amar rabba bar rav huna: hay tzureba merabbanan veam haaretz deit lehu dina bahade hadade – motvinan leh letzureba merabbanan, uleam haaretz name amrinan leh "tiv"; vei kae – let lan ba.

Rav bar sherevya hava leh dina kammeh derav pappa, otveh veotev name levaal dineh. ata shelicha deve dina, betash beh veokmeh leam haaretz, vela amar leh rav pappa "tiv". hechi aved hachi? veha mistatteman taanateh! amar rav pappa: memar amar, ihu ha otvan, shelicha hu dela mippayyays minnay.

Veamar rabba bar rav huna: hay tzureba merabbanan veam haaretz deit lehu dina bahade hadade, la likdom tzureba merabbanan velittev, mishshum demichaze keman desadar leh ledineh. vela amaran ella dela kevia leh iddaneh, aval kevia leh iddaneh – let lan ba; memar amar: beiddaneh terid.

Veamar rabba bar rav huna: hay tzureba merabbanan deyada besahaduta, vezila beh milleta lemezal leve dayyayna dezutar minneh leashode kammeh – la lezil. amar rav shisha bereh derav idi, af anan name tenena: matza sak o kuppa veen darko littol – hare ze lo yittol.
Hane mille bemamona, aval beissura – "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai"; kol makom sheyyesh bo chillul Adonai – en cholkin kavod lerav.

Rav yemar hava yada leh sahaduta lemar zutera. ata lekammeh deammemar, otvinhu lechullehu. amar leh rav ashe leammemar, vehaamar ulla: machloket bevaale dinin, aval beedim – divre hakkol baamida! amar leh: hay ase vehay ase, vaase dichvod tora adif.
Sotah 39a:2-39b:6: Amar rava bar rav huna: kevan shenniftach sefer tora asur lesapper afillu bidvar halacha, shenneemar: "uvefitcho amdu kol haam", veen amida ella shetika, shenneemar: "vehochalti ki lo yedabberu ki amdu lo anu od". rabbi zera amar rav chisda, mehacha: "veozne chol haam el sefer hattora".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen shello natal yadav — lo yissa et kappav, shenneemar: "seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai".
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar ben shammua: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lahen: miyyamay lo asiti bet hakkeneset kappendarya, velo pasati al rashe am kodesh, velo nasati kappay belo beracha.
May mevarech? amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: "asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu levarech et ammo yisrael beahava".

Ki akar kareh may amar? yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettehe beracha zo shetztzivvitanu levarech et ammecha yisrael, lo yehe bah michshol veavon. vechi mahdar appeh mitztzibbura may amar? adbereh rav chisda lerav ukeva uderash: "ribbono shel olam asinu ma sheggazarta alenu ase immanu
Ma shehivtachtanu. hashekifa mimmeon kodshecha min hashshamayim vegomer".

Amar rav chisda: en hakkohanim rashshaim lachof kishre etzbeotehen ad sheyyachziru penehem min hatztzibbur. amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: en hakkore rashshay likrot "kohanim" ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi hatztzibbur,

Veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatechil bivracha ad sheyyichle dibbur mippi hakkore, veen hatztzibbur rashshain laanot "amen" ad shettichle beracha mippi hakkohanim, veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatechil bivracha acheret ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi hatztzibbur.

Veamar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: en hakkohanim rashshain lehachezir penehem min hatztzibbur ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur besim shalom", veenan rashshain laakor raglehem velelech ad sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur "sim shalom".

Veamar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: en hatztzibbur rashshain laanot "amen" ad shettichle beracha mippi hakkore, veen hakkore rashshay likrot battora ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi hatztzibbur, veen hametargem rashshay lehatechil battargum ad sheyyichle pasuk mippi hakkore, veen hakkore rashshay lehatechil befasuk acher ad sheyyichle targum mippi hametargem.

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammaftir benavi, tzarich sheyyikra battora techilla, veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en hammaftir rashshay lehafetir bannavi ad sheyyiggalel sefer tora.
Zohar, Metzora 14: Ad dahavo azle, patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Bereshit 32:2-3) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. veyaakov halach ledarko, dehava azil lokovel avuhi. ta chaze, kol zimna, deyaakov ishtechach legabbeh delavan la mallil immeh kudesha berich hu, (velo ishtechach legabbeh) vei tema, veha ketiv, (Bereshit 31:3) vayyomer Adonai el yaakov shuv el eretz avotecha ulemoladtecha vegomer. hay besofa hava, bezimna devaa leitparsha millavan vechad itperash minneh, atu lokovleh innun malache veozfuhu beorcha.

Ta chaze, ketiv, vayyifgeu vo. vayyifga bemalache elohim mibbae leh, may vo. ella inhu atu leitkallela beh (veozfuhu beorcha). may leitkallela beh. ella innun missitra digvura kaatyayn, dichtiv malache elohim, vechama missitra ochora malache derachame, veitkallu beh rachame vedina.

Ta chaze, bekadmita, machane elohim, ze chad. levatar vayyikra shem hammakom hahu machanayim, tere. chad missitra dedina vechad missitra derachame, malachin mehay gisa, umalachin mehay gisa, veal da ketiv, vayyifgeu vo. vo, dayyka. vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam, raa otam mibbae leh, may raam. ella chama lon kelilan kachada, mitdabbekan da beda, mitchabberan da beda, veal da ketiv raam, vechullehu atu leozfa leh uleshezava leh mida deesav.
Zohar, Noach 40: Hu haya gibbor tzayyid lifni Adonai al ken yeamar kenimrod gibbor tzayid lifne Adonai. ta chaze, hu hava gevar takkif. levushoy deadam harishon hava lavish vehava yada lemetzad tzeda divriyyayta behu.

Amar rabbi elazar nimrod hava mefatte livriyyayta lemehach batar pulechan deavoda zara vehava shallit beinun levushin venatzach bene alma vehava amar deihu shallita bealma ufalchin leh beni nasha. veammay ikre shemeh nimrod demarad bemalka illaa dilela demarad beillae umarad betattae.

Beinun levushin shallit al kol (davar acher shear) beni alma umalach behu umarad bemareh veamar deihu shallita dealma vehava mefatte livriyyayta avatreh ad demashach bene nasha lemefak mibbatar pulechana demare alma. amar rabbi shimon beilen levushin yade behu chavrayay raza illaa:
Zohar, Pinchas 84: Ta chaze, al hay ilana dechol cheloy beh sharya, amar david, (Tehillim 16:5) atta tomich gorali. mahu gorali. da adva deachid beh david malka. veal da, al pi haggoral (sefer acher ken beh al pi) ketiv. vechen hu al pi Adonai. vayyamat sham al pi Adonai. haggoral ketiv. zakkaa chulakehon deinnun demishtaddelin beorayyta yemama velele, veyade archoy. veinnun achle bechol yoma mezona illaa. kema deat amer, (Kohelet 7:12) hachachma techayye vealeha. deha orayyta dilella meatar da itzan, veha ittemar alayyhu, (Yeshayahu 65:13) hinne avaday yochelu.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (yechezkel 1:25) vayhi kol meal larakia. da kol deachid lehay rakia, veishtetaf bahadeh. veda hu (Tehillim 111:4) zecher asa lenifleotav. vehahu rekia kaim alayyhu, al innun chevavn. veda hu deivre bashsheni, (Bereshit 1:6) lehavedil ben mayim lamayim.

Veha okmuha, deshiva rekiin leella leella. vadday vilon eno meshammesh, deha let leh middileh, ella ma deyahavin leh. umiskene beh itachadu, da hu raza dichtiv, (divre hayamim b 22) uveanyi hachinoti levet elohay. veda machnis shacharit umotzi arvit. deha belelya, appik chayyaloy lechol sitrin, veshalta al innun chayyaylin veuchlosin. uveshacharit kanish lechullehu, veail lenukvayyhu, vela shaltin. deha boker kalil kullehu. kema deat amer (Tehillim 92:3) lehaggid babboker chasdecha veemunatcha ballelot. veha okmuha.

Vekol it al hay rakia, minneh itzan hay rakia, beshaata dehay kol itar, kullehu uchlusin la natlin, velet behu reshu, ella lemekam beduchetayyhu, veakreve chelehon umechakkan, lehahu tivu denagid lehahu rakia, veyitbarchan begineh, veal da ihu meal larakia asher al rosham.

Ta chaze umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse, kemare even sappir, da even yisrael. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:3) vegallu et haeven vegomer. chad even nachta milleella, kad bau yisrael lemerat ara, uchetiv beh goral. veihu amar, da liflanya, veda liflanya. veda even hu mittechot kurseyay demalka nachta. vadday (Bereshit 49:24) mishsham roe even yisrael ketiv. uvegine kach al pi haggoral vadday techalek nachalato.

Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle meusha lelud, paga behu ribbi elazar, rahatu abbatreh. amru, vadday narhit abbatreh dishchinta. ad dematu legabbeh, amru vadday nishtattef bahadach, venishma milla chadta.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 51:1) shimu elay rodfe tzedek mevakshe vegomer. shimu elay rodfe tzedek, innun deazlin batar mehemnuta, rodfe tzedek, vadday innun mevakshe Adonai. i baitu leminda mehemnuta, uleachada lehay tzedek, la tistakkelun bah bilchodaha kishar bene alma, degarmu mita legarmayyhu al da. aval (Yeshayahu 51:1) habbitu el tzor chutztzavtem veel makevet bor nukkartem. <small></small>

(Bamidbar 28:2) tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et karbani lachmi vegomer. ketiv (Shmuel 1 15:22) hachefetz laAdonai beolot uzevachim kishmoa bekol Adonai vegomer. let reuta dekudesha berich hu, deyechuv bar nash, veal choveh yakriv karban. ella karban deihu beli chova, da ihu karban shelim, veikre shelamim, vekarban tamid uf hachi, veaf al gav dimchapper al chovin.

Ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara vegomer. hay kera okmuha, diruta dekudesha berich hu, la itree bekarban debar nash al chovoy, ella ruach nishbara. uvene nasha la yade may kaamre, vehachi shemana mibbutzina kadisha, dechad ate bar nash leistaava bechovoy, amshich aleh ruach, missitra demisava, veitgae al bar nash, veshalit aleh lechol reuta. vehahu sitra misava, itgabbar becheleh veittakaf, veshalit aleh liruteh. ate bar nash veshalit aleh leitdakkea, medakkein leh.

Bezimna dehava be makdesha kayyaym, akriv karbaneh, kol kappara dileh talyay aleh, ad deitcharat, vetavar lehahu ruach miggo gauta dileh, umaich leh. veda hu teviru, dehahu darga demisava. vechad itbar hahu ruach misava, vekariv karbaneh, da ihu deitkabbel beraava kaddeka yaut.

Vei la itbar hahu ruach, lav karbaneh kelum, ulechalbe itmesar, deha karbena da lav dekudesha berich hu, ella michalbe. uvegin kach zivche elohim kaddeka yaut, hu ruach nishbara, deyitbar hahu rucha misava, vela yishlot. veal da man deyitbar leh kaddeka yaut, aleh ketiv, (Tehillim 78:39) ruach holech velo yashuv. lihevi hahu gavra beavtachuta, dela yetuv legabbeh lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, velo yashuv. lev nishbar venidke, hahu gavra dela itgae, vela itanneg beinnugin dealma, elohim lo tivze, bikara ihu legabbeh.
(Bamidbar 28) tzav et bene yisrael. may tzav. da avoda zara. begin dela yeul garmeh leistaava beruach misava, deihu avoda zara mammash.

Ribbi elazar patach. (Shir hashshirim Adonai:1) bati leganni achoti challa vegomer. hay kera okmuha, aval it setarim bekarbana (sefer acher shit sidrin dekarbena) hacha, vecholla ittemar. amar leh rabbi shimon, yaut hu, desharit milla, vesatamt, ema. (sefer acher nasetamet amay) amar, begin dachamena besifra dechanoch milla, veolifna. amar, ema hahi milla dechamit veshamat.

Amar kolla chad milla, kudesha berich hu amar da, bati leganni, begin dechol karbenin dealma kad sallekin, kullehu ayylin lego ginta deeden bekadmita, raza dekneset yisrael. veheach bekadmita veshiruta dekarvena, beshaata debar nash ode chetoy alah, unechisu uzeriku dedameh al madbecha.

Hasheta it leistakkela, heach innun ruchin kadishin ithanun mehay. umay tama dekarbena divhema, veha yatir hava sagya, letavra bar nash hahu rucha, uleatava betiyyuveta may tama nechisu divhema, uleokda leh benura demadbecha.

Ella raza hu, begin deit behema dirvia al elef turin, veelef turin achlat bechol yoma, vechullehu ikrun (Tehillim 50:10) behemot beharere alef. veal da tanenan, deit beira achil beire. umimma havo. meeshsha. vechullehu lachich lon hahi behema bilchicha chada, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna. vechol mayya deyarden, deamla beshit shenin, hi avdat leh gemia chada, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 40:23) yivtach ki yagiach yarden el pihu.

Sitra demilla, chamira dechol hane, ikkara visoda lehane beire diltatta. begin derucha minnayyhu mitfashsheta (sefer acher deruche divire minnayyhu atepashetav) letatta, veittzayayr hahu rucha letatta bivire. vechad chav bar nash, ayyte beira lekarbena, vehahu rucha divira da, salleka vetav leatreh, umitpashshat hahu rucha bechullehu. vechol innun dezina da, mitkarvin veatyayn veithanyayn mehahu chelba vedama, dehahu levusha derucha da, deha missitra dilhon hava (begin) hahu rucha (dilhon). vechulhon ithanu veittezanu, veitabbedun sannegorin al hahu bar nash. veal derech veshet, kema deittemar. uvegin kach karbena min habbehema.

Amar rabbi shimon, berich beri lekudesha berich hu, alach ittemar (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha. yismach avicha, dilella. veimmecha, da keneset yisrael. vetagel yoladtecha, da berateh deribbi pinchas ben yair chasida. elazar beri ema, ha kurebana divhema, karbena deofe may. dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:14) veim min haof ola karbano. amar leh, la chamena, aval istakkalna mehay milla divhema, milla deofe. vela ema, begin dela chamena, vead kean la shemana.

Amar leh elazar, yaut amart. aval raza dekarbenin sitrin saggiin tamman, vela itmesaru legallaa, bar lezakkae keshot, deraza demarehon la itkasse minnayyhu. sitra dekarbenin, da ihu sitra, leinnun manin (sefer acher chevan) kaddishin. 4 diukenin chakukin bechisse, veda ihu kuresyay upparnasa demalka kaddisha. pene shor. pene nesher. pene arye. pene adam. pene adam dechalil lechullehu. vechol anpin mistakkelin illen leillen, veitkelilan illen beillen, uminnayyhu mitpashshetan lechamma sitrin verivvavn, ella vetatta, delet lon shiura uminyayna vecheshbon.

Pene shor, itpeshat livire rucha minneh, learbea zayynin, veitkelilan bechad, veillen innun: parim, uchevasim, veattudim, veizzim. veillen kayymin lekarbena. uvegin deminnehon havo, innun chayyaylin kaddishin demitpashshete mehahu pene shor, mitkarvin lisoda dilhon, veithanun mehahu yesoda ulevusha dilhon. vei la dahavu lehu yesoda dehay alma, la mitkarvin tamman.

Kegavvna dahavi nayycha lishchinta kaddisha, meruchehon detzaddikayyay, veitkerivat lekabbela rucha dehahu zakkaa, veithanaat minneh, begin deminnah hava hahu ruach. kach illen ithanun missitra diysoda dilhon, veithanun mehahu levusha demitkarve leh, (sefer acher deha) ruach malbusha (sefer acher kach illen matehanevan mehahu levusha dametakerabev missitra diysoda dilhon, deha chalava vedama levusha) derucha dilhon hava. uvegin kach ithanun minnayyhu.

Pene nesher itpeshat leofa ruach minneh. venesher bitren sitrin ihu. veraza da (Bereshit 1:20) veof yeofef, teren ruchin. uvegin kach itpeshat venachta (sefer acher venashar bitren sitrin ihu. yemina usemala veraza da (Bereshit 1:20) vaof yeofef, uvegin kach teren ruchi matepashetav minneh unechatu) mimina umissemala karbena deofe.

Mikkol setar dachya, la itkeriv ella yona vetorim, deinnun bikshot leziuugayyhu, mikkol shear ofin. vehem nirdafin, velo rodfin. umehemana da leda, nukeva levar zugo. veal da karbena minnayyhu. venachte umitkarve innun ruchin kaddishin, veithanyayn miyyesoda veikkara dilhon.

Vei tema, hech itpeshat zeer mehay yona, o mishshafnina da, lechamma sitrin chayyaylin delet lon shiura. o min beira chada uf hachi. ta chaze. chad sheraga dakik dalik, itmalleyay minneh kol alma. tu aa dakik, adlik leravreva.

Ad hacha karbena mitteren sitrin dechakikin bechisse. hasheta it lemishal, 4 diukenin innun, dechakukin bechisse, may tama let karbenin meacharanin. ella vday mikkullehu it karbena. arye chakuk bechuresyay, beshaata dekarbena shelim, arye nachit veal beeshsha, veachil veitnahe mittamman. adam chakuk bechuresyay, adam ikkara decholla, umakriv tamman rucheh venishmateh, veadam illaa ithane meadam tattaa, vechol zina itkeriv lezineh, veithane minneh midileh mammash, umisoda dileh.

Vei tema, ha arye delet leh yesoda letatta behahu karbena. arye kalil bechullehu, deha limina havi, uvegin kach achil bechullehu, vechol shear la achlin (sefer acher minneh) mizzineh, begin dimina hu. ha kol 4 diukenin dechakukin bakkisse, mitkarvin lekarbena, uvegin kach havi karbena shelim. vechad ithanun meikkara visoda dilhon, keden nachat ruach leadleka butzinin ilain.

Kahane velevae veyisraele, yahave (sefer acher inun) yesoda veikkara leinnun dargin illain dilhon. vechol darga yahiv lisodeh 4 diukenin dechuresyay bekadmita. kidamaran zina lokovel zineh, umitkarve innun bekadmita zina lezineh. pene shor kullehu panim demitpashtan leinnun zinin kidkaamran, kullehu mitkarve leikara visoda dilhon. pene nesher, kidamaran. pene arye, kidamaran. pene adam, demakriv rucheh venishmateh mitkeriv legabbe adam illaa.

Kahana dimyached shema kaddisha, mitkarev legabbe kahana illaa. hahu deal levet kodesh hakkodashim. veitkeriv da, veadlik betikkuneh binhiru deanpin (sefer acher deatvavn), lekadmut kahana diltatta. levae di menaggene bechedva, hahu sitra dilhon chadde, veanhir anpin. yisrael dekariv, (sefer acher dekayymu) al karbena bitzlota, deha tzelota al kolla hava. ittear legabbayyhu yisrael sava (sefer acher ilaa), setama (sefer acher chotama) kaddisha, veanhir anpin.

Kol zina lezineh, vechol milla batar yesoda dileh azla veattearu dargin tattain ledargin illain, veaf al gav dechullehu mitarin, veattearu dargin dechakikin bakkisse, legabbe dargin deara, yesoda dilhon. veinnun dargin illain demittammeran, kullehu mitare umitkarve lisudata, umitaddene. aval let reshu lechad minnayyhu lemechal, la ledarge illae, vela ledarge tattae, ulemithane shum hanaa, vela leoshit yeda bekarbana, ad demalka illaa achil veithane, veyahiv lon reshu.

Levatar deyahav lon reshu, kol chad vechad ithane veachil (kedka yeot). vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim Adonai:1) ariti mori im besami, illen innun dargin illain. mori im besami, achle veithane kaddeka yaut. (sefer acher da deroa yemina, beyarcha semala). achalti yari im divshi, da yaakov berachel, da achila kaddeka yaut. shatiti yeni im chalavi, da deroa semala, beyarcha yemina. ha kullehu dargin (sefer acher karbenin) illain, deithane behu malka kaddisha bekadmita. veda mechla dileh vahanaa dileh. ad hacha mechla demalka illaa bekadmita.

Mikkan ulehala, yahiv reshu led diukenin dechakikin bechuresyay, ulechol innun demitpashshetan minnayyhu, leithane ulemechal. hada hu dichtiv, ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim. ichlu reim, illen innun arba diukenin deamaran. shetu veshichru dodim, kol innun demitpashshete minnayyhu, vechullehu achle umitpashshete, veithanun kaddeka yaut, veanhiru anpin, vealmin kullehu bechedva, vechol chad vechad, ben dargin illain, uven dargin tattain, bisoda dilhon mitkarvin umithanin. da ihu raza vesitra dekarbena kaddeka chaze.

Atu ribbi elazar vribbi abba ushear chavrayyay, veishtetachu kammeh. amar ribbi abba, ilmale la itmesar orayyta betura desinay, ella deamar kudesha berich hu, ha bar yochay orayyta vesitrin dili, daye lealma. vavy kad tistallak min alma. man yanhir butzinin deorayyta, kolla yitchashach mehahu yoma. deha ad deyete malka meshicha, la liheve dara kedara da, derabbi shimon shari begavvih.

Amar rabbi shimon, al raza da, asir leh lebar nash litom kelum, ad deyechul malka illaa, uma ihu. tzelota. tzelota debar nash, kegavvna da, bekadmita, mezamnin lediyyukenin dechakikin bechuresyay, al innun biryayn, demitpashshete ruchin dilhon, al ofe uveire, lekarbena biryayn derucha dilhon yesoda behay alma minnayyhu, vehayeynu (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai, deha biryayn deitchazyayn lekarbena rucha dilhon, mitpeshshat alayyhu arba diukenin, mezammenan al karbenin illen. vehayeynu dekaamaran, vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh, vechol innun chayyaylin acharanin deka mitpashshete minnayyhu.

Ulevatar kahana rabba deka meyayched shema kaddisha, hayeynu ahavat olam ahavtanu vechulei. yichuda deka meyayched, hayeynu (Devarim 6:4-Adonai) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. ulevatar levae, deka mitare lenigguna, hayeynu (Devarim 11:16) vehaya im shamoa vegomer, hishshamru lachem pen yifte vegomer. da nigguna delevae, begin leastara sitra (sefer acher leitteara sitra) da, bekorbana da. ulevatar yisrael, da emet veyatztziv venachon, yisrael sava dekayyeyma al karbena, (karbena ilaa ha dargin) deihi 10 dargin illain penimain decholla, kayyeyma al patora.

Aval let reshu lechad minnayyhu lemechal, uleoshit yeda lekarbena, ad demalka illaa achil. vehayeynu 3 rishonot, veg acharonot. kevan deihu achil, yahiv reshu led diukenin, ulechol innun sitrin demitparshan minnayyhu, lemechal.

Keden adam, deihu diyyukena dechalil kol shear diukenin, maich venafil al anpoy, umasir garmeh verucheh legabbe adam dilella, dekayyeyma al innun diukenin, dechalil kol diukenin, leatteara leh aleh kaddeka chaze, vehayeynu (Tehillim 25:1) elecha Adonai nafshi essa, leatteara (telat) diukenin acharanin, vechol innun demitpashshete minnayyhu. (tehilla ledavid) vehayeynu (Tehillim 145:11) yabbiu. yerannenu. yomeru. yedabberu. vechullehu achlin veithanyayn kol chad vechad kaddeka chaze leh.

Mikkan ulehala lema bar nash aku dileh beh (sefer acher delibbeh), hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 20:2) yaancha Adonai beyom tzara. (aku) keubbarta deyatva beaku, leithappecha kullehon sannegorin aleh debar nash. veal da ketiv (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo vegomer.

Rabbi shimon hava azil litverya, paga beh eliyyahu, amar leh shelama aleh demor. amar leh rabbi shimon, bemay ka asik kudesha berich hu birkia. amar leh bekarbanot asik, veamar millin chadattin mishshemach, zakkaa ant, vaatena leakdema lecha shelam, umilla chada baena lemishal minach, leaskema. bimtivta dirkia sheelta shailu, alma deate let beh achila ushetiyya, veha ketiv (Shir hashshirim Adonai:1) bati leganni achoti challa vegomer, achalti yari im divshi vegomer. man delet beh achila ushetiyya, ihu amar achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeni im chalavi.

Amar rabbi shimon, vekudesha berich hu may ka ativ lon. amar leh, amar kudesha berich hu, ha bar yochay yemma. vaatena lemishal minach. amar rabbi shimon, kama chavivu chibbev kudesha berich hu lichneset yisrael, umissegiu dirchimu derachim lah, shane ovadoy mimma dehu avid. deaf al gav delav orchoy bemechla umishteyyay, begin rechimuta, achil veshata. hoil veate legabbah, avid reutah. kalla ayylat lachuppa, uvaat lemechal, let din deyechul chatanah bahadah, af al gav delav archeh lemebad hachi. hada hu dichtiv bati leganni achoti challa. hoil vaatena legabbah, ulemeal bahadah lachuppa, achalti yari im divshi vegomer.

Veyalfenan middavid, dezammin lekudesha berich hu, veshanne ovadoy mimma dearchoy dekudesha berich hu, vekudesha berich hu kabbil veavid reuteh. zammin lemalka umatronita bahadeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:8) kuma Adonai limnuchatecha atta vaaron uzzecha. malka umatronita kachada, begin dela leafresha lon, shanne manin, veshanne ovadin demalka.

Hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim lev) kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek vachasidecha yerannenu baavur david vegomer, kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek, leviyyecha mibbae leh, deha tzedek missitra delevae ihu. vachasidecha yerannenu, leviyyecha yerannenu mibbae leh, deha rinna vezimra belevae ninhu, veihu shanne veamar, kohanecha vachasidecha, deinnun missitra dimina.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, david lav orach dili hachi. amar david, baavur david avdecha al tashev pene meshichecha. tikkuna daana takkinat, la teshane leh. amar leh, david, hoil vezaminat li, it li lemebad reutach, velav reuti. veyalfenan mehay, orcha dealma, deman dimzammen leachara, hahu deate legabbeh, it leh lemebad reuteh, af al gav delav orcheh bechach.

Kach (Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavne hammakom vegomer, hoil veata chatan legabbe kalla, af al gav delav orcheh lemishkav. ella becharim uchesatot, veihi yahavah leh avanin lemishkav, kolla yekabbel biruta delibba. hada hu dichtiv, vayyishkav bammakom hahu, al innun avanin, af al gav delav orcheh bechach.

Uf name hacha, achalti yari im divshi af al gav delav archoy bechach, begin rechimu dechalla. veim kol da beveta dechalla vela baatar achara. beatreh la achil vela shate, baatar dilah achil veshate. hada hu dichtiv, bati leganni. malachin deshadar kudesha berich hu leavraham, la achlu vela shatu beatrayyhu, begin avraham achlu veshatu. amar leh, ribbi. chayyecha, milla da bae kudesha berich hu lememar, uvegin dela lemechzak tivu legarmeh, kamme keneset yisrael, salik milla legarmach, zakkaa ant bealma, demarach mishtebach bach leella. vealach ketiv, (Shmuel b 23:3) tzaddik moshel yirat elohim.

(Bamidbar 28:2) et karbani lachmi leishshay vegomer, ribbi yudai amar, bekarbana it ashan, veit reach, veit nichoach. ashan: innun mare derugeza. dichtiv, (Devarim 29:19) ki az yeshan af Adonai. innun ithanun meashan. veashan rugeza, bechotama ihu. reach: innun deikrun tappuchin. amar ribbi abba, kattappuchim. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 7:9) vereach appech kattappuchim.

(Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves echad taase vabboker. may vabboker. da boker deavraham. dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker. menalan dehay boker deavraham hu. amar ribbi elazar, mehacha, (Bereshit 44:3) habboker or. boker or la ketiv, ella habboker or, veda or kadmaa, devara kudesha berich hu beovada divreshit, veal da taase vabboker, vabboker deishtemodaa. velokovel boker deavraham, itkeriv karbena da. karban deven haarbayim, da yitzchak, velokovel erev deyitzchak itkeriv. menalan. dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot arev. veerev deyitzchak hu, veha okimna.

Raya mehemna pikkuda da lehakeriv mincha bechol yom, ulehakriv karban musaf shabbat. vaabbatreh lehasedir lechem happanim ulevona. vekarban musaf berosh chodesh. butzina kaddisha, bechol yoma tzarich leshaddure dorona lemalka bida dematronita. i ihi birshu balah, tzarich tosefet, kegon musaf beshabbat uverosh chodesh, umusaf dechol yomin tavin.

Deihi reshut hayyachid dileh veammuda deemtzaita ihu balah dehay reshut. veyaakov detikken tzelota dearvit, ihu darga dileh deammuda deemtzaita. begin da okmuha mare matnitin, tefillat arvit reshut, deaf al gav divgaluta dedome lelayla, deshaltin tamman samael venachash, vechol memanan deuchlusin dileh, ushechinta nachtat begaluta im yisrael, ihi birshu devalah ishtakkechat, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:8) ani Adonai hu shemi uchevodi leacher lo etten.

Uvegin da (Bereshit 28) vayyifga bammakom, let pegia, ella piusa. kegon (Rut 1) al tifgei vi. keneset yisrael payysat leh, dela yazuz minnah, dekudesha berich hu ihu mekomo shel olam. may olam. da shechinta. targum olam, alma, lishana deulema, kema deat amer, haalma. uma ketiv beh, (Bereshit 28) vayyalen sham, itpeyays immah, lemevat tamman begaluta im shechinta. vei tema deyaakov payis lah, shappir. uvegin deihi bechol lelya, deihu galuta, birshu balah, okmuha tefillat arvit reshut. ufirusha acharina, ihu teven lemechal liviran chomriyyim bekal vachomer. nachtu mare matnitin, veishtetachu kammeh, vechadde behay milla, vekashru lah bechamma kishrin derazin setimin. veatteru lah, useliku lah legabbe chavrayyay deishtaaru tamman.

Amar raya mehemana, butzina kaddisha, begin da bishar tzelotin ihu chova, dishtar chov alayyhu, lesamcha lah betzaddik chay almin, deveh kol hassomech geula lattefilla, eno nizok bechol oto yom. uvemay semichat al yesod. bidroa yemina. hada hu dichtiv, (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker.

Kad mate zeman tzelota demincha, baerev hi vaa. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 8:11) vattavo elav hayyona leet erev. begin demincha shelucha hi laadoni, (adonay mibbae leh) begaluta deesav, (sham 32) vehinne gam hu acharenu. veod laadoni (adoni laadoni), da ihu adon kol haaretz, veda tzaddik, mittamman yosef hatztzadik, (Devarim 33:17) bechor shoro haddar lo. deatid lenafka minneh mashiach ben efrayim. uvegineh ittemar (Bereshit 37:7) vehinne kama alummati vegam nitztzava vehinne tesubbena alummotechem vattishtachavyna laalummati. uvatztzaddik, kol hakkorea korea bevaruch.

Amar butzina kaddisha, raya mehemana, bach ittemar (Shemot 13:19) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef. begin deguf uverit chashvenan chad. uvegin da alach ittemar, vehinne kama alummati vegam nitztzava. dechach tefilla meumad. vechen kol hazzokef zokef beshem. uvatztzaddik, kol hakkorea korea bevaruch, vehayeynu vattishtachavyna laalummati. deant achid bimina uvismala, beguf uverit. ulevatar tistallak alayyhu labbina, lemiftach bah chamshin tarin decheru leyisrael. lekayyeyma, (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot, uvegin da tzelota deshacharit chova, dearvit reshut.

Bearvit ihu hashekivenu, dishchivat ben deroe malka begaluta. kad yete tzafra, pesach achid beh bimina. aval bidroa semala deyitzchak, tishre. (Bereshit 24:15) vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vehinne rivka yotzet, min galuta. uvegin dela nafke missitra dedina, yaakov (Bereshit 48:14) sikkel et yadav, veshavvi shor bimina, arye bismala. uvegin da (Tehillim 110:1) neum Adonai ladoni shev limini, da tzaddik, lokovleh mashiach ben yosef, veamar leh shev limini, deroa deavraham, begaluta deyishmael, ad ashit oyvecha hadom leraglecha.
Zohar, Vaera 11: Veal da ha deamaran vehashevota el levavecha, (teruma 162 amud bet) leachlela lon kachada, semala bimina. keden teda (Devarim 4:35) ki Adonai hu haelohim. amar ribbi abba vadday hachi hu, vehasheta yedia, hu aharon umoshe, hu moshe veaharon, rucha bemayya, umayya berucha, lemeheve chad. veal da ketiv hu.

Rabbi abba patach veamar, (dabeham 6) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha. kehay gavvna hacha itremiz yichuda kaddisha, veazhara hu levar nash, leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeot, birchimu illaa. bechol levavcha: da yemina usemala (nusach acher kaddisha) deikre yetzer tov veyetzer ra. uvechol nafshecha: da nefesh david, deityehivat benayyhu. uvechol meodecha leachlela lon leella baatar delet beh shiura. hacha hu yichuda shelim lemircham leh lekudesha berich hu kedka yeot.
Tu, uvechol meodecha: da yaakov, deihu achid lechol sitrin, vecholla hu yichuda shelim kedka yeot, begine kach, hu aharon umoshe hu moshe veaharon, kolla hu chad bela piruda.
Zohar, Vayakhel 15: Kevan dehay rucha shara al alma, kol ruchin bishin, vechol mekatregin bishin, istalaku mealma vela baenan letzallaa al netura, begin deyisrael innun netirin behahu rucha, vesukkat shalom perisat gadfaha alayyhu, veinnun netirin mikkolla.

Vei tema, ha tanenan, dela yippuk bar nash yechiday, la belelya reviaa deshabbeta, vela belelya deshabbeta, uvae bar nash leistammera. veha amaran, divlelya deshabbeta netirin bene nasha mikkol mekatregin dealma, vela bainan letzallaa al netura.

Ta chaze, hachi hu vadday, lelya reviaa deshabbeta, baenan leistammera minnayyhu, may tama. begin dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot, meerat ketiv chaser, veha ukemuha, divgin dehi chasera, kama chavile tehirin itkelilan behay meorot. levavtin umeorot innun bigriuta desihara, vechullehu shallitin behahu lelya.

Belelya deshabbeta, kevan dechullehu mitbadran leaala benukeba deafra, dela yachlin leshalletaa, bae bar nash yechiday, leistammera. vetu, af al gav dela yachlin leshalletaa, itchazyayn lezimnin, uvar nash yechiday bae leistammera.

Milla da hachi tanenan, vei hachi geriuta dintura ihu. aval beshabbeta netiru ishtechach leamma kaddisha, vekudesha berich hu kad al shabbeta, meatter lechol chad vechad miyisrael, uvae deyinterun leh lehay itra kaddisha, deitattaru beh, veaf al gav deinnun la ishtechachu beyishshuva, lezimnin levar nash yechiday itchazun, veittera mazzaleh. veitzterich leh levar nash, leitattera beitra kaddisha, ulenatra leh.

Sof sof, netiru ishtechach behahu lelya leamma kaddisha, hoil vesukkat shalom perisa al amma, deha tanenan, bechol atar desukkat shalom ishtechach, sitra achara la ishtechach tamman. veal da netura ihu unetura shechiach.

Yoma deshabbeta, chedva ihu lecholla, vecholla itnetar leella vetatta. unehora (nusach acher unekuda) tattaa nahara lesalleka leella, bishfiru deitrin shivin chulakin yattir, vesava dechol savin ittear.

Keden kad salik nehora, amma kaddisha mekaddeme leve kenishta bilvush yekar bechedva, mitatteran beitra kaddisha dilella, behahu rucha dekayyeyma alayyhu letatta, meshabbechan beshirin vetushebchan, vesallekin tushebchan leella, veillain vetattain kullehu bechedva, umitatteran kullehu kachada. patche illae veamre, zakkain attun amma kaddisha beara, demarechon itattar alayychu, vechol chelin kaddishin, mitatterin beginechon.
Hay yoma, yoma denishmatin ihu, velav yoma degufa, begin deshultanu ditzrora denishmatin ihu, vekayyman illain vetattain kullehu beziuuga chada, beitra derucha yetera illaa kaddisha.
Zohar, Vayechi 69: Dan yadin ammo keachad shivte yisrael. ribbi chiyyay amar, hay kera hachi it le lememar, dan yadin leshivte yisrael, o dan yadin leshivte yisrael keechad, mahu dan yadin ammo, ulevatar keachad shivte yisrael. ella dan, hu dichtiv beh, (Bamidbar 10:25) meassef lechol hammachanot, dehu yarcha semala, veazil levatrayyta.

Ta chaze, kevan dihuda ureuven natlin, levae vaarona parsin diglin, venatil digla deefrayim deihu lemaarav, yarcha yemina natil, bekafsire kista. vei tema zevulun deihu al, venafik, dichtiv beh, (Devarim 33:18) semach zevulun betzetecha, uchetiv veyarchato vegomer. ella vadday, yehuda itkelil mikkolla.
Ta chaze, malchu dilela itkelil mikkolla, vihuda ihu malchu tattaa. kema demalchu illaa itkelil mikkolla, hachi name malchu tattaa, itkelil mikkolla miggufa miyyarcha, begin leitgabbera betukefeh.

Ketiv, (Devarim log) mimino esh dat lamo, (74 amud alef) orayyta missitra digvura ityeyhiv (ityeyhivat), ugevura itkelil bimina, uvegufa, veyarcha, uvecholla. hachi name sidra kadmaa, yehuda ihu, malchu deate missetar gevura, veitkelil bimina begufa uveyarcha, becholla itkelil. kema demalchu dilela, itkelil mikkolla.

Siddera tinyayna reuven, deihu listar darom, vedarom ihu yemina, vechol chela dimina, yehuda natil leh, begin diruven (sefer acher itavid) itavir minneh malchu, kema deat amer pachaz kammayim al totar, venatil leh yehuda, veitgabbar betukefa dimina, dehava meruven, vechen ketiv bedavid, (Tehillim 110:1) neum Adonai ladoni shev limini. begin dissemala itkelil bimina, veittakkaf becheleh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:15) yemin Adonai osa chayil vegomer. yehuda ureuven teren deroin havu.
Siddera telitaa, efrayim, deihu yarcha yemina, venatla kamme semala tadir, vedan (da) deihu yarcha semala, natil levatrayyta, veal da hu hameassef lechol hammachanot letzivotam, veazil levatrayyta.

Yehuda natil chela bitren deroin, begin diruven deihu yemina, (sefer acher itavir) itavid minneh becheruta kehunnata umalchuta, veal da ketiv bihuda, (Devarim 33:7) yadav rav lo veezer mitztzarav tihye.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Melachim 1 10:16) vayyaas hammelech shelomo kisse shen gadol. kurseyay dishlomo, avad leh kegavvna dilela, vechol diukenin (dehacha) dilela avad hacha. veal da ketiv, (divre hayamim 1 29:23) vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai lemelech, melech milla setima hu. vechen (Melachim 1 2:12) ushelomo yashav al kisse david aviv vattikkon malchuto meod, dekayyma sihara beashlamuta.
Dan yadin ammo bekadmita, ulevatar shivte yisrael keachad, keyichudo shel olam kema dehava beshimshon, deihu yechiday avid dina bealma, vedain vekatil kechada, vela itzterich semech.

Dan yadin ammo. ribbi yitzchak amar, dan, hayeynu chivya, kamin al orchin ushevilin. vei tema deal shimshon bilchodoy hu. uf hachi name leela, da hu nefesh ochora (sefer acher nachash zuta) meassef lechol hammachanot, vechamin leorchin ushevilin. levatar, chelin umashshiryayn mehacha nafke, inun dechaman livne nasha, al chovin, deramin lehu laachora batar kitfayyeyhu. amar ribbi chiyyay, nachash hakkadmoni leela, ad dela yitbassam bechamra dechedu.

Nachash ale derech. ta chaze, kema deit derech leela, hachi name it derech letatta, umitparsha yamma, lechamma orchin bechol setar. veit orcha chad, deate veasge yamma, verabbe nunin bishin liznayyhu, kema daafiku mayin letatta nunin tavin, (Shemot 30) nunin bishin, nune uredanaya, kegavvna da, nunin bishin liznayyhu.

Vechad mishtammeshe mearcha deyamma, itchazun rachvin al susayyhu. veilmale dehay chivya, deihu kanish lechol mashshiryayn, kamin lesof archin, uvaddar lon laachora, havu metashteshe alma. missitra dehanne nafkin chorashin lealma. ta chaze, bevilam ketiv, (Bamidbar 24:1) velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim, begin deinun kayymin lelachasha bacharashe alma.

Chame ma ketiv, yehi dan nachash ale derech. may ale derech. ella nachash, man deishtaddal avatreh, akkechish fammalya dilela, umay ihu, hahu derech illaa denafak milleela. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam derech vegomer. nachash, man deishtaddal avatreh, keilu azil al hahu derech illaa leakkechasha leh, begin dimhahu derech, itzanu almin illae.

Vei tema, dan, ammay ihu bedarga da, ella kedichtiv, (Bereshit 3:24) veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet lishmor et derech etz hachayyim. hachi name hannoshech ikve sus vegomer, begin lenatra leh lechol mashshiryayn. amar ribbi elazar, tikkuna dechuresyay ihu. ta chaze, kurseyay dishlomo malka, chad chivya merafref bekitture sharvita leela mearyevata.

Ketiv, (Shoftim 13:25) vattachel ruach Adonai lefaamo bemachane dan vegomer. ta chaze, shimshon nezir olam hava, ufaresh alma ihu, veitgabbar beh chela takkifa, vehu hava chivya behay alma, lokovel ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, deha achsanat chulaka devirchata dedan avuhi yarit, dichtiv, yehi dan nachash ale derech vegomer.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, nachash yedia, shefifon may nihu. amar leh, raza detikkuna dachorashin, denachash ihu shefifon, hachi name hahu rasha devilam, becholla hava yada. ta chaze ketiv, (Bamidbar 23:3) vayyelech shefi, lezimnin behay, ulezimnin behay.

Vei tema dan, lav dargeh behay. hachi hu vadday. ella itmanna al darga da (lehahu), lemeheve sitra batrayyta, ushevacha ihu dileh, memannan demalka behay, umemanna al hay, vikara ihu lechol inun memunnin. vekurseyay demalka, bechol inun memannan ittakkan, bechol hanne memannan techotayyhu mitparshan orchin vedargin, hen letav, hen levish, vechullehu itachadan behanne tikkune dekurseyay. uvegini kach dan listar tzafon, benukeva dithoma rabba. distar tzafon kamma chavile terikin izdammenan tamman, vechullehu tafsira dekistera leavasha alma.
Begine kach tzalle yaakov veamar, lishuatcha kivviti Adonai. bechol shevatim la kaamar lishuatcha ella behay. begin dechama leh tukefa takkifa dechivya, merachasha dina leitgabbera.

Ribbi yose veribbi chizkiyya havu azle lemecheme leribbi shimon bekapputekiyya, amar ribbi chizkiyya, hay deamrinan leolam yesadder bar nash shevacha demareh, ulevatar yetzalle tzeloteh, hay man delibbeh tarid, uvae letzallaa tzeloteh, veihu beaku, vela yachil lesaddera shevacha demareh kedka yeut, may hu.

Amar leh, af al gav dela yachil lechavvevna libba ureuta, siddura veshivcha demareh ammay gara, ella yesadder shivcheh demareh, af al gav dela yachil lechavvevna, vitzalle tzeloteh. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 17:1) tefilla ledavid shima Adonai tzedek hakeshiva rinnati, shima Adonai tzedek bekadmita, begin deihu siddura deshivcha demareh. ulevatar hakeshiva rinnati haazina tefillati. man deyachil lesaddera shevacha demarih, vela avid, aleh ketiv, (yeshaya 60) gam ki tarbu tefilla enenni shomea yedechem vegomer.

Ketiv, (Shemot 29:39) et hakkeves haechad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim. tefillot keneged temidin tikkenum. ta chaze, beitaruta diltatta, itar hachi name leela. uveitaruta dilela, hachi name leela minneh, ad demate itaruta leatar devaya butzina leadlaka veadlik. uveitaruta ditnana diltatta, adlik butzina leela, vechad hay adlik (butzinin), kullehu butzinin ochoranin dalkin, umitbarchan minneh kullehu almin. ishtakkach, deitaruta dekarbana tikkuna dealma, uvirchan dealmin kullehu.

Ha chetzad, share tenana lesalka, inun diukenin kaddishin dimmannan al alma ithannun (sefer acher atetakenan) leatara, umitarin ledargin bechissufa dilela, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:21) hakkefirim shoagim lattaref vegomer. illen itarin ledargin illain dealayyhu, ad demate itaruta, ad devae malka leitchabbera bematronita.

Uvechissufa diltatta, navin mayin tattain, lekivla mayin illain, deha la navin mayin illain, ella beitaruta dechisufa diltatta, ucheden tiuveta itdabbak, venavin mayin tattain lokovel mayin illain, vealmin mitbarchan, uvutzinin kullehu delikan, veillain vetattain mishtakkeche bevirchan.

Ta chaze, kohane velevae. mitare leitchabbera semala bimina. amar ribbi chizkiyya, kolla hachi hu vadday, aval hachi shemana, kohane velevae, da itar semala, veda itar yemina, begin deitchabberuta didchura legabbe nukeva, lav ihu ella bismala vimina. kema deat amer, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. ucheden itchabbar dechar benukeva, vetiuveta ishtakkach, vealmin mitbarchin, veillae vetattae bechedu.

Veal da, kohane velevae, mitare milla letatta, leitara kissufa vachavivuta leela, decholla talya bimina usemala. ishtakkach dekarbana yesoda dealma, tikkuna dealma, chedu deillain vetattain. amar ribbi yose vadday shappir ka amart, vehachi hu, vehachi shemana milla, veanshena lah, veana shemana ha, vecholla bechad salka.

Hasheta tzelota beatar dekarbana, uvee bar nash lesaddera shevacha demareh kedka yeut, vei la yesaddar, lav tzeloteh tzelota. ta chaze, siddura shelim deshivcha dekudesha berich hu, man deyada leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeut, divhay mitarin illain vetattain, venagde birchan lechullehu almin.
