Amar ribbi chizkiyya, la ashre kudesha berich hu leyisrael begaluta bene ammaya, ella begin deyitbarchun shear amin beginehon, deha inun nagdin birchan milleela letatta kol yoma.

Azlu, ad dehavu azle, chamu chad chivya dehava kamaschar (vaasater) bearcha. satu mearcha. ata bar nash ochora legabbayyhu, katil leh chivya. ahadaru reshayyhu, vechamu leh, lehahu bar nash demit. amru, vadday hahu nachash, shelichuta demareh ka avid. berich rachamana deshezvinana.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, yehi dan nachash ale derech. ematay hava dan nachash, beyomoy diravam, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 12:29) veet haechad natan bedan ammay ityeyhiv tamman ale derech. al hahu orach, deyitmena (hahu derech desallekin) dela yislekun lirushalam (velo yesalkun tamman). veda dan, hava lon nachash leyisrael ale derech, ale derech vadday, kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 12:6) vayyivvaatz hammelech vegomer. shefifon ale orach. deakitz lon leyisrael. vecholla la hava ella ale derech, vaale orcha, leitmenaa miyyisrael dela yislekun lirushalam, lemechag chagayyhu, ulekarava karbanin veillavvavn, lemiflach tamman.

Ta chaze, beshata dematu birchan lida demoshe, levarcha lechullehu shevatim, chama ledan dehava katir bechivya, ahadar katar leh bearya. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:22) uledan amar dan gor arye yezannek min habbashan. may tama, begin (deihu) dihe sheruta vesofa ded diglin katir bihuda deihu malka, kema deat amer, gor arye yehuda, vehu sheruta dediglin. vesofa dediglin dan, dichtiv dan gor arye vegomer, lemehevi sheruta vesofa katir bechad atar:

Lishuatcha kivviti Adonai, ribbi chiyyay amar, (kedichtiv) kema deat amer, (Shoftim 13:5) vehu yachel lehoshia et yisrael miyyad pelishtim. amar (sefer acher rabbi acha), vechi ammay kivviti veha salik hava yaakov mealma behahu zimna mikkamma shenin. ammay amar deihu mechakke lehahu yeshua. (sefer acher ella vadday) amar leh vadday raza demilla, kedichtiv, (Shemot 17:11) vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael, yisrael setam. uf hacha vehu yachel lehoshia et yisrael, yisrael setam. begine kach amar, lishuatcha kivviti Adonai. amar ribbi chiyyay. vadday hachi hu, veshappir. zakkaa chulekehon detzaddikayay, deyade leishtaddela beorayyta, lemizke bah lechayyin dilela. kema deat amer, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha lashevet al haadama vegomer.

rashi: Chelek kechelek yochelu. melammed shecholkin baorot ubbivsar seire chattaot, yachol af biddevarim habbaim shello mechamat haregel, kegon temidin umusefe shabbat unedarim unedavot, talo levad mimkarav al haavot chutz mimma shemmachru haavot bime david ushemuel shennikveu hammishmarot umachru ze laze, tol atta shabbattecha vaani ettol shabbatti (sham):
Kaasher dibber lo. "beartzam lo tinchal, ani chelkecha" (Bamidbar 18):
Ayin beayin. mamon, vechen shen beshen vegomer (sifre; bava kamma 84):
Nachon. mechuvvan haedut:
Ki tikrav el ir. bemilchemet harshut hakkatuv medabber, kemo shemmeforash bainyan "ken taase lechol hearim harchokot vegomer" (sifre):
ohc: Ki tikrav vegomer. ulay parasha zo tirmoz al pi ma sheamar harashbi besefer hazzohar (10 62.) ki haadon baruch hu sholeach neshama yetera lehaadam meolam haelyon lehadericho bederech yashar, uveemtzautah yimmalet haadam mehammachtio, vetzivva Adonai lanneshama veamar ki tikrav el ir – ze hu guf haadam shennikra ir, keamram besefer hazzohar (zohar chodesh Rut 97.) befasuk "ir ketanna" (Kohelet 9:14) veze leshono: "ir ketanna" – da gufa devar nash, ad kan, lemilchama – ki tzarich koach lehatztzil haadam miyyad marshio.
Vedikdek lomar "aleha", perush, bishvil hair lemalletah miyyetzer hara, al derech amro (Kohelet 9:14) "uva eleha" vegomer umillat hair bechachmato (nedarim lev:).

Vekarata eleha leshalom. perush, shello tavo eleha bifsiotecha lehattoto lederech hattov min hakkatze el hakkatze, ella bitchilla bekarvecha tikra eleha leshalom, sheaso yaase gam laolam haelyon veyehane baze uvabba, veyitten chelek laggufaniyyut vechelek laruchaniyyut, ki gam laolam haelyon tzarich haadam limzonot, veim lo yatriach baolam hazze bead olam habba gam ken, nimtza shello yaggiu veyovad leolam vaed, vederech ze yikkare divre shalom, shehu habbitztzua.

Veamro vehaya im shalom. perush "vehaya" leshon simcha hi im shalom taancha. veamar ufatcha perush, en tzorech ella peticha levad, veim yiftach kefitcho shel machat hakkadosh baruch hu yiftach lo kefitcho shel ulam. vehu ma sheggamar omer vehaya kol haam hannimtza vah ramach evarim ushesa gidim hakkol yishtabed lanneshama, ben bivchinat mitzvot ase yihyu lamas laasot begufam uvemamonam vechulei, ben bivchinat mitzvot lo taase vaavaducha perush, keeved hayyare merabbo leval netot middevarav yamin usemol.

Veamro veim lo tashlim vegomer. perush, im lo hishlima hair venatta ashureha minni derech, velifamim yiker mikre sheachar shehitchil haadam lehetiv maasav yashuv achorannit, uchesheera ze lehaadam yagdil resha veyitchazzek yitzro alav yoter mibbarishona lehillachem im hanneshama, vehu amro veasta immecha milchama. yetzav Adonai latzur al hair besiggufim, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (berachot 5.): leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara, veharegazato hu lesaggef atzmo bidvarim hammuttarim lo, gam betaaniyyot umalkiyyot uvechi lehattish koach hara shebbair, umavticho Adonai littenah beyado, keamro "unetanah Adonai elohecha beyadecha". vehikkita chol zechurah hu koach 100 vechelotav.
Veamro lefi charev – al derech amro (tehillim 149:6) "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam".

Veamro rak hannashim vehattaf – perush, "nashim" hem nefesh veruach, venikreu nashim beerech hanneshama kayyadua leyode chen, "vehattaf" hem mitzvot umaasim tovim sheasa adam kodem shehaya metoav beene Adonai, besod (tehillim 50,16) "velarasha amar elohim ma lecha lesapper chukkay", uchesheadam chozer bo yechashvu lizchut. gam al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (yoma 86:) shegagot naasot lo kizchuyyot, velahem yikkare taf.

Veamro vehabbehema hu taavat hachomer sheyyikkare behema, vechol asher bair tavoz lach shehakkol yihye letoelet hanneshama letakken hatztzarich letakken lehassagat hammuskalot, ki gam taavat habbehemi tesaggel segel hattov bema shennogea lah.

Veamro ken taase lechol hearim vegomer. perush kol mitzvot haamurot bainyan enam ella <לֶעָרִים> shehem haggufot shennitrachaku, al derech amro (390 57) "larachok velakkarov", shebbaal averot yikkare rachok mehashshechina, shehi mekor hakkedushsha shemmimmenna hi machtzav hanneshama haelyona, aval ir shehi meare haggoyim, perush, sheen lah kesher im hakkedushsha veyatzta mimmekorah berov peshaeha kechol haggoyim, en lanneshama chelek immah velo tikva bah lahashivah, vehu amro asher lo meare haggoyim vegomer, ki bechinot hahem en lahem ella lehacharimam. vezo hayta shiggat moshe bekabbalat erev rav (546 122), vaAdonai amar elav sheshsharsham ra veenam omdim begeder hakkedushsha umuvdalim lechelek ra, ucheshehaya mechayye otam, perush, lekarvam lakkodesh, eno mechayye bam kol neshama, dikdek lomar "kol" hi haruach shezzocha rishona im hanneshama:
Chassalat parashat Shoftim

rashi: Kaasher tzivvecha. lerabbot et haggirgashi (sham):
Yamim. shenayim:

Rabbim. shelosha, mikkan amru en tzarin al ayyarot shel goyim pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat, velimmed sheppoteach beshalom shenayim o shelosha yamim, vechen hu omer (Shmuel 2 1) vayyeshev david betziklag yamim shenayim (sifre); uvemilchemet harshut hakkatuv medabber:
Ki haadam etz hassade. hare ki meshammesh bilshon dilma, shemma haadam etz hassade lehikkanes betoch hammatzor mippanecha lehityasser beyissure raav vetzama keanshe hair? lamma tashchitennu?:
Hitnaari. 618 109, kimnaer et hattallit (shabbat 147 1):
Kumi. min haaretz, miggizrat "laaretz teshev" (Yeshayahu 3:26):
Shevi. al hakkisse:
Hitpattechi. hevi nitteret:
Sheviyya. kemo 'shevuya:
targum: Itnappatzi meafra kumi tevi al kurese yekara yerushelem itpesaku chinke tzavrechon sheviya kenishta detzion:

rashi: Chitztzecha shenunim belev oyve hammelech. shenunim agiyyeshotz belaaz, vahare ze mikra mesoras. matzinu shehattalmidim keruyim chitztzim, shenneemar "kechitztzim beyad gibbor ken bene hanneurim" (tehillim 127:4). vetalmide chachamim (hammezuyyanim) bahalacha keruyim oyvim ze laze lefi shaa, shenneemar "lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyvim bashshaar" (tehillim 127:5):
Ammim tachtecha yippelu. bischar hattora yippelu haovde gillulim tachtehem shel yisrael:
targum: Girrach shelifin ammin techotach yippelun uvene kashtach yishtalchun belev sane malka:

rashi: Meshachacha vegomer shemen sason. kol leshon gedulla nofel aleha leshon meshichat shemen, kedat hammelachim:
targum: Metul di richamta tzidkata useneta risha metul hechna rabbeyach Adonai elahach mishcha dechedva yattir min chavrach:

rashi: Im lo yashuv. harasha merisho:
Charbo yiltosh. hakkadosh baruch hu alav yiltosh, forbira belaaz, veyidroch kashto:
targum: Im la yetuv lidchalteh sayfeh shechiz kashteh meticha usedira:

rashi: Reshit degancha. zo teruma, velo peresh bah shiur, aval rabbotenu natnu vah shiur – ayin yafa echad mearbaim, ayin raa echad mishshishshim, benonit echad mechamishshim, vesamchu al hammikra shello lifchot meechad mishshishshim shenneemar (Yechezkel 45) shishshit haefa mechomer hachittim, shishshit haefa chatzi sea, kesheatta noten chatzi sea lechor hare echad mishshishshim, shehakkor sheloshim sein (talmud yerushalmi terumot 84):

Vereshit gez tzoncha. kesheatta gozez tzoncha bechol shana ten mimmenna reshit lakkohen, velo peresh bah shiur, verabbotenu natnu vah shiur echad mishshishshim, vechamma tzon chayyavot bereshit haggez? chamesh rechelot, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 25) vechamesh tzon asuyot. rabbi akiva omer reshit gez – shetayim, tzoncha – arbaa, titten lo – hare chamishsha (80 sifre vechullin 135):
Vattishkach Adonai osecha. velo nishanta alav:
Hammetzik. moshle ummot haolam hameshabedim bachem:
Kaasher konen. nizdammen:
Veayye chamat hammetzik. machar ba veenennu:
targum: Veitnesheta pulechana dayya deavdach ditla shemaya veshachlel ara udechalta tedira kol yoma min kodam chamat meika kema dimtaknin lechabbala uchean an hi chamat dimika:

rashi: Lo tatte mishpat. kemashmao:
Lo takkir panim. af bishat hatteanot; azhara laddayyan shello yehe rach laze vekashe laze, echad omed veechad yoshev, lefi shekkesheroe ze shehaddayyan mechabbed et chavero mistattemin taanotav:
Velo tikkach shochad. afillu lishpot tzedek (sifre):
Ki hashshochad yeavver. mishshekkibbel shochad mimmennu i efshar shello yatte et libbo etzlo lahafoch bizchuto:
Divre tzaddikim. devarim hametzuddakim – mishpete emet:
ohc: Lo tatte mishpat vegomer. lo yiched haazhara lashshoftim vetzivva lenocheach, lehair ki kelalut yisrael yeshnam gam ken beellu azharot – im lo yemannu hashshoftim kederech shennitztauu, hem hammattim mishpat, hem haovrim al kol haamur.

rashi: Ushechurat velo miyyayin. shechurat middavar acher shelo miyyayin:
targum: Bechen shimi chean da metaltalta deravya min aka vela min chamar:

rashi: Lo tizbach … kol davar ra. azhara lamfaggel bakkodashim ay dibbur ra. veod nidreshu vo shear derashot bishchitat kadashim (zevachim 36):
ohc: Lo tizbach vegomer asher yihye vo mum. velo amar asher bo mum, kefi ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (sifre) shebba hakkatuv leesor mum over, ramzu betevat yihye lomar kol havayat mum ben kavua ben over. veefshar od lomar sheim huchlat bah evar shennaasa bo baalat mum veamru harofim sheal kol panim tzarich lechatcho, hagam sheadayin lo chatacho hare zo pesula, vehu amro lo tizbach vegomer asher yihye vo mum perush hagam sheatta eno mum kevan sheomed lihyot mum lo tizbachennu.
Veasita al pi haddavar. perush, lo mibbaya hammishpat atzmo shehiggidu lecha, ella afilu mishpatim acherim hannivnim al pi shemua zo, ki kamma mishpatim yistaafu mipperat mishpat echad.

rashi: Vechol haam yishmeu. mikkan shemmamtinin lo ad haregel umemitin oto baregel (sanhedrin 89):
Ma li fo. lamma ani shohe umashhe banay kan?
Yehelilu. mitpaarim lemor: "yadenu rama" (Devarim 32:27):
Menoatz. mitnaetz, vahare ze dugmat "vayyishma et hakkol middabber elav" (Bamidbar 7:89):
targum: Uchean atidna lemifrak amar Adonai are izdabban ami magan ammaya dishlitu vehon mishtabbechin amar Adonai utedira kol yoma al pulechan shemi margezin:

rashi: Mihar tzoe lehippateach. afillu nekavin kashin alav, vetzarich hu lehippateach behilluch hammeayim kede shelo yamut lashshachat, vechevan shemmihar lehippateach tzarich hu limzonot rabbim, sheim yechsar lachmo af hu yamut:

Tzoe. leshon davar haomed lihyot nirok, kemo sheomer bemoav sheddimmahu hannavi leyayin (Yirmeyahu 48:11) "hashshoket el shemarav velo hurak mikkeli el keli", veneemar sham "veshalachti lo tzoim vetzeuhu vechelav yariku". davar acher: mihar tzoe – oto haoyev hammetzik, shehu achshav chagur matnayim, chalutz koach, yemaher lehippateach velihyot challash:
Tzoe. choger, kemo (Yeshayahu 63:1) "tzoe berov kocho":
Velo yamut. hammasur beyado lashshachat, aval hallashon rishon midderash aggada hu bifsikta rabbati (Pesikta rabbati log:):
targum: Mochi pureanuta leitgelaa vela yemutun tzadikaya lechabbel vela yachserun mezonehon:

rashi: Vechi yavo hallevi. yachol beven levi vadday hakkatuv medabber, talmud lomar usherat, yatzu leviyyim sheen reuyin lesherut (sifre):

Uva bechol avvat nafsho, usherat. limmed al hakkohen shebba umakriv karbenot nidvato o chovato vaafillu vemishmar sheeno shello (bava kamma 109); davar acher — od limmed al hakkohanim habbaim laregel shemmakrivin (bammishmar) veovdin bakkarbanot habbaot mechamat haregel kegon musefe haregel veaf al pi sheen hammishmar shellahem (sifre; socha 55):
El nachal etan. kashe, shello neevad:
Vearfu. kotzetz arpah bekofitz; amar hakkabba tavo egla vat shenatah shello asta ferot vetearef bemakom sheeno ose ferot, lechapper al harigato shel ze shello hinnichuhu laasot perot (sota 46):
Yamin usemol. afillu omer lecha al yamin shehu semol veal semol shehu yamin, vechol shekken sheomer lecha al yamin yamin veal semol semol (sifre):
Tzofayich. tzofim shemmaamidin al hachomot vehammigdalim levasser velirot mi ba lair:
targum: Kal parnasayich dimrimin kalhon kachada meshabbechin are veenehon yechezun gevuran di avad Adonai kad yetiv shechinte letzion:

rashi: Velo chillelo. lo pedao vashshana harviit, shehapperot teunin leachlan birushalayim o lechallelan bedamim veleechol haddamim birushalayim:
Laavor berito. asher karat ittechem shello laavod avoda zara:
ohc: Ki yimmatze vekirbecha. amro bekirbecha, lechayyev al haddavar livne hammakom sheshsham yimmatze haish ose hara, veacharehem yitchayyevu kol yoshve haaretz, vehu ma sheggamar omer beachad shearecha. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (ketuvot ma:) darshu "shearecha" ligzera shava, shaar shennimtzeu vo velo shaar shenniddonu vo. veamru asher Adonai elohecha noten lach, nitkavven lomar sheal menat ken Adonai netanah lach.

Laavor berito. perush, tzarich sheyyeda shehu over berit Adonai, velaze tzarich sheyyatru bo veyodiuhu ma gadlu maasav haraim. gam ramaz sheim amar lammatrim shehu nishba laavod avoda zara, sheyyodiuhu shekkadma lo berit al ze veen shevuato chala levattel harishona, vahare hu over berit Adonai veyehareg.

rashi: Ki holech lifnechem. shene devarim shebbesof hammikra hazze meyashshevin shene devarim shebberosho: ki lo vechippazon tetzeu – ma taam? ki holech lifnechem Adonai lanchotchem hadderech, umi sheshshelucho makdim lefanav lanchoto hadderech en yetziato vechippazon. uvimnusa lo telechun – lefi shemeassifchem elohe yisrael holech meacharechem lishmor etchem mikkol rodef, kemo "venasa degel machane dan meassef lechol hammachanot" (Bamidbar 10:25). haholech achare hammachane karuy meassef, lefi shehu mamtin et hannechelashim veet hannichshalim, vechen hu omer bihoshua (Yehoshua 6:13): "vehameassef holech achare haaron":
targum: Are la bivhilu tippekun mibbene ammaya uveeroke la tittovlun learachon are medabber kodamechon Adonai vaatid lechanasha galvatchon elaha deyisrael:

rashi: Yechabbel. leshon herayon veleda, kemo "shamma chibbelatcha immecha" (Shir HaShirim 8:5):
Vehara amal veyalad shaker. kol ma shehu molid veyagea – hakkol meshakker bo, sheeno mitkayyem beyado; matla amar : kol ma deshikra molid, pachta nasva:
targum: Ha yitztaar lishkar viede amla veyeled shikra:

rashi: Velo chanacho. velo dar bo, chinnuch leshon hatechala:
Veish acher yachnechennu. vedavar shel agmat nefesh hu ze:
Vehattaf. af taf shel zecharim, uma ani mekayyem "vehikkita et chol zechurah"? baggedolim (sham):
Pekuddato. gedullato, perovoshtia belaaz, kemo "veyafked hammelech pekidim" (Ester 2:3):
targum: Yehon yomoy kalilin minyan shenoy yerat ocharan:

rashi: Kol haam hannimtza vah. afillu atta motze vah mishshiva ummot shennitztavvita lehacharimam, atta rashshay lekayyemam (sham):
Lamas vaavaducha. ad sheyyekabbelu alehem missim veshibud (sham):
Tame al tiggau. sheketz yihyu lachem milligga bahem:
Tzeu mittochah. mittoch haggalut, kol nechamot haellu haacharonot enan ella al galut haacharon:
Hibbaru. hittaharu:
Nose kele Adonai. hakkohanim haleviyyim, shehayitem nosim kelav (shel hakkadosh baruch hu) bammidbar (mikkan litchiyyat hammetim):
targum: Itperashu itperashu puku mittaman bimsaav la tikrevun puku migavah itbecharu natle mane vet makdesha dayay:

rashi: Unetanah Adonai elohecha beyadecha. im asita kol haamur bainyan, sof she notnah beyadecha (sham):
Shema yisrael. afillu en bachem zechut ella keriat shema bilvad, keday attem sheyyoshia etchem:

Al oyvechem. en ellu achechem, sheim tippelu veyadam enam merachamim alechem, en zo kemilchemet yehuda im yisrael shenneemar (divrei hayamim 2 28 15) "vayyakumu haanashim asher nikkevu veshemot vayyachaziku vashshivya vechol maarummehem hilbishu min hashshalal vayyalbishum vayyanilum vayyaachilum vayyashkum vaysuchum vaynahalum bachamorim lechol koshel vayvium yerecho ir hattemarim etzel achehem vayyashuvu shomron", ella al oyvechem attem holchim, lefichach hitchazzeku lammilchama (sifre; sota 42):

Al yerach levavchem al tiru veal tachpezu veal taartzu. arba azharot keneged arbaa devarim shemmalche haummot osim, megifin bitrisehem kede lehakkishan ze laze kede lehashemia kol sheyyachpezu ellu shekkenegdan veyanusu, veromsim besusehem umatzhilin otam lehashemia kol shaatat parsot susehem, vetzovchin bekolam, vetokin bashshofarot umine mashmie kol:
Al yerach levavchem. mitztzahalat susim:
Al tiru. mehagafat hatterisin:
Veal tachpezu. mikkol hakkeranot:
Veal taartzu. mikkol hatztzevacha (sham):
Mi at. bat tzaddikim kemotech, melea zechuyyot, lamma tiri meenosh asher sofo lamut?
targum: Ana ana hu menachemchon miman attun dachalin meenasha demaet umibbar enasha di cheisba chashiv:

rashi: Veamdu shene haanashim. beedim hakkatuv medabber velimmed sheen edut benashim, velimmed shetztzerichin lehaid edutan meomed (shavuot 30):
Asher lahem hariv. ellu vaale haddin:
Lifne Adonai. yihye dome lahem keillu omdin lifne hammakom, shenneemar (Tehillim 82) bekerev elohim yishpot (sanhedrin 6):
Asher yihyu bayyamim hahem. yiftach bedoro kishmuel bedoro, tzarich atta linhog bo kavod:
Yeda ammi. kesheegalem yakkiru, ki shemi adon, shallit umoshel, kemashmao (chagiga 15:-16.):
Lachen bayyom. geullatam yavinu ki ani hu hamedabber hinneni kiyyamti:
targum: Bechen yitrabba veammaya shemi bechen beidana hahi tedun are ana hu demallet umemri kayam:

rashi: Kubbaat. tirgem yonatan: "payle", vehu shem kos. veli nire: kubbaat – ellu hashshemarim hakkevuim betachtit hakkeli, umatzit yore alav, kemo shenneemar "shemareha yimtzu" (tehillim 75:9):

Hattarela. hu mashke hametamtem umattish koach haadam keasur vekashur umeuttaf, kemo "vehabberoshim haralu" (Nachum 2:4), "vehashsherot veharalot" (Yeshayahu 3:19), shehu leshon 'ittuf, uvemassechet shabbat (shabbat 65 1) madiyyot reulot – min sarbal nae lehitattef bo:
targum: Itrabba itrabba kumi yerushelem dekabbelt min kodam Adonai yat kasa dechemte yat payle kasa dilvata shetet aret:

rashi: Raa tachat tova. shivim parim ani makriv bechol shana bishvil shivim ummot, umevakkesh ligshamim, vehem mereim li:
targum: Veshavun alay bishta chalaf tava vesinata chalaf dirchimet:

rashi: Ki tetze lammilchama. samach hakkatuv yetziat milchama lechan, lomar lecha sheen mechussar ever yotze lammilchama (80 sifre); davar acher, lomar lecha im asita mishpat tzedek, atta muvtach sheim tetze lammilchama atta notzeach, vechen david hu omer (Tehillim 119) asiti mishpat vatzedek bal tannicheni leoshkay (tanchuma):
Al oyvecha. yihyu beenecha keoyvim, al terachem alehem ki lo yerachamu alecha:
Sus varechev. beenay kullam kesus echad, vechen hu omer (Shoftim 6) vehikkita et midyan keish echad, vechen hu omer (Shemot 15) ki va sus paro (80 sifre):
Am rav mimmecha. beenecha hu rav, aval beenay eno rav (sham):
ohc: Ki tetze lammilchama vegomer. ulay sheramaz hakkatuv milchemet haadam im yitzro, uva lehasir millevavo morech, veamar ki tetze lammilchama hayyedua sheen gedola mimmenna, vehinne bemilchama zo yesh shene devarim kashim laadam shemmattishim kocho, 1 hu sheeno melummad bammilchama kemo shehu melummad veragil bemin milchama zo yitzro hara, 2 sheharekavat haadam <חֹבֶקֶת> divre hayyetzer bechol asher yomar elav beinyene haissur lignov veligzol veligot veleechol kol asher teavve nafsho, veze yimnaehu millishmoa el divre hattora vehammitzvot, uma gam achar shennichshal baaverot rabbot sheyyittosfu kochot hara shennoldu mimmaasav haraim kemo shepperashti bimkomot acherim vahare hu benehem kacharara sheen lah hofchin:

Laze ba devar Adonai kan veamar: ki tetze lammilchama veraita beene sichlecha sus varechev, "sus" keneged ma shehu hayyetzer sus muchan lammilchama ma sheeno chen haadam, "rechev" keneged harekavat haadam shennota vechosheket lidvarim. veamro am rav mimmecha keneged kochot hara shennittosfu mimmennu mitztzad maasav haraim kemo sheamarnu. af al pi chen ba devaro hattov veamar: lo tira mehem, vehattaam hu ki Adonai elohecha immach, perush, hen emet im hayita ba lammilchama bechochacha en becha koach laamod bemilchama zo, aval kevan she elohecha immach kocho gadol lehatztzilcha, ki keshebba adam littaher yemino yitbarach mekabbalto venidbak laAdonai vehu yachnia metzerav.

Vegamar omer hammaalcha meeretz mitzrayim, ki ze mofet chotech ki Adonai mefarek hakkelippa min hakkedushsha umevarrah, vehu sod haalaat yisrael mimmitzrayim kayyadua leyode chen, veze lecha haot kede shettitchazzek bammilchama, vechen hu omer (tehillim 37:32) "tzofe rasha latztzaddik vegomer Adonai lo yaazvennu veyado", veamru zichronam livracha (kiddushin 30:) shehakkatuv medabber al yetzer hara shehu mitgabber al haadam vaAdonai ozro umatztzilo miyyado:

rashi: Veatta tevaer. maggid sheim nimtza hahoreg achar shennitarfa haegla hare ze yehareg vehu hayyashar beene Adonai (sota 47; ketuvot 37):
Ode Adonai ketzidko. kesheyyatzdik haddin haggamur lishpot harshaim kerisham:
targum: Ashabbach Adonai betzidketeh vaashakkach shum elaha ilaa:

rashi: Hinne yaskil avdi. hinne beacharit hayyamim yatzliach avdi yaakov, tzaddikim shebbo:
targum: Ha yatzlach avdi meshicha yerum veyisge veyitkof lachada:

rashi: Tzedek tzedek tirdof. halloch achar bet din yafe (sifre; sanhedrin 32):
Lemaan tichye veyarashta. keday hu minnuy haddayyanin hakkesherim lehachayot et yisrael ulehoshivan al admatan (sifre):
ohc: Tzedek tzedek tirdof vegomer. ba lehazehir kesheyyesh bair shene anashim muflagim bechachma ushenayim acherim gam ken chachamim ella sheenam besug harishon, al yomar adam: kevan sheshshene anashim yecholin lehorot velishpot betzedek lo atriach et hammuflagim lissa beol minnuy haddayyanut, o letzad shetztzarich lahem torach beminnuyam yimmana veyistappek bakketannim, talmud lomar "tzedek tzedek", perush, hagam shehissagta ledayyanim shehem reuyim, alecha lachzor achar hayyoter reuyim mehem.

rashi: Lemaan asher lo yelammedu. ha im asu teshuva umitgayyerin atta rashshay lekabbelam (sham):
Velo takim lecha matztzeva. matztzevet even achat lehakeriv aleha afillu lashshamayim:

Asher sane. mizbach avanim umizbach adama tzivva laasot, veet zo sane, ki chok hayta lakkenaaniyyim, veaappi shehayta ahuva lo bime haavot, achshav seneah meachar sheasauha ellu chok laavoda zara (80 sham):
Maavir beno uvitto baesh. hi avodat hammolech, ose medurot esh mikkan umikkan umaaviro ven shetehem (80 sanhedrin 64):
Kosem kesamim. e zehu kosem? haochez et maklo veomer im elech im lo elech, vchen hu omer (Hoshea 4) ammi beetzo yishal umaklo yaggid lo (sifre):
Meonen. rabbi akiva omer ellu notne onot – sheomrim ona pelonit yafa lehatechil, vachachamim omrim ellu ochaze haenayim:
Menachesh. pitto nafla mippiv, tzevi hifsiko vadderech, maklo nafal miyyado (sifre; sanhedrin 65):

Veniddecha yado. keshebba lehappil haggarzen al haetz, vetargumo "vetitmereg yedeh", leshon venishmeta yado lehappil makkat haggarzen al haetz, "ki shamtu habbakar" (Shmuel 2 6) tirgem yonatan "are marguhi torayya":
Venashal habbarzel min haetz. yesh merabbotenu omrim nishmat habbarzel mikkatto, veyesh mehem omrim sheyyishshal habbarzel chaticha min haetz hammitbakkea vehi nitteza veharga (makkot 7):
Vedarshu hashshoftim hetev. al pi hamezimmin otam, shebbodkim vechokrim et habbaim lahazimam bidrisha vachakira:
Vehinne ed sheker haed. kol makom shenneemar ed — bishnayim hakkatuv medabber:
Kol shevet levi. ben temimin ben baale mumin (sifre):
Chelek. babbizza:
Venachala. baaretz (sham):
Ishshe Adonai. kadshe hammikdash:

Venachalato. ellu kadshe haggevul – terumot umaasrot, aval nachala gemura lo yihye lo bekerev achiv; uvesifre darshu – venachala lo yihye lo — zo nachalat shear, bekerev achiv — zo nachalat chamishsha. veeni yodea ma hi, venire li sheeretz kenaan shemmeever hayyarden vaelach nikret eretz chamishsha amamin, veshel sichon veog shene amamin, emori uchenaani, venachalat shear lerabbot keni ukenizzi vekadmoni, vechen doresh befarashat mattanot shenneemru leaharon (Bamidbar 18) "al ken lo haya lelevi vegomer" lehazehir al keni ukenizzi vekadmoni. shuv nimtza vedivre rabbi kelonimus hache garsinan besifre: venachala lo yihye lo. ellu nachalat chamishsha, bekerev achiv ellu nachalat shiva, nachalat chamishsha shevatim venachalat shiva shevatim; umittoch shemmoshe vihoshua lo chilleku nachala ella lachamishsha shevatim bilvad, shekken moshe hinchil liruven vegad vachatzi shevet menashshe, vihoshua hinchil lihuda veefrayim velachatzi shevet menashshe, veshiva haacherim natlu meelehen achare mot yehoshua, mittoch kach hizkir chamishsha levad veshiva levad:
ohc: Lo yihye lakkohanim vegomer venachala lo yihye vegomer. kafal hakkatuv hainyan lomar shehagam sheavru venatnu lahem nachala, otah nachala lo takum lizchutam, vehu amro venachala lo yihye vegomer. vetaam semichut mitzva zo lemitzvat hammelech, lomar shehammelech shave laam bammitzvot haamurim bainyan latet lahem mattenotehem, velo yarum levavo meechav levilti sur min hammitzva shemmetzavve Adonai lichlalut yisrael.

rashi: Kisacha elohim. kisacha, sar veshofet, lolam vaed; keinyan shenneemar "netatticha elohim lefaro" (Shemot 7:1). velamma? bishvil sheshevet mishor shevet malchutecha. shemmishpatecha emet verauy atta limloch:
targum: Kurese yekarach Adonai kayaym lealme almin chutera teretzta chutera demalchutach:

rashi: Meet haam. velo meet hakkohanim (sifre; chullin 132):
Im shor im se. perat lechayya:
Hazzeroa. min happerek shel arkubba ad kaf shel yad shekkorin ashepaledaven (chullin 134):

Hallechayayim. im hallashon. dorshe reshumot hayu omrim zeroa tachat yad, shenneemar (Bamidbar 25) "vayyikkach romach beyado", lechayayim tachat tefilla, shenneemar (Tehillim 110) "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel", vehakkeva tachat "haishsha el kovatah" (Bamidbar 25):
Mogayich. meniech umetaltelech, kemo "vehinne hehamon namog" (Shmuel 1 14:16). 846 109:
Shechi venaavora. al gabbech:
targum: Veemserinah beyad dahavo monan lich dahavo amrin lenafshech amichi venede veamecht keara yekarich vahavet keshuk leadan:

rashi: Veim yarchiv … kaasher nishba. latet lecha eretz keni ukenizzi vekadmoni:
ohc: Veim yarchiv vegomer laavotecha. perush atzman, ki hem yinchalu haaretz leatid lavo, veamar ze yussag lahem im yishmeru et kol hattora veyaasuha, vetihye hashshemira vehaasiyya meahavat Adonai velo miyyira. haddor hahu asher yaamod baze, beyamav yakim Adonai devaro hattov latet kol haasara amamin veyaamid beyad yisrael kol hattov shehivtiach laasot laavot beyom amdam battechiyya. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 99:) heiru sheggeulla haatida teluya baavodat Adonai meahava davka.

rashi: Lintoa shamayim. "lekayyama amma daamir alehon deyisgon kechochve shemayya" (targum yonatan):
Velisod aretz. "uleshachlala kenishta daamir alehon deyisgon keafra deara":
targum: Veshaveti pitgame nevuati befumach uvitlal gevureti agnet alach lekayama ama daamir alehon deyisgun kechochve shemaya uleshachlala chenishta daamir alehon deyisgun keafra deara ulememar liddayrin betzion ami attun:

rashi: Asher yedabber hannavi. veyomar davar ze atid lavo alechem vetiru shello yavo, hu haddavar asher lo dibbero Adonai vaharog oto. veim tomar zo vemitnabbe al haatidot, hare shebba veamar asu chach vechach umippi hakkabba ani omer? kevar nitztauu sheim ba lehaddichacha meachat mikkol hammitzvot lo tishma lo (Devarim 13) ella im ken mumche hu lecha shehu tzaddik gamur, kegon eliyyahu vehar hakkarmel shehikriv bevama bishat issur habbamot, kede ligdor et yisrael, hakkol lefi tzorech shaa useyag happirtza, lechach neemar (pasuk 15) elav tishmaun (sanhedrin 89):
Lo tagur mimmennu. lo timna atzmecha millelammed alav chova (sifre), velo tira leanesh alav:
Lo titta lecha ashera. lechayyevo aleha mishsheat netiatah, vaafillu lo avadah over belo taase al netiatah (sham):
Lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha. azhara lenotea ilan ulevone vayit behar habbayit:
ohc: Lo titta lecha ashera vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sanhedrin 7:): kol hammaamid dayyan sheeno hagun keillu notea ashera, ad kan. uledivrehem amar tevat "lecha", lomar sheeno maale alav keillu vechulei ella im kesheyyaamidennu tihye kavvanato leezo sibba shennogaat mimmenna, aval zulat ze im taa bedayyan sheeno hagun vechashav shehu hagun veheemido, eno nechshav alav kehaamadat ashera.

rashi: Yishmeu veyirau. mikkan shetztzerichin hacheraza – ish peloni ufeloni neheragin al shehuzammu bevet din (sanhedrin 89):
Ad ridtah. leshon ridduy, shettehe kefufa lecha:
Roga hayyam. leshon "ori raga" (Iyov 7:5), 427 109:
targum: Vaana Adonai elahach dinzef beyama vehaman galohi Adonai tzevaot sheme:

rashi: Shoftim veshotrim. shoftim – dayyanim happoskim et haddin, veshotrim – harodin et haam achar mitzvatam (shemmakkin vechoftin) bemakkel uvirtzua ad sheyyekabbel alav et din hashshofet:
Bechol shearecha. bechol ir vair:
Lishvatecha. musav al titten lecha – shoftim veshotrim titten lecha lishvatecha bechol shearecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha:
Lishvatecha. melammed shemmoshivin dayyanin lechol shevet vashevet uvechol ir vair (sifre; sanhedrin 16):
Veshaftu et haam vegomer. manne dayyanin mumchim vetzaddikim lishpot tzedek (80 sifre):
ohc: Shoftim vegomer. samach mitzva zo lemitzvat "shalosh peamim" vegomer shellefaneha, lehair shehagam shemmetzavvecha laalot shalosh peamim bashshana leraot et pene Adonai vesham hi omedet sanhedre gedola kevua, af al pi chen tzarich lemannot shoftim vechulei, velo yismechu al bet din shellifne Adonai belishkat haggazit levad. vehattaam kede shello teanne haddin ad alot el hammakom.

Vetaam hashshotrim, amru bappesikta: rabbi elazar ben shammua omer, im yesh shotrim – yesh shoftim, im en shotrim – en shoftim, ad kan. haddevarim mochichim sheim en shotrim en chiyyuv mitzvat shoftim, umeatta kol sheyyodim yisrael shehaam enam nishmaim lashshoftim vehashshoftim enam yecholim lechufam – en chiyyuv beminnuy hashshoftim, vechol shehaam nishmaim ledayyanehem belo shotrim chayyavin lemannot shoftim, vekorim anu beshofet ze shofet veshoter.

Titten lecha. perush, shehammemannim atzman lo yomru bedatan shello tishlot alehem makkel marduto shel shofet veshoter kevan shehem hammemannim oto, ella sheyyemannum lishpot velirdot otam, vehu amro titten lecha perush alecha.

Bechol shearecha. taam amro bechol, shetztzarich lemannot bechol ir vair uvechol pelech vafelech beeretz yisrael, uvabbarayta (yalkut shemauni) amru veze leshonam: "bechol shearecha" – ba hakkatuv lehakkish sanhedre ketanna lesanhedre gedola, ma gedola dana vehoreget af ketanna dana vehoreget, ad kan. venire shedderashatam hi mittevat "bechol", shekkalal hakkatuv kol hassanhedrin yachad lomar sheshshavim bechoach echad.
Veamro asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha, amru zichronam livracha (makkot 7.) shebba lomar sheen chiyyuv haamur bainyan ella baaretz asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha velo bechutz laaretz:

Veamro lishvatecha rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre) pershuhu shemmusav lemala, vekashe lamma lo ketavo bimkomo al ze hadderech "titten lecha lishvatecha bechol shearecha asher" vegomer? veulay shennitkavven lehasemichah lemaamar "veshaftu et haam mishpat tzedek" lehair ki hu ze taam shemmetzavve latet shoftim bechol ir, uveir sheyyesh shene shevatim shene shoftim kede sheyyishpetu mishpat tzedek. vedikdek lomar et haam, perush shello yihye hefresh benehem veyihyu niddonim ze et ze behashevaa, kevan shekkol shevet niddon lifne bet dino. uvaze anu marvichim yishshuv maamar veshaftu, sheim ba lehazehir laddayyanim haya lo ledabber nocheach kasseder sheddibber besamuch "lo tatte lo takkir" vegomer. verashi zichrono livracha peresh shehu azhara lammemannim lemannot tzaddikim, velidvarav haya lo lomar al ze hadderech "shoftim sheshshoftim betzedek vegomer titten lecha" vegomer, uledarkenu yavo al nachon.

Veraiti larambam zichrono livracha (hilchot sanhedrin perek 1) shehishmit din ze shetztzarich lechol shevet vashevet, velo katav ella shellechol ir vair. veulay shessover harambam shekkavvanat rabbotenu zichrono livracha sheddarshu "lishvatecha" shetztzarich bet din lechol shevet, hu kodem sheddarshu shetztzarich bechol ir, aval achar shetztzarich lechol ir en od tzorech limnot lechol shevet. veze leshon habbarayta besanhedrin (daf 16 amud bet): tanu rabbanan, minnayin shemmaamidin shoftim leyisrael? talmud lomar "shoftim titten" vegomer, lechol shevet vashevet minnayin? talmud lomar "shoftim lishvatecha", lechol ir vair minnayin? talmud lomar "shoftim lisharecha" ad kan. vekashe lamma darash hattanna tevat "lishvatecha" shehu besof pasuk kodem tevat "bechol shearecha" shekkeduma lah, shemmin harauy haya lattanna lehakedim derashat "bechol shearecha"? ella hare ze maggid shello ba chiyyuv "lishvatecha" ella kodem chiyyuv kol shearecha, aval achar shetztzivva "bechol shearecha" en makom lehatzerich lashshevatim. velaze harambam shekkatav chiyyuv bechol ir en makom lomar bechol shevet. ulederech ze derashat hattanna hu al ze hadderech, shemmechayyevcha hakkatuv latet shoftim lechol shevet ben yihye baasara ayarot ben yihye beir achat, vechazar veamar sheim yihye beharebe ayarot yitten lechol ir vair.

Veim tomar: im yitten bechol ir, lamma hutzrach lomar "lishvatecha"? mishshum shezzulat "lishvatecha" lo hayiti mefaresh "bechol shearecha" bechol ir vair, shehayiti omer sherotze lomar shearecha shel kelalut yisrael, ben shebbeeretz yisrael ben shebbeever hayyarden, lo shel kol ir vair shebbaaretz. veachar amro "lishvatecha" shepperusho hu lechol shevet, nitchayyavnu lomar "bechol shearecha" bechol ir. velaze kesheppasak harambam bechol ir, en makom lomar "lishvatecha", sheaz tefaresh bidvarav kedivre hattosafot (sanhedrin 56.) sheim yesh bair shene shevatim tzarich shene batte dinim.

Mishpat tzedek. velo amar betzedek keamro (Vayikra 19:15) "betzedek tishpot amitecha", kan heir heara gedola lechafetz lishpot betzedek, vehu ki kesheyyirtze laamod haddayyan al mishpat haanashim asher lahem hariv yihye beseder ze, sheyyaavir mibben enav shene hannosim velo yalbish massa umattan hahalachot sheyyaase baanashim asher lahem hariv, lomar kefi ze yitchayyev peloni uchefi ze yihye lehefech, ella yaase iyyuno vetzidde hahalacha keillu en adam shetztzarich lehoraa zo atta, ella laamod al haddin ladaat hilchot hattora. veachar sheyyaamod alav bederech ze ma sheyyaale bimtzudato yadin bo levaale dinim, yezakke hazzakkay vichayyev hachayyav. vehu amro veshaftu et haam mishpat, perush kevar hu mishpat bifne atzmo, ze yihye tzedek. aval zulat ze, kesheyyaarich bedato beet shemmezakkek umetzaref haddin levaale dinim, al kol panim yihye echad yoter mitkarevet dato elav velo yetze hammishpat tzedek, uvifrat bemishpatim shetteluyim beshikkul haddaat uvehattaya muetet benakel yatte dato.

Uvederech remez yirmoz al derech amro (tehillim 96:13) "yishpot tevel betzedek", veamru anshe emet (Zohar 11 198.) ki bet din elyon yikkare tzedek, veamru zichronam livracha (betza 16.) ki berosh hashshana mezonotav shel adam kevuim vechulei, vehinne kesheyyippol hahefresh al hammamon ben adam lachavero veamdu lifne hashshofet, im yishpot al pi hattora asher tzivva Adonai kesheyyezakku harauy lezakkot vegomer, hinne hem shoftim hammishpat atzmo sheshshafat bet din elyon hannikra tzedek, vehu amro veshaftu et haam mishpat tzedek, perush sheshshafat bet din haelyon shennikra tzedek:

Ki tavo vegomer veamarta vegomer som tasim vegomer. meamro ki tavo vegomer veamarta, mashma ki lo mitzvat Adonai alehem limloch melech, ella im yomru harshut beyadam, umimma sheggamar omer som tasim, shiur hallashon mochiach shemmitzvat Adonai hi lehamelich alehem melech.

Venire shekkavvanat hakketuvim hi al ze hadderech, lefi sheyyesh beminnuy hammelech shene gedarim: echad sheyyihye hammivtach bo lehanehig hammilchamot beotzem chachmato velatzet kegibbor beyom kerav keseder malche haummot, veze hu davar sanouy beene Adonai, ki seder malche haummot lo yelchu bahem achare kishron hammaase ella achare toaliyyot hachushiyyot, hagam shello yimmatze bo davar tov mehammuskol, gam yasimu bo kislam vetikvatam umin Adonai yasur levavam. vegader sheni hu lichvod uletiferet yisrael uchede she yaase bizchuto kederech shehaya Adonai moshia yisrael beyad hashshoftim uveyad malche yisrael hakkesherim, vetze ulemad middavid hammelech vechulei, vedavar ze hu chen vesechel tov beene elohim veadam.

Velaze ba devaro hattov kan veamar ki tavo vegomer veamarta asima alay melech kechol haggoyim vegomer, veze gader harishon shezzacharnu, vegamar omer som tasim vegomer, perush, lo yakum haddavar hara hazze, ella hammesimot shettasim hu al ze hadderech asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo. veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (tosefta sanhedrin 83) veze leshonam: en maamidin melech battechilla ella al pi bet din shel shivim zekenim veal pi navi vechulei, ad kan. umelech hammitmanne beseder ze eno keseder melech hammitmanne al haggoyim kemo shebba bedivrehem "kechol haggoyim". uchefi ze maamar som tasim hi mitzva ushelilat gader shekkeneged tenaeha. velaze nitchakkem Adonai lehakedim maamar veamarta asima vegomer lehaircha et asher yechavven elav, lishlol oto bemaamar "som tasim" vegomer, shezzulat ze lo hayiti mevin sheoser lasum melech kechol haggoyim, vahagam sheyyomar "asher yivchar", en muvan shebba leesor kechol haggoyim veyihye ze vaze, velo chash lehavin bemaamar "som tasim" shehu reshut mikkefel "som tasim".

Vetimtza she hikpid al yisrael kesheshshaalu bime shemuel latet lahem melech (Shmuel 1 8:5), vehainyan kashe, lamma yakpid Adonai alehem, vahalo lu yihye shekkavvanat Adonai befasuk ze lirshut velo lemitzva, sof sof harshut netuna. uchefi ma shekkatavnu yesh makom laAdonai lehakepid al haddavar, kevan shetztzivva Adonai alehem leval yomru lasum melech kechol haggoyim kemo shepperashnu, veshaalu hammelech veamru (Shmuel 1 8:5) "leshaftenu kechol haggoyim", laze hikpid Adonai. aval im hayu shoalim lahem melech kirtzono yitbarach, lo lechoach veligvura kederech haggoyim, hayu mekayyemin mitzvat ase.

Veraiti besanhedrin perek kohen gadol (sanhedrin 20.) shennechleku rabbotenu zichronam livracha, veze leshono: rabbi yehuda omer shalosh mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bichnisatan laaretz – lehaamid lahem melech, ulehachrit zaro shel amalek, velivnot bet habbechira. rabbi nehoray omer: lo neemra parasha zo ella keneged taromtan, shenneemar "veamarta asima alay melech" vegomer, ad kan. udevarenu olin ledivre rabbi yehuda velo ledivre rabbi nehoray, vahagam shehalacha kerabbi yehuda vechen pasak rambam beferek 1 mehilchot melachim, af al pi chen tzarich leyashshev hakkatuv lisvarat rabbi nehoray sheppeshat amro "som tasim" yaggid shemmitzvat Adonai lasum melech.

Veefshar lomar, ki im yisrael yihyu kesherim velo yishalu melech, vehaya Adonai lemelech alehem, kederech amro (Shmuel 1 12,13) "vaAdonai elohechem malkechem", gam Adonai yachpotz lihyot melech yisrael hu levaddo. aval im yisrael yikkansu begeder sheela shechafetzim bemelech alehem, az mitzvat hammelech alehem laasoto, keamro "som tasim". velaze lo amar hakkatuv som tasim ella achar maamar veamarta asima vegomer, uchefi ze afillu alibba derabbi nehoray yefaresh som tasim mitzva achar sheyyomru "asima" vegomer:

rashi: Mikkirbecha meachecha kamoni. kemo sheani mikkirbecha meachecha, yakim lecha tachtay, vechen minnavi lenavi:
Chinnam nimkartem. al iske chinnam, hu yetzer hara sheeno lachem lesachar:
Velo vechesef tiggaelu. ella bitshuva (yerushalmi taanit 1 1):
targum: Are chidnan amar Adonai magan izdabbintun vela vichsaf titparkun:

rashi: Ullefu. leshon 'ayefut, kemo (Amos 8:13) "titallafna habbetulot batztzama", 630 109:
Keto michmar. hefker keto ze shennafal lmichmar. to kemo "uteo vazamer" (Devarim 14:5):
targum: Benayich yehon mitarfin raman beresh kol shukaya kemizrake metzadan melan chemta min kodam Adonai mezofita min kodam elahayich:

rashi: Ki yippale. kol hafelaa leshon havedala uferisha, shehaddavar nivdal umechusse mimmecha:
Ben dam ledam. ben dam tame ledam tahor (nidda 19):
Ben din ledin. ben din zakkay ledin chayyav:
Ben nega lanega. ben nega tame lenega tahor:
Divre rivot. sheyyihyu chachme hair cholkim baddavar, ze metamme veze metaher, ze mechayyev veze mezakke:
Vekamta vealita. melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoah mikkol hammekomot (sifre; sanhedrin 87):
ohc: Ki yippale vegomer lammishpat. hutzrach lomar "lammishpat", lehair shello neemru dinim ellu ella bemore shehu rauy lehorot mishpat, vechen amru bammishna (sanhedrin 86.) talmid sheeno rauy lehoraa patur. ella sheraiti babberayta (sanhedrin paz.) sheddarshu pittur talmid sheeno rauy lehoraa meamro "ki yippale" – bemufla shebbevet din, vechatvu Rashi vetosafot behannechnakin sheppershu mufla – mumche ulemaute talmid, veharambam peresh (hilchot mamrim 83 10) shehakkavvana hu mi shello yippale mimmennu ella davar mufla. umeatta lefi ze amro lammishpat lomar sheen haddin haamur bezaken ze ella behoraa lemaase, uchemo sheamru bammishna sham veze leshonam: eno chayyav ad sheyyore laasot, shenneemar "vehaish asher yaase vezadon", ad kan. vehinne mippasuk ze en hochacha ella al maasehu al pi horaato, velo im hora laacherim laasot, ulemedin lah meamro "lammishpat" sheim hora laacherim chayyav.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: ki yippale vegomer lammishpat, hagam shehaya halacha lemaase vehora laasot hefech kavvanat hacholkim, venimtza haddin lo chen hu, af al pi shehora bedavar shechayyav al zedono karet vechulei, lo yumat. perush, hagam shehora laasot hefech harabbim hacholkim alav, lo yumat ad sheyyore laasot hefech asher yaggidu alav bet din haggadol shebbelishkat haggazit, vechen mochichim haddevarim besanhedrin (sanhedrin pach:).

rashi: Pen yirdof goel haddam. lechach ani omer lehachin lecha derech veare miklat rabbim:
Veyasafta lecha od shalosh. hare tesha, shalosh shebbeever hayyarden veshalosh shebbeeretz kenaan veshalosh leatid lavo (sifre):
Behishshafto. lefanecha yetze middincha mechuyyav vrasha:
targum: Beidayneh yippok chayav utzeloteh tehe lechovta:

rashi: Velo yarbe lo nashim. ella 18, shemmatzinu shehayu lo ledavid shesh nashim, veneemar lo (Shmuel 2 12:8) "veim meat veosifa lecha kahenna vechahenna":
Vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo meod. ella kede litten leachsanya (sifre; sanhedrin 21):
Ki Adonai elohechem vegomer. hem baim benitzchono shel basar vadam veattem baim benitzchono shel makom. pelishtim bau venitzchono shel galyat, me haya sofo? nafal venaflu immo:
Haholech immachem. ze machane haaron (sota 42):
ohc: Lehillachem vegomer lehoshia vegomer. perush lehillachem vegomer – leabbed oyvechem, veamro lehoshia vegomer perush shello yamut mibbene yisrael echad bammilchama, veze hu ikar hannes shettihye hammilchama keveda beoyvehem velo yippaked echad mibbene yisrael. veulay ki laze nitkavven bema sheamar bitchillat hakkatuv Adonai elohechem, hizkir harachamim vehaddin: rachamim lehoshia yisrael, din leabbed oyvehem. vezulat ze haya day beamro "ki elohechem holech".

Kechol asher shaalta vegomer. ulay shebba lomar shehem garmu leatzmam sheen kullam neviim, kemo sheamru beyom hakkahal "kerav atta ushama", ufachadu mitztzaar hannisbav mehannevua. laze gam Adonai yitten lahem navi, vehatztzarich ledabber elav yavo veyaggidennu, uletaam ze amar hakkatuv kol haamur bainyan.

rashi: Mitzrayim yarad ammi vegomer. hem hammitzriyyim hayu lahem ketzat chov alehem, shennaasu lahem achsanya vechilkelum, aval ashshur befes uvechinnam ashako:
targum: Are chidnan amar Adonai elohim lemitzrayim nechat ami vekadmeta leittotava taman veatturaa bilma anseh:

rashi: Laamod lesharet. mikkan sheen sherut ella meomed (sifre; sota 38):
Divre hattora. kemashmao:

Vechi tomar bilvavecha. atidin attem lomar kesheyyavo chananya ben azzur umitnabbe "hinne chele vet Adonai mushavim mibbavela atta mehera" (Yirmeyahu 27), veyirmeyahu omed vetzoveach "el haammudim veal hayyam veal yeter hakkelim" shello galu im yechanya, "bavela yuvau" im galut tzidkiyyahu (sham):
Veim lo tashlim immach veasta immach milchama. hakkatuv mevassercha sheim lo tashlim immecha sofah lehillachem becha im tannichenna vetelech (sham):
Vetzarta aleha. af lehareivah ulehatzmiah velahamitah mitat tachaluim (sham):
Yadenu lo shafcha. vechi alta al lev shezzikne vet din shofche damim hem? ella lo reinuhu ufetarnuhu belo mezonot uvelo levaya (sota 45). hakkohanim omrim kofer leammecha yisrael:
Vehaya cheshivto. im asa chen keday hu shettitkayyem malchuto (sifre):
Et mishne hattora. shete sifre tora, achat shehi munnachat bevet genazav, veachat shennichneset veyotzet immo (sanhedrin 21); veunkelos tirgem "patshegen", patar mishne leshon shinnun vedibbur:
Velo. velarasha hechin hakkadosh baruch hu kele mavet:

Ledolkim. lerodfim, kemo "ki dalakta acharay" (Bereshit 31:36). vechen perusho: chitztzav laharog et harshaim haddolkim et hatztzaddikim yifal hakkadosh baruch hu veyazminem lahamitam. kol delika leshon redifa hi:
targum: Umetuleteh taken zeyane mota giroy ledalke tzadikaya yabed:

rashi: Pen yamut bammilchama. yashuv pen yamut, sheim lo yishma ledivre hakkohen keday hu sheyyamut (sifre):

Vechi yihye ish sone lereehu. al yede sinato hu va lide vearav lo, mikkan amru avar adam al mitzva kalla, sofo laavor al mitzva chamura, lefi sheavar al lo tisna (Vayikra 19), sofo lavo lide shefichut damim, lechach neemar "vechi yihye ish sone lereehu vegomer", shehaya lo lichtov vechi yakum ish vearav lereehu vehikkahu nafesh (sifre):
ohc: Vechi yihye ish sone vegomer. parasha zo romezet ma sheamru baggemara makkot daf 12: shalosh tauyyot atid saro shel edom litot leatid lavo, veechad mehem hu sheare miklat koltot hahoreg beshogeg vehu mezid. veyadua ki saro shel edom hu 100 hu satan (bava batra 16.) hu yetzer hara, vealav heid hakkatuv kan. veamar ki yihye ish sone ki en sone laadam keyitzro hara vehu mekor hassina. lereehu ki hu mare reut lakkol ki letovatam meyaatzam, vehu sone lo umevakkesh raato bederech ahava vereut. vearav sheorev lo lehachetio, ki yesh lecha ladaat sheavera rishona sheose haadam eno ose ella kishgaga, uvaze motze shaar hatztzar likkanes lannefesh, gam makdim lehaadam, keamro (Bereshit 4:7) "lappetach chattat rovetz" kodem bo hammenaggedo baadam, gam masbir lo panim al maase hara veyomar lara tov, veen lecha orev gadol mizze, uvaze mitgabber alav, vehu amro vekam alav, ma sheen ken kodem lachen shehaya kechut hassaara helech betoch haadam (socha nov:) veal yede hachet yitgabber veyakum alav.

Vehikkahu nefesh. kan heir shehu medabber al 100, velaze amar "vehikkahu nefesh", perush shechovel benafsho, ki al yede hachet tamut hannefesh. venas el achat – perush im yanus el achat hearim hael levatztzer atzmah shehi meare hammiklat – veshalchu zikne iro – hem bet din shel mala shehi ir shel hassar shel edom, velakchu oto – veal pi hammishpat yittenuhu beyad goel haddam, hu avinu shebbashshamayim.

Veamro vamet – kan ramaz sod amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin lach:) moshit etzbao bahem userafam, vehu amro beyad goel haddam vamet – perush bingiat yad Adonai bo baze hu met meatzmo. ulefi sheamru zichronam livracha ki harigat 100 tihye gam ken al yede yisrael, sheyyadam tihye bo lahamito im Adonai baruch hu, laze amar lo tachos alav, vahagam shehatztzaddikim hirvichu beemtzauto, yesh lahem lehabbit el dam naki kamma damim rabbim sheshshafach bearvo, veaz vetov lach tihye nechletet bechinat hattov lach, ki behibbatel ruach hattuma tihye nishlemet bechinat hattov bimkomah, shehem bene yisrael.

rashi: Asher lo tzivviti. leavdam (Megila 9):

Kaasher shammu. kaasher tamhu alehem ammim rabbim birotam shiflutam, veamru ze el ze: kamma mishchat meish marehu (shel yisrael), reu ma tooram chashuch mishshear bene adam, ken kaasher anachnu roim beenenu:
targum: Kema disvaru leh bet yisrael yomin sagiin dahava chashich bene ammaya chezvehon vezivhon mibbene enasha:

rashi: Al devar emet. lehorot kaddat, ulehitnaheg beanvat tzedek:

Vetorcha. hattora udevar haemet shettaasok bo, hi tore otcha tachsise hammilchama laasot yeminecha noraot. lefi shehizkir talmud tora bilshon milchama, nofel bo leshon yamin hameyummenet lehillachem, (kelomar hesder lehillachem beyad yamin):
targum: Veshivhorach sagi begin ken titzlach lemirkav al suse malchuta al esak hemnuta ukeshot veinvetanuta vetzidketa veyalfinach Adonai lemebad dechilan beyad yeminach:

rashi: Vechover chaver. shemmetzaref nechashim o akrabbim o shear chayyot lemakom echad:
Veshoel ov. ze mechashshefut sheshshemo pitom umedabber mishshichyo umaale et hammet bevet hashshechi shello:
Veyiddeoni. machnis etzem chayya sheshshemah yaddua letoch piv umedabber haetzem al yede mechashshefut (sham):
Vedoresh el hammetim. kegon hammaale vezachruto vehannishal begulgolet (sham):
Yariv ammo. asher yadin din ammo:
targum: Kidnan amar ribbonich Adonai velahayich daatid lemebad pureanut din ame ha kabbelit min yedich yat kasa dilvata yat payle chasa dechemti la tosifin lemishtah od:

rashi: Tachin lecha hadderech. "miklat", "miklat" haya chatuv al parashat derachim (makkot 10):

Veshillashta et gevul artzecha. sheyyehe mittechillat haggevul ad hair harishona shel are miklat keshiur mahalach sheyyesh mimmenna ad hashsheniyya vechen mishsheniyya lashshelishit vechen min hashshelishit ad haggevul hashsheni shel eretz yisrael (sham 9):

Sare tzevaot. shemmaamidin zakkafin millifnehem umilleacharehem vechashshilin shel barzel bidehem vechol mi sherotze lachazor harshut beyado lekappeach et shokav; zakkafin – bene adam omdin biktze hammaaracha lizkof et hannoflim ulechazzekam bidvarim, shuvu el hammilchama velo tanusu, shettechillat nefila nisa (sifre; sota 44):
Veyatzu zekenecha. meyuchadim shebbizkenecha, ellu sanhedre gedola (sota 44):
Umaddu. mimmakom shehechalal shochev:
El hearim asher sevivot hechalal. lechol tzad vetzad leda e zo kerova:

Lo yarbe lo susim. ella kede merkavto, shello yashiv et haam mitzrayma, shehassusim baim mishsham, kema shenneemar bishlomo (Melachim 1 10) vattaale vattetze merkava mimmitzrayim beshesh meot kesef vesus bachamishshim umea (sanhedrin 21):
Shetayim henna korotayich. tzarot kefulot, shetayim shetayim:
Mi anachamech. mi avi lach lenachamech velomar: af umma pelonit hi lakta dugmatech?
targum: Tarten akan ataa alach yerushelem la yechelet lemekam kad arba yetun alach biza utevara vechafna vecharba let di menachamech elahen ana:

rashi: Venikkapper lahem haddam. hakkatuv mevasseram, shemmishsheasu chen yechuppar lahem heavon (sham):
Tachat ahavati otcha yistenuni:
Vaani tefilla. vaani mitpallel elecha tamid (matzati):
targum: Chalaf di rechimet setanu li vaana atzale:

rashi: Lo tassig gevul. leshon "nasogu achor" (Yeshayahu 42), shemmachazir siman chalukkat hakkarka leachor letoch sede chavero lemaan harechiv et shello; vahalo chevar neemar "lo tigzol" (Vayikra 19), ma talmud lomar lo tassig? limmed al haoker techum chavero sheover bishne lavin. yachol af bechutz laaretz? talo benachalatcha asher tinchal vegomer, beeretz yisrael over bishne lavin, uvechutza laaretz eno over ella mishshum lo tigzol (sifre):

Shenayim edim o shelosha. im mitkayyemet edut bishnayim lamma peret lecha vishlosha? lehakkish shelosha lishnayim, ma shenayim edut achat af shelosha edut achat, veen naasin zommin ad sheyyizzommu chullam (makkot Adonai):
ohc: Yumat hammet. kafal lomar hammet, lehair ki im lo nimtzeu lo edim vehateraa – ben mavet hu lashshamayim, ella shebbeedim vehateraa yumat bide adam hammet shehaya omed lemita bide shamayim.

rashi: Lo tilmad laasot. aval atta lamed lehavin ulehorot, kelomar lehavin maasehem kamma hem mekulkalim, ulehorot levanecha lo taase chach vechach, shezze hu chok haggoyim (sifre; sanhedrin 68):
Ed echad. ze vana av – kol ed shebbattora shenayim ella im ken peret lecha vo echad (sanhedrin 30):

Lechol avon ulechol chattat. lihyot chavero neenash al eduto, lo onesh guf velo onesh mamon, aval kam hu lishvua; amar lachavero ten li mane shehilviticha, amar lo en lecha veyadi kelum veed echad meido sheyyesh lo, chayyav lishshava lo (shavuot 40):
Al pi shene edim. velo sheyyichtevu edutam beiggeret veyishlechu levet din, velo sheyyaamod turgeman ben haedim uven haddayyanim (sifre):
Lo tachos encha. shello tomar harishon kevar neherag, lamma anu horgim et ze venimtzeu shene yisreelim harugim? (sham):
Kaasher zamam. velo chaasher asa, mikkan amru hargu en neheragin (makkot Adonai):

Laasot leachiv. ma talmud lomar leachiv? limmed al zomme vat kohen nesua sheenan bisrefa ella kemitat habboel shehi vechenek, shenneemar (Vayikra 21) "hi vaesh tissaref" – hi velo voalah, lechach neemar kan leachiv, kaasher zamam laasot leachiv, velo kaasher zamam laasot laachoto, aval bechol shear mitot hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish vezomme ishsha neheragin kezomme ish, kegon sheheiduha sheharga et hannefesh, shechillela et hashshabbat, neheragin bemitatah, shello miet kan achoto ella vemakom sheyyesh lekayyem bahen hazamma kemitat habboel (sifre; sanhedrin 90):
ohc: Vaasitem lo kaasher zamam. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (makkot 5.) mikkan: hargu en neheragim, "kaasher zamam" velo kaasher asa. vekashe, dilma amar hakkatuv "kaasher zamam" lehitchayyev afillu lo asa, ella meet asher ana sara vezamam laasot raa leachiv nitchayyev, ucheshennaasa maase al yado veneherag yesh kan zamam veasa, vekore ani bo gam ken zamam venosaf sheasa, veen kan taanat en onshin min haddin?

Achen ikkar hadderasha hi mimma shehaya lo lomar "kaasher ana al achiv", vechozer lema sheamar "sheker ana beachiv" – yaasu lo kaasher ana. uvemaamar ze yeshno lechiyyuv ben neherag ben lo neherag, shenehem nichlalim bemashmaut asher ana. uma shello amar lashon hakkolel vehalach levakkesh lashon ze "asher zamam" – lediyyuk ba, lomar davka zamam velo asa kedivrehem zichronam livracha. veze leshonam babbarayta (makkot 5:): amar lo aviv, "lav kal vachomer hu?" amar lo, "limmadtanu rabbenu en onshin min haddin" vechulei. en lehakeshot mizze ledivrehem, ki belo taam "en onshin min haddin" haya hakkal vachomer machriach lomar shello ba hakkatuv lefatran im hargu, shehare kal vachomer haddevarim veen koach baddiyyuk lidchot hakkal vachomer, uleokme kera shello bediyyuk, im lo mittaam sheddacha rabbi "en onshin min haddin".

rashi: Kol ose elle. ose kol elle lo neemar, ella chol ose elle, afillu achat mehen (sifre):
Lo chen natan lecha Adonai elohecha. lishmoa el meonnim veel kosmim, shehare hishra shechina al hanneviim veurim vetummim:
ohc: Ki haggoyim vegomer yishmau. perush, yesh lahem lishmoa ulekabbel et asher yaggidu lahem hammeonnim, ki yodium hammeonnim ma sherashum bammazzal, veatta lo chen perush, lo tehe hodaat haatidot lecha ken, ella "navi akim" vegomer:

O yirmoz al ze hadderech: "lo chen" vegomer, perush encha bematztzav ze kemotam, ella netanam lecha Adonai elohecha tachat memshaltecha kol hammazzalot vechol tzeva hashshamayim, keamro (tehillim 8:7) "kol shatta tachat raglav", uchemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (shabbat kanu:) befasuk "tzedek yikraehu leraglo" (Yeshayahu 41:2).

Veamro navi akim vegomer, ba lehashiv: sof kol sof kefi ze yihyu haggoyim behaderaga gedola sheyyedu haatidot, ma sheen ken yisrael. laze amar "navi akim" vegomer. veulay shekken hevin shaul kesheshshaal bevaalat ov (Shmuel 1 28:8), ki lo asar Adonai lishol ov o yiddeoni ella bemakom sheyyakim navi, aval zulat ze im yitztarchu ladaat shaol yishalu bahem.

rashi: Kekarovchem el hammilchama. samuch letzetchem min hassefar – miggevul artzechem:
Veniggash hakkohen. hammashuach lechach, vehu hannikra "meshuach milchama":
Vedibber el haam. bilshon hakkodesh (sota 42):

Veyasfu hashshotrim. lamma neemar kan veyasfu? mosifin ze al divre hakkohen, shehakkohen medabber umashmia min shema yisrael ad lehoshia etchem, umi haish vesheni ushelishi kohen medabber veshoter mashmia, veze shoter medabber veshoter mashmia (sota 43):

Hayyare verach hallevav. rabbi akiva omer kemashmao, sheeno yachol laamod bekishre hammilchama velirot cherev shelufa; rabbi yose haggelili omer hayyare meaverot shebbeyado, ulechach talta lo tora lachazor al bayit vecherem veishsha, lechassot al hachozrim bishvil averot shebbeyadam shello yavinu shehem baale avera, veharoehu chozer omer shemma bana vayit o nata kerem o eras ishsha (sota 44):
ohc: Mi haish hayyare vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sota 44.) ze hayyare meaverot shebbeyado, perush al derech amro (yeshaya 33:14) "pachadu vetziyyon chattaim", shekkol mi sheyyesh beyado averot libbo yare vechared meatzmo, vaafillu eno yodea sheyyesh beyado averot happachad hannichnas bilvavo bammilchama todiehu ki yesh beyado averot. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (orach chayyim siman ned beshem hayerushalmi) shiaru heavon sheyyikkanes belibbo happachad miyyotzro sheafillu en beyado ella sheddibber ben yishtabbach leyotzer, vehattaam ki hannichnas lammilchama tzarich laasot lo nes lehinnatzel mecherev oyev, vechol shebbeyado mibbechinat hara eno rauy lenes umazzalo yafchido.

rashi: Asher lo tzivvitiv ledabber. aval tzivvitiv lachavero:
Vaasher yedabber beshem elohim acherim. afillu chivven et hahalacha leesor et haasur ulehattir et hammuttar (sanhedrin 89):

Umet. bechenek. 3 mitatan bide adam – hammitnabbe ma shello shama, uma shello neemar lo veneemar lachavero, vehammitnabbe beshem aza. aval hakkovesh et nevuato vehaover al divre navi vehaover al divre atzmo – mitatan bide shamayim, shenneemar (pasuk 19) anochi edrosh meimmo (sanhedrin 89):
ohc: Ach hannavi asher yazid vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1 amro ach, gam amro asher yazid velo hispik lomar "asher yedabber" vegomer, 2 amro vechi tomar bilvavcha vegomer asher yedabber vegomer velo yihye haddavar vegomer, peshita sheim lo yihye ma shetztzivva shello dibber Adonai haddavar hahu, 3 amro asher yedabber beshem Adonai lamma bappasuk shellefanav amar "bishmi" uvefasuk ze amar "beshem Adonai", 4 amro hu haddavar shello haya lo lomar ella "lo dibbero Adonai" vaani yodea shechozer laddavar hahu.

Achen yitbaer hainyan al pi ma sheamar hannavi bemaase yehoshafat veachav bemilchemet ramot gilad (Melachim 1 22), shekkol hanneviim pe echad dibberu leachav "ale vehatzelach", umiddivre michayhu ben yimla nitgalla haddevarim sheruach yatza millifne Adonai lefattot achav laalot velippol bammilchama. uvechiddushay al divre neviim dikdakti lamma battechilla avar al michayhu ruach navot venitnabbe kanneviim harishonim veamar "ale vehatzelach", veachar kach binvua acharona dibber nevuat Adonai velo hoil lefanav ruach navot. veal haruach gam ken tameah ani, ech lo kiyyem shelichuto asher yatza laasot. od kashe lemichayhu lamma bittel atzat Adonai chas veshalom umachshevotav shechashav lehappil achav bemilchemet ramot gilad, vehu ba vegilla sodo leachav atzmo.

Achen hen henna haddevarim asher heir Adonai benoam devarav, lefi shehakkol galuy vetzafuy lifne habbore ki yavo zeman shettetze ruach millefanav vetate hanneviim, vahagam sheshsheker dibberu, im kol ze anusim hem. laze keshebba letzauot onesh hannavi hikdim veamar ach hannavi, "ach" miet navi kayyotze baze sheyyedabber davar velo yakum velo yamut. vedikdek lomar asher yazid lahaircha shello yamut ella navi asher yazid ledabber vegomer, lomar aval navi sheddibber sheker velo hezid, uchegon shehitahu ruach navot, shezze en alav ashmat davar ki haruach behasekamat Adonai yatza vehammitnabbeim mitztziddo nekiyyim hem meheavon. vahagam shebbesanhedrin (sanhedrin 89.) amru shetztzidkiyyahu ben kenaana chayyav hagam sheruach navot hitahu, hu mittaam sheamru sham dahava leh lemedan en shene neviim mitnabbeim besignon echad, aval zulat ze patur haya. vahagam shearba meot neviim amru chen vegam michayhu ben yimla gam ken amar "ale vehatzelach" vegomer, im kol ze kullam patchu fihem lehitnabbeot veharuach dibbera befihem, ucheshehirgishu shennibbeu besignon echad lo hosifu ledabber od baddavar hazze, ma sheen ken tzidkiyyahu. veal ze yomar "asher yazid vegomer umet" vegomer:

Umeatta kan habben shoel bamme neda haddavar vegomer, veim mimma shello yihye haddavar chayshinan leruach navot hammata vechayyotze bah, velamma yumat haish hannavi kevan sheharuach sheyyatza bidvar Adonai hitattu? vechayyotze baddavar im bemaase ramot lo haya ba michayhu vegilla hassod, hayu mitchayyevim mita kol arba meot neviim al lo chamas asu, vaAdonai ohev mishpat. vehu amro vechi tomar vegomer echa neda haddavar asher lo dibbero Adonai, kan kalal devar Adonai lenavi vechalal gam ken devar Adonai laruach "tze vaase chen".

Veamar asher yedabber hannavi vegomer, perush, im hannavi yomar nevuato beshem Adonai – vehu ma sheddikdek lomar beshem Adonai velo yihye haddavar vegomer, az teda ki bezadon dibbero hannavi, perush, velo ba devaro mitztzad ruach shehitattu. vehattaam ki lo yanuach ruach sheker beshem Adonai hannichbad ki Adonai elohim emet. vehu amro hu haddavar asher lo dibbero Adonai, perush, hu sheani omer lecha alav shello dibbero Adonai, vegam lo ba beruach ella bezadon, vehu amro bezadon dibbero hannavi. aval yesh davar acher shehagam shehu sheker veen hattora yechola lomar lecha "lo dibbero Adonai bezadon dibbero hannavi", vehu keshello yedabber hannavi beshem Adonai, shehagam sheyyihye sheker yesh lachush leruach keruach navot.

Uvaze yeerav lenefesh adam inyan michayhu, ki battechilla lo hizkir shem Adonai, velaze lo haya omer ella divre haruach, ad shennitchakkem yehoshafat veamar elav (divrei hayamim 2 18:15) "ani mashbiacha asher lo tedabber elay rak emet beshem Adonai", perush, nitchakkem lomar lo hattenay shehitna Adonai kan veamar asher yedabber hannavi beshem Adonai, lefi ma shepperashnu sheyyedabber beshem Adonai, uvaze im yesh ruach mata tefanne makom. vechen haya keshehizkir elav shem Adonai, veamar hannavi beshem Adonai, barach lo navot veamar hannavi haemet bema shehu. uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim sheddikdaknu beinyan nevuat ramot gilad, vahagam shello matzinu shehizkir michayhu shem Adonai, hizkiro umikra katzar hu, kevan shehizkiro yehoshafat vechivven michayhu lashshem shehizkir yehoshafat hoil. velo tikshe meamro sham kamma peamim "ani mashbiacha vegomer beshem Adonai" sheyerae shehishbio kamma peamim ledabber beshem Adonai, ki ulay shello hirgish michayhu bedikduk ze shel yehoshafat ella befaam acharona:

O efshar ki maamar "beshem Adonai" eno nismach lemaamar "ani mashbiacha", ella maamar bifne atzmo shechiddesh baacharona. ulefi ze lo kashe lamma gilla michayhu sod Adonai, ki yecharev haolam velo yishtanne mekor haemet leyached shemo al devar sheker chas veshalom, uma gam ki al kol panim asa haruach peullato ki lo heemin elav achav veala venafal, venimtzet machshevet Adonai kayyemet velo mityaches hashsheker leshem Adonai elohim emet.

rashi: Vehotzeta et haish hahu el shearecha vegomer. hametargem el shearecha "litra bet dinach" toe, shekken shaninu "el shearecha" — ze shaar sheavad bo, o eno ella shaar shenniddon bo? neemar "shearecha" lematta veneemar "shearecha" lemala, ma shearecha haamur lemala shaar sheavad bo, af shearecha haamur lematta shaar sheavad bo, vetargumo "lekirvaych":
Chasaf. gilla:
targum: Gale Adonai yat dera kudeshe leene kol ammaya veyechezun kol devisyafe ara yat purekana deelahana:

rashi: Tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha. hithallech immo vitmimut, utetzappe lo, velo tachakor achar haatidot, ella kol ma sheyyavo alecha kabbel bitmimut veaz tihye immo ulechelko:
ohc: Tamim tihye im Adonai. perush, lefi shetztzivva alav besamuch leval yeonen vichashshef uleval yishal baov vegomer, amar tamim vegomer, perush kelomar taam kol haddevarim hu ladaat haatidot ulehitnaheg al asher yoru uletakken hachissaron kaasher yuchal asot. im tihye im Adonai tamim tihye, lo yechsar lecha davar veen ma sheyyaggid hammazzal alecha titkayyem leraa. veze lecha haot – avraham shehithallech lifne Adonai, hagam shehera hammazzal alav shello yolid, nithappech veyalad (shabbat kanu:). uchefi ze tevat tihye nimshechet lemala ulematta al ze hadderech: tamim tihye im tihye im Adonai, o al ze hadderech: tamim tihye kesheatta im elohecha.

rashi: Laanot bo sara. davar sheeno, shehusar haed hazze mikkol haedut hazzot. ketzad? sheamru lahem vahalo immanu heyitem oto hayyom bemakom peloni (makkot Adonai):
Ulevilti sur min hammitzva. afillu mitzva kalla shel navi:

Lemaan yaarich yamim. mikkelal hen atta shomea lav; vechen matzinu veshaul sheamar lo shemuel (Shmuel 1 10) "shivat yamim tochel ad boi elecha", lehaalot olot, uchetiv (sham 13) "vayyochel shivat yamim", velo shamar havetachato lishmor kol hayyom, velo hispik lehaalot haola ad shebba shemuel veamar lo "niskalta lo shamarta vegomer veatta mamlachtecha lo takum", ha lamadta shebbishvil mitzva kalla shel navi neenash:
Hu uvanav. maggid sheim beno hagun lemalchut hu kodem lechol adam (horayot 11):
ohc: Levilti rum levavo. perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 6:1) "umalbashto anava veyira", vehu amro ki beemtzaut keriat hattora lo yarum levavo vegomer, ucheneged hayyira amar lifne ze "lemaan yilmad leyira".

rashi: Hakkohanim haleviyyim. hakkohanim sheyyatzu mishshevet levi:
Veel hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem. vaafillu eno kishar shoftim shehayu lefanav, atta tzarich lishmoa lo – en lecha ella shofet shebbeyamecha (rosh hashshana 25):
ohc: Vedarashta vehiggidu lecha. perush, alecha atta lidrosh sheyyomru lecha taam haddin, vehem gam ken chayyavim lehaggid lecha taam divrehem, aval im lo darash en chiyyuv alehem lehaggid lo.

targum: Etun neshabbach kodam Adonai neyabbev kodam takif purekana:
Vahava virushelem bet makdesheh umedor bet shechinat kudesheh vetzion:
Shuach chafar venamtzeh unefal beshuchata di avad:
Leshabbacha betushebachta tushebcha al yeda deasaf shira:
Itgela itgela livshi tukefech tzion livshi levushi tushebachtich yerushalami karta dekudesha are la yosfun veyedun bich od arlin umesaavin:
Yetuv leuteh beresheh veal mokdeh chatofeh yechot:
Asar aloy rashia vesitna yekum al yemineh:
Ma yaavan al ture ara deyisrael rigle mevaser mashma shelam mevaser tav mashma purekan amar lichnishta detzion itgeliat malchuta deelahayich:
Let dimnachem lah mikkol benin diledat velet dematkif bidah mikkol benin derabbiat:
Ityeda bidvet yehuda elaha bidvet yisrael rav shemeh:
Buu veshabbachu kachada charvat yerushelem are atid Adonai lenachma ame parik yerushelem:

bart: Vechullan enan metammeot bevet habbelia. af al pi shennifselu, melikatan metahartan mide nevela, veen metammein bevet habbelia kedin nivlat of tahor shehaochlah af al pi shello naga bah kegon shettechavah lo chavero bevet habbelia nitma tuma chamura letamme vegadim shealav, aval ellu af al pi sheen melikatan mattiratan baachila mippene happesul sheera bahen, mikkol makom metaharatan umotziatan mide nevela:
Umoalin bahen. hannehene mehen beshave feruta mevi karban meila kedin kol nehene min hahekdesh. vaafillu chattat, hoil venifsela velo haya vah sheat hetter lakkohanim, lo yatza mide meila:
Chutz mechattat haof sheasaah lematta kemaase chattat leshem chattat. dichshera hi veyesh bah sheat hetter lakkohanim, veshuv en bah meila afillu lezar:
Sheasu tzerachehen. hittilu me raglayim:

Rabbi yose metaher. deha afillu beishsha geredta delekka ella chada sefeka, safek ba min hammakor, safek ba mimmekom me raglayim, metaher rabbi yose leel, vechol shekken hacha dedilma meish ate. velo hadar tanna hacha rabbi yose metaher, ella leashmoinan mimmishna yeterta daafillu lechattechilla metaher rabbi yose leishsha sheosa tzeracheha veraata dam, shettitassek betohorot. delo tema davka diavad metaher rabbi yose tohorot shennitasseka bahen, aval lechattechilla lo amrinan la shettitassek, kamashma lan:
Verabbi shimon metamme. afillu hacha deikka sefek sefeka, kidkatane taama:
Shechezkat damim min haishsha. uleel paskinan halacha kerabbi yose dimtaher vaafillu bechad sefeka, kol shekken hacha deikka tarte:
Shehen shelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur. shekkevar hitannu shesh, vetaaniyyot dichidim enam min hamminyan:
Matriin. bashshofarot:
Bashsheni mattin. besheni shel taanit potchin dalte hachanuyyot ketzat leet erev, aval en motziin sechoratan lachutz:
Uvachamishi muttarim. liftoach kol hayyom:
Lo hifrisha. lo badka atzmah lehaferish betohora:
Uleachar yamim. leachar shettavla belel shemini:
Hare zo vechezkat tohora. bayyamim shebben tevilatah limtziat tuma. vetohoroteha shennaga bahen tehorot, deemur hasheta hu dachazat:
Umetammea meet leet. aresha kae, dekatane uleachar yamim badka umatza temea hare hi bechezkat tohora, aval metammea meet leet shel reiyya zo o mippekida lifkida:

Afillu vashsheniyya leniddatah. badka shacharit umatza tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, velivsof shiva tavla, uleachar yamim badka umatza temea, hare zo ad achshav bechezkat tohora. veshalosh machalokot baddavar, letanna kamma bedikat shacharit dishvii hu dimtahartah, aval sheni leniddatah, lo. ulerabbi yehuda afillu bedikat shacharit dishvii lo metaharah ad shettifrosh ben hashshemashot. ulerabbanan afillu bashsheni, dechevan defasak pasak. vedavka bashsheni hu dimtahari rabbanan, aval barishon matza tahor veshuv lo badka, vetavla belel shemini, veasta tohorot, veachar kach matza tame, lo metahari rabbanan, lefi shebbeyom rishon huchzeka mayan patuach. umishshum hachi katane vaafillu bashsheniyya leniddatah davka, aval rishon lo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Seder taaniyyot ketzad. besheva taaniyyot acharonot ka mayre:

Et hatteva. haaron shessefer tora munnach bo, kelomar keli tzanua haya lanu venitbazza baavonenu. velamma lirchovah shel ir, lomar, tzaaknu betzina bevet hakkeneset velo naanenu, nevazze atzmenu befarhesya birchovah shel ir:
Efer mikle. efer serefa. umishshum deafar nammi ikkere efer tana efer mikle, dehacha tzarich sheyyihye efer mammash kede sheyyizkor hakkadosh baruch hu akedato shel yitzchak virachem:
Al gabbe hatteva. mishshum dichtiv (yeshaya 63) bechol tzaratam lo tzar:
Uverosh hannasi vechulei. vehen atzman enam notlim, kede sheyyitbayyeshu yoter, lefi sheeno dome mitbayyesh meatzmo lammitbayyesh meacherim:
Divre chibbushim. devarim shekkovshin libbo shel adam lehachaziro lemutav:
Uvakkabbala. bedivre hanneviim:
En shoalin et haggeshamim. hayenu en mazkirin et haggeshamim:

Ella samuch laggeshamim. dehaynu yom shemini shel chag, demin hechag veelach zeman geshamim hu. usetama kerabbi yehoshua. perush acher, rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua diflige leel behazekarat geshamim, modim hem leinyan sheela dehaynu lomar veten tal umatar, sheen shoalin otan ella samuch laggeshem, dehaynu bishlishi bemarcheshvan o vashshevii bo, kedimfarshe tannae lekamman bematnitin:
Haacharon. hammitpallel tefillat musaf mazkir morid haggeshem:

Veharishon. hammitpallel tefillat shacharit eno mazkir geshem ella tal. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. veha ditnan besamuch rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaavor happesach, vehacha kaamar rabbi yehuda beyom tov harishon shel pesach haacharon eno mazkir, tere tannae ninhu veallibba derabbi yehuda:
Parim hannisrafim. par helem ufar kohen mashiach, sheen neechalim lakkohanim ella nisrafim chutz lirushalayim:
Useirim hannisrafim. seire avoda zara. shehukkeshu lefar helem lechol divrehem:
Hazzaya al happarochet. sheva hazzayot al happarochet. aval ben habbaddim lo chetiv behu hazzaya kemo befar shel yom hakkippurim dichtiv beh (sham) vehizza beetzbao al pene hakkapporet:
Ellu vaellu. shel yom hakkippurim ushear hannisrafim:

Nisrafim bevet haddashen. limkom shemmotziim sham et haddeshen shel mizbeach hachitzon, dichtiv beh (sham 6) vehotzi et haddeshen el michutz lammachane. uvefarim hannisrafim ketiv (sham 4) el shefech haddeshen yissaref:

Kadshe kadashim. keillu nishchatu vatztzafon. dichtiv (sham 20) vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha, kullo kasher leola vechullo kasher lishlamim, veaf al gav deola teuna tzafon veen shelamim teunim tzafon:

Mechatzi hammizbeach velatztzafon katztzafon. demashma leh chetzyo leolotecha vechetzyo lishlamecha. dei salka datach kullo leola kasher, hasheta kullo leola amart dechasher, kullo lishlamim sheshshechitatan bechol makom mibbaya. veidach, itzterich, salka datach amena ola dedachek lah makom, shello huchsheru lah shear haruchot, ufeamim shehaolot merubbot vetzar lahem hammakom, lefichach hichshir lahem rosh hammizbeach, aval shelamim delo dachek lehu hammakom lo hichshir lahem rosh hammizbeach, ka mashma lan. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hayu nikmatzot bechol makom. veenam teunot tzafon. delo kava hakkatuv makom likmitza:
Lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna. dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) lechol karbanam ulechol minchatam, usemich leh bekodesh hakkodashim tochalennu kol zachar yochal oto:
Leyom valayla ad chatzot. deyalfinan mimminchat lachme toda:
Vetolot zo vazo. sheim hayta haachat meubberet, tola haddam besheenah meubberet, vehi tehora:
Veim lo hayu reuyot. kegon shehayu kullan meubbarot o kullan menikot, kullan temeot keillu reuyot lirot, demikkol makom dam mibbenayhu nefak:

Im chissar achat mikkol hammattanot lo chipper. divfar helem davar ketiv (Vayikra 4) veasa lappar kaasher asa lefar hachattat ken yaase lo, umikra sheen tzarich hu, shehare kol avodotav nitparshu vo, ella lichpol beazharat hazzaot shebbo hu deata. vehachi mashma, veasa lo chaasher katavti lecha asiyyotav, veshana alehem leakkev sheim chissar achat min hammattanot lo chipper:
Lefichach. hoil vechullan mattirot, en zo matteret belo zo veen zo mefaggelet belo zo:
Im netanan kullan ketiknan veachat shello chetiknah. bemachashevet chutz lizmanno:
Pasul. shello huttar barishonot:
Veen bo charet. sheen mefaggelim bachatzi mattir:
Al harishona. begoel yisrael hu matchil lehaarich. veaf al pi sheenah mimminyan shesh kore otah rishona, lefi shebbah matchil lehosif ulehaarich:
Al hashsheviit. labberachot shemmaarich bahen. aval habberachot shemmosifin bishvil hattaanit enan ella shesh, shebberacha rishona shehi goel yisrael dishmone esre hi, ella shemmaarich bah:

Mi sheana et david veet shelomo veno. veaf al gav deyona batar david ushelomo haya. mikkol makom makdim leh beresha, mishshum devae lemichtam besof habberachot baruch hamerachem al haaretz, vedavid ushelomo veno hem shehitpallelu al eretz yisrael. david, vayhi raav bime david kulei‏ (Shmuel 2 21), ushelomo, raav ki yihye vaaretz (Melachim 1 8):
Hammarid et hailan. menaneo:
O et hattuma. kegon shehevi sham orev sheretz o chazzayit min hammet o nevela venishar ben anfe hailan:
Enan bechi yuttan. im mechamat reada zo naflu me geshamim shebbailan al perot shettachtav, lo huchsheru:
Hayyotzim veet shebbo. mashkim hayyotzim mechamat harada, umashkim hannisharim bailan venaflu achar kach al happerot, huchsheru, deachshove achshevinhu vechitlushim damu:
Mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu mikkullo. nitkavven lehotzi chol hammayim min hailan, vehannisharim lav dateh alayhu velo machshere:
Hivdil bachattat. shemmalak shene simanim bachattat:
O lo hivdil baola. shemmalak bah siman echad:
Pasul. dechol shinnuy shehu lifne avodat haddam pasul:
Velo mitztza dam hagguf pesula. deikkar damim bagguf hu dishchiche:
Metammea mishshum ketem. shel nidda, bemashshehu, dei mishshum tumat met, lo metammea ella birviit:
Umetammea beohel. im kol harviit yachad:

Shemmetamma mishshum katem. bemashshehu. shenneekar mechayyim. veen halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi yose. hilkach, lo shena yoshevet al mashber velo shena shear metot, kullehu metammeot mishshum ketem, umetammeot beohel:
Ellu hen chattovt hatztzibbur. sheanu tzerichin lehazekiram, shehare happenimiyyot kevar nishnu:
Seire rashe chodashim veshel moadot. shehen al mizbeach hachitzon:
Shechitatan batztzafon. shehare lamadnu bevinyan av lechol hachattaot shehen teunot tzafon:

Ala vakkevesh ufana lassovev. mippene sheddamah nittan al hakkeranot uveetzba, tzarich laamod al gabbe sovev. aval bechol shear haddamim shehen hattachtonim min hachut ulematta, omed al haritzpa etzel zavit hammizbeach vezorek min hakkeli, vechol makom sheyyaggia lammizbeach kasher:

Uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit. shebbah hu pogea rishon, kidkayma lan [yoma daf 15] kol pinnot sheatta fone lo yihyu ella derech yamin, vehakkevesh baddarom, uchesheole vo ufanav lammizbeach nimtza yemino lammizrach, ufone limino lammizrach uva lo leotah hakkeren, veholech umakkif bassovev derech yamin ufanav lammizbeach min haddarom lammizrach umimmizrach latztzafon umitztzafon lammaarav dehaynu derech yamin. veamma al amma berum amma hannatun berosh hammizbeach bechol zavit vezavit shebbah, karuy keren:

Al yesod deromit. deyalfinan yeridato min hakkevesh bachattaot hachitzonot usheyare haddam beyado, mitziato min hahechol veshirayim happenimit beyado, ma yetziato min hahechol haya noten sheyare haddam besamuch lo shehu yesod maaravi kedichtiv (Vayikra 4) asher petach ohel moed, dehaynu letzad maarav shehu samuch lahechol, af yeridato min hakkevesh noten hashshirayim besamuch lo, dehaynu yesod deromi samuch lakkevesh, shehakkevesh baddarom:

Lifnim min hakkelaim. lefi shebbammishkan hayu kelaim hekkef lachatzar ohel moed, uvechattat ketiv (sham 6) bemakom kadosh teachel bachatzar ohel moed. uvevet olamim hayta chomat haazara bimkom hakkelaim:
Lezichre chehunna. degabbe chattat veasham umincha ketiv kol zachar bakkohanim yochal otah:
Bechol maachol. mishshum devae lemitne vappesach deeno neechol ella tzali, tana bechullehu vechol maachol:
Leyom valayla. dichtiv (sham 7) uvesar zevach todat shelamav beyom karbano yeachel, lamadnu letoda shenneechelet leyom echad. chattat veasham minnayin, talmud lomar zevach:
Ad chatzot. seyag asu chachamim lattora leharechik et haadam min haavera. deha kera lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker kaamar:

Shello taam kelum mibbaerev. kol otah hallayla, vehayenu tafel belo taam. vehu sheyyashan mechatzot acharon shel layla ad habboker. vead shalosh shaot bayyom nikra rok tafel leinyan ze. veim hishkim babboker veshana pirko, lo have rok tafel:
Leissat gerisin shel pol chalukat nafesh. shennechelak haochel min hakkelippa. loasa ligrisat happol umaaviro al hakketem:
Shehechemitzu. shehisrichu. vechamma chimmutzan, kol sheshshahu shelosha yamim:
Vetzarich lechaskes. leshafshef shalosh peamim lechol sam vesam, kederech kibbus begadim shekkofel tzad im tziddo umeshafshef:
Kesidran. sheshshenuyim kan:
Lo asa velo chelum. lo livdok velo levattel:
Hamemachek et hakkeresha. dochek et hakkeresha kede sheyyetze mimmenna hattal:
Keresha. chatzir bilshon mikra. 592 belaaz uvaaravi 627:
Vehassochet bisaro uvichsuto. shehaya va vadderech veyardu geshamim bisaro veal kesuto, vesochet bahen kede sheyyetzu hammayim:
Veet shebbo. mashkin hannisharim venaflu achar kach al happerot:
Mitkavven sheyyetzu mikkullo. denitkavven lehotzi mehen kol hammayim velav dateh al hannisharim, hilkach lo machshirim. kevet hillel deresh pirkin:
Anshe mishmar. esrim vearbaa mishmerot kehunna hayu, kol mishmar oved bashshabbat shello:
