Anshe vet av. hammishmar mitchallek leshiva vatte avot keminyan yemot hashshavua, kol echad oved yomo:

Mitannin velo mashlimin. shettaaniyyot harishonot enan chamurin kol kach, ulefichach en mashlimin, sheim tichbad haavoda al anshe vet av shehayu ovdin oto hayyom yavou ellu lesayyean vihe vahen koach laavod:

Chattat haof hayta naaset bekeren maaravit deromit. mishshum deminchat chote keruya chattat, dichtiv beminchat chote (Vayikra 5) lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona ki chattat hi. umashma nammi shehachattat keruya mincha. dechattat nehpecha lihyot mincha bedalle dallut, umincha matzinu shetteuna haggasha bekeren maaravit deromit dichtiv (sham 6) hakerev otah bene aharon lifne Adonai‏ el pene hammizbeach, ezehu ruach shehu lifne Adonai‏ veel pene hammizbeach, heve omer zo ruach maaravit deromit, delifne Adonai‏ hu maarav, ufene hammizbeach hu haddarom sheshsham haya hakkevesh, uma mincha teuna haggasha bekeren maaravit deromit, af chattat haof avodatah bekeren maaravit deromit. vehazzaat damah hi ikkar avodatah:
Bechol makom hayta cheshera. limlikatah:
Ella ze haya mekomah. lehazzaatah. vehachi mefaresh la baggemara:
Millematta. lematta michut hassikra:
Haggashot. shel menachot kodem kemitzatan, kedichtiv (sham 2) vehiggishah el hammizbeach:
Usheyare haddam. shel chattaot hachitzonot haya shofech el yesod deromi. kidyalfinan beferek ezehu mekoman:
Nissuch hammayim. bechag hassukkot:
Vehayyayin. bechol yom. sheshsham hayu hashshitin velo haya efshar lenassech ki im sham:

Veolat haof keshehi rabba vammizrach. deikkar mekomah bekeren deromit mizrachit mippene shekkerova levet haddeshen lizrok sham mura venotza, kedichtiv (sham 1) vehishlich otah vegomer‏ el mekom haddashen. ucheshehi rabba sham sheyyesh kohanim harebe beotah hakkeren asukim beolot veen laze makom laamod bassovev deolat haof naaset lemala, ba lo lekeren deromit maaravit, sheaf hi semucha levet haddeshen yoter mishshear shete keranot, shebbet haddeshen samuch lakkevesh haya bemizracho shel kevesh velidromo shel mizbeach:
Higgia shiva asar bemarcheshvan. uchevar avru shelosha zemannim, shehen shelishi bemarcheshvan, ushevii, veshiva asar:
Hitchilu hayechidim. talmide chachamim:
Shalosh taaniyyot. sheni vachamishi vesheni:

Ochlim veshotim mishshechashecha. muttar lahem leechol velishtot kol lel hattaanit ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar kol zeman shello yashen. aval leachar sheyyashen shenat keva asur leechol velishtot im lo hitna mittechilla kodem sheyyashen. veit deamre daachila bae tenay, shetiyya lo bae tenay, deen keva lishtiyya. vehachi mistabbera:
Hannoer agudda shel yarak. kegon yarak sheyyardu alav geshamim o shennafal bammayim shello leratzon, umenaaro kede sheyyetzu hammayim:
Choshshim anu. bitmiha. kelomar ledivrechem haya lanu lachush gam laze:
Hammaale sak male ferot. shennafal bemayim shello leratzon, veheelahu vehinnicho al sefat hannahar:
Hattachton tahor. kelomar, af hattachton tahor, vechol shekken haelyon:

Kadshe nachrim. shehannachrim nodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael. dichtiv befarashat emor ish ish mibbet yisrael asher yakriv karbano lechol nidrehem ulechol nidvotam, vedarshinan ish, ma talmud lomar ish ish, lerabbot et haggoyim shennodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael:

En chayyavin mishshum piggul notar vetame. defiggul yalef minnotar bigzera shava deavon avon, venotar yalef mittame bigzera shava dechillul chillul, uvetame chetiv (Vayikra 22) veyinnazru mikkadshe bene yisrael, velo mikkadshe nachrim. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Devarim sheen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul. kegon hakkometz vehakketoret vechol hashshenuyin bemishnatenu:
Chayyavin mishshum tuma. haochlan betumat hagguf chayyav karet:

Chutz min haddam. demiateh kera, dichtiv (sham 17) vaani netattiv lachem, shellachem yehe kishar chullin, velo kekadashim. veod ketiv (sham) al hammizbeach lechapper, lechappara netattiv velo limila. hilkach en chayyavin alav lo mishshum tuma velo mishshum notar velo mishshum piggul, ella mishshum ochel dam gereda:

Bedavar sheddarkan leheachel. shedderech bene adam leachlan, veaf al pi shehu min hanniktarim, kegon kometz uminchat kohanim vehaddomim lah. aval levona veetzim uketoret en chayyavin alehen mishshum tuma. verabbanan pelige aleh umerabbu lehu lattuma mikkera dichtiv (sham 7) vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame, vehabbasar yetera, lerabbot etzim ulevona. vahalacha kachachamim deetzim ulevona nammi yesh bahen mishshum tuma. veen lecha etzim demittamin ella etzim shel karban bilvad, sheim naga vahen tuma asur lesarfan al gabbe hammizbeach:
Lemuda lihyot roa vitchillat havvesatot. shebbegufah, kegon bitchillat haittushim vehappihukin vechayyotze bahen:

Af yamim veshaot vesatot. shaot nammi vesatot ninhu, uvatar didhu azlinan. sheim hayta regila lirot meesrim yom leesrim yom umishshesh shaot leshesh shaot, muttarot leshammesh beyom esrim ad shesh shaot, vechosheshet beshaa shishshit levad. avra shaa shishshit velo raata, mutteret leshammesh kol hayyom kullo:
Hayta lemuda lihyot roa im hanetz hachamma. siyyuma demilleta derabbi yose hi:
Enah asura ella im hanetz hachamma. vechol hallayla meshammeshet. veim avar hanetz hachamma velo raata, meshammeshet kol hayyom. dedavka sheat havvesatot chosheshet, vetu lo:

Rabbi yehuda omer kol hayyom shellah. kelomar mutteret leshammesh kol hayyom, mishsheavar hanetz hachamma velo raata. aval kol hallayla shellifne hanetz hachamma shel vestah, asura leshammesh. veim hanetz hachamma dekatane, hayenu dirgila lemichze besof lelya mikkamme dilmate techillat yemama, vaanan asrinan la kol onat vestah. nimtzet asura kol hallayla shehi onat vestah. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Shello lehafekia et hashshearim. kesheroin baale chanuyyot shekkonin lemotzae chamishi shete seuddot gedolot, achat lelel hattaanit veachat lashshabbat, yihyu sevurin shebba raav laolam, umeyakkerin umafkiin hashshaar. aval mishshehitchilu lehitannot bashsheni, yodim sheeno ella mippene hattaanit. perush acher shello yomru im lo sherau vet din sheharaav ba, lo hayu dochakim ligzor taanit atta samuch lashshabbat, umippene chen yeyakkeru veyafkiu hashshaar:

Haya molek et roshah. ochez shete gappeha bishte etzbeotav zeret ukemitza shel yado hassemalit, vehaof al gabbe yado ufanav shel of letzad gav yado sheyyihye haoref lemala, umoteach tzavvaro haggaron al rochav shel shete etzbeotav etzba veamma. umolek betzipparno. vezo achat meavodot kashot shebbammikdash:
Veeno mavdil. harosh min hagguf. ella chotech shidra umifreket verov basar immo ad shemmaggia lavveshet o lakkane venotel siman echad levaddo umolek, kedichtiv velo yavdil:
Umazze middamah. ochez baof umazze. shello haya mazze lo bichli velo beetzba ella begufo shel of:

Haya mitmatztze. shemmekarev bet melikato lammizbeach vedochako bakkir vehaddam mitmatztze veyored laysod. divchattat haof ketiv (Vayikra 5) vehizza middam hachattat al kir hammizbeach vehannishar baddam yimmatze el yesod hammizbeach, ezehu kir shehashshirayim shello mitmatztzin laysod, heve omer ze kir hattachton, dehaynu min hachut ulematta. dei kir haelyon, dehaynu min hachut ulemala, peamim shehaya mitmatztze lassovev, kevan sheose lemala min hassovev, shehachut lematta min hassovev amma:
Hammarid et hailan. lehappil perotav:

Venaflu al chavero. al ilan acher, umeoto ilan naflu al hazzeraim veal hayerakot hamechubbarim lakkarka, umashke tofeach al otan hazzeraim min hammayim shergilin lehashekot otan o miggeshamim shennaflu alehen:

Bet shammay omrim hare hen bechi yuttan. dechevan deyodea haya sheyyippelu ferot hallalu al otan zeraim sheyyesh alehen mashke tofeach, galle dateh denicha leh, vehuchsheru happerot shennaflu al gabbe otan zeraim, lekabbel tuma:
Uvet hillel omrim enan bechi yuttan. kevan delo naflu lehedya min hailan al hazzeraim ella meilan leilan acher:
Chale kuferi. kach haya chinnuyo:
Tivon. shem makom:
Ad sheyyitkavven. vehane hoil umeilan leilan o missocha lesocha naflu, en zo chavvana. vetaamayhu devet hillel kaamar:

Meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim. ayde detana bemassechet rosh hashshana desalek minnah uvechag niddonin al hammayim, tana hacha meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim. ulefi shehaggeshamim achat miggevurotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv (Iyov 5) ose gedolot veen cheker hannoten matar al pene aretz, mishshum hachi kare lehu gevurot geshamim:

Miyyom tov acharon shel chag. aval kol shivat yeme hechag lo, shehaggeshamim lime sukka siman kelala. mashal leeved shebba limzog kos lerabbo veshafach lo rabbo kitton al panav, kelomar i efshi beshimmushecha:
Im ken. atta omer mazkirin af al pi sheen shoalin hoil umashma beonato, afillu bakkayitz yazkiro, uma atta noten siman miyyom tov rishon. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Chattat haof sheasaah lematta. michut hassikra, kehilchatah shehi naaset lematta, kedaamaran befirkin dilel:
Kemaase chattat. behazzaa umitztzuy:
Leshem chattat. af al pi sheshshinna beseder melika, kegon shemmalak vehivdil, uvechattat neemar velo yavdil:
Keshera. hoil venaaset lematta uvishar avodot kehilchatah:
Kemaase chattat leshem ola vechulei‏ pesula. dechattat shello lishmah pesula:
Kemaase chullam. kelomar kemaase echad mikkullam haamurim kan, vaafillu kemaase chattat leshem chattat, hoil vaasaah lemala pesula:
Lehanniach et damo o et emurav lemachar. lo sheyyaktirem lemachar, dehay machashevet chutz lizmanno hi ufiggul gamur have. ella al menat sheyyanniach hakkol lemachar velo yaktirem:

Rabbi yehuda posel. hoil umifsal behotzaa uvehinnuach, mifsal nammi bemachashevet hotzaa vehinnuach. ucheshem sheim hinnichan lemachar pasul, dedam nifsal bishkiat hachamma, kach im chashav alehen lehannicham lemachar, pasal:

Vachachamim machshirin. hoil velo chashav lo lehaketir velo lizrok velo leechol chutz lizmanno, vechen lo chashav lo lehaketir velo lizrok velo leechol chutz limkomo, af al pi shechashav lehanniach lemachar o lehotzi chutz limkomo, lo fasal. vahalacha kachachamim. veha delo fasal rabbi yehuda bimchashshev baddamim hannittanin lematta latet otam lemala hoil veim asa chen pasal, mishshum disvira leh lerabbi yehuda shehachoshev lizrok haddam al hammizbeach afillu shello vimkomo keillu chashav lezarko bimkomo, uvilvad shello yachashov lizrok chutz laazara:
Vechol sevivoteha mitannot. sheotah hair shello yardu vah geshamim telech liknot tevua bair sheyyardu vah veyihye raav:
Veenah mittaheret min havveset. sheppasak mimmenna, shello lachosh lo:
Olat haof sheasaah lemala. kehilchatah shehi naaset lemala:
Kemaase ola leshem ola. af al pi sheshshinna vimlikatah shello hivdil, umin haddin haya lo lehavedil, afillu hachi keshera:
Kemaase ola leshem chattat keshera. dechol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kesherim ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat:
Asaah lematta kemaase chullan. kemaase echad mikkullan, vaafillu kemaase ola leshem ola:
Pesula. hoil vaasaah lematta pesula:
Yardu latztzemachim velo lailan. kegon sheyyardu benachat, shezze yafe latztzemachim velaasavim veeno moil lailanot:
Lailan velo latztzemachim. sheyyardu bechoach:
Labborot shichin umearot. shemmachnisin bahen mayim lishtot:

Shechitatan bechol makom baazara. shalosh parashiyyot neemru bishchitat shelamim, chada beven bakar, vachada bechesev, vachada beez. bekammayta chetiv ushechato petach ohel moed, uvetarte batrayta chetiv lifne ohel moed, lehacheshir et kol haruchot shebbaazara, delifne mashma kol shellifne hahechol:
Lishne yamim velayla echad. dehachi chetiv bishlamim (sham 7) vehannotar mibbesar hazzavach bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref:
Hishila chalukah. veachar kach levashattah hi umatza alav ketem:
Lenachrit o lenidda. lenachrit shehi roa dam, shehi gedola veyadanu bah shekkevar raata, dumeya denidda:

Hare zo tola vah. utehora. dechevan denidda hi, lo mekalkela la midi. venachrit nammi temea vetalya bah. aval yisreelit tehora sheshshaala chaluk mechavertah tehora, veachar kach levashattu chavertah, shetehen temeot, kidkatane shalosh nashim vechulei, dechevan dei talya bah, mekalkela la, may chazet dimkalkelet lehach tefe mehach:
Shel even. deeno mekabbel tuma. vesafsal deresha [ayre] bichli etz derauy littame bemoshav hazzav vehannidda:

Eno mekabbel ketamim. kelomar lo gazru al ketamim hannimtzaim bo. vetaama derabbi nechemya, dichtiv (yeshaya 3) venikkata laaretz teshev, kevan sheyyashva laaretz sheenah mekabbelet tuma, nikkata. vehu haddin lechol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma. vechen im yashva al gabbe keli cheres, sheen mekabbel tuma miggabbo, o al gabbe matlaniyyot shel beged sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh sheenan mekabbelin tuma, bechol ellu lo gazru al ketamim hannimtzaim bahem. vahalacha kerabbi nechemya:

Chattat haof shemmelakah shello lishmah. melika baof bimkom shechita babbehema. umitztzuy baof bimkom zerikat haddam babbehema. vehammachashava happoselet bishchita uzerikat dam babbehema, poselet bammelika uvemitztzuy haddam baof. aval kabbala vehilluch en baof:
Olat haof keshera. keditnan beresh perek kamma gabbe vehema, kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kesherim ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat:
Leechol davar sheddarko leechol. chattat haof:
Lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir. olat haof:
Shello lishmah. en motzi ola mide piggul, lefi shehi cheshera shello lishmah. vechulla matnitin meforeshet leel perek 2:
Veragil. hayyodea seder tefilla:
Veyesh lo vanim uveto rekan. sheen beveto bamme lefarnes et banav, umittoch shennafsho aguma alav mitpallel bechavvana. i nammi beto rekan min haaverot, shello yatza alav shem ra beyalduto:
Umosifin alehem shesh. ben goel lerofe omer shesh berachot hallalu:

Ala vakkevesh. lefi sheolat haof naaset lemala, delo chetiv beolat haof yesod, ella bechattat haof bilvad. uvivhema ippecha, dechattat behema naaset lemala dichtiv bah karnot hammizbeach, veolat behema lematta dichtiv (sham 4) el yesod mizbach haola, tala hayesod baola:
Ba lo lekeren deromit mizrachit. lefi shehi kerova levet haddeshen sheshsham mashlich hammura vehannotza:
Mimmul arpah. mul haroe et arpah. vehu achore hatztzavvar. veaf al pi shello neemar beola mul oref, lamadnu vah mul oref mechattat:
Umavdil. chotech shene simanim. demiddichtiv bechattat haof velo yavdil, lamadnu shebbeolat haof mavdil:
Vehikkif bet melikato lammizbeach. mekarev vedochek bet hammelika bekir hammizbeach kede sheyyitmatztze haddam:

Usefago vemelach. leshon sheiva ulekicha, kemo sofeg et haarbaim. af kan noten alav melach kede sheyyehe harosh moshech umekabbel hammelach. perush acher, sefago begimel kemo sofko bekuf, leshon vayyispok et kappav (Bamidbar 24):
Mura. zefek:
Notza. koder bo chemin arubba venotel kol haor vehannotza shekkeneged hazzefek im hazzefek umashlich:
Shissa. et haof ben agappim velo haya mavdil:
Vehammaaser. maasar behema:
Vedaman taun mattana achat. delo chetiv behu saviv, ella veet damam tizrok ketiv gabbe bechor. vehanach nammi mehatam yalfinan, middelo chetiv veet damo ella veet damam:

Keneged hayesod. bemakom sheyyesh yesod tachtav, lemaote mizrachit deromit sheen sham yesod kedaamaran. uvechor umaaser ufesach teunim yesod, deyalfinan zerika zerika ligzera shava meola, uveola chetiv (Vayikra 4) el yesod mizbach haola:
Shinna vaachilatan. ze mizze. af al pi shehishva otan lemattan damim:
Habbechor neechol lakkohanim. kedichtiv (Bamidbar 18) uvesaram yihye lecha:
Vehammaaser lechol adam. shello matzinu bechol hattora sheyyihye lakkohanim chelek bo:

Veneechalin bechol hair. dichtiv (Devarim 12) vahavetem shamma olotechem vezivchechem veet maserotechem. vetanya, bishne maasrot hakkatuv medabber, chad masar behema, vechad masar dagan. uchetiv behahu kera uvechorot bekarchem vetzonchem, umidlo kava lehu mechitztza shema minna demaaser uvechor neechalim bechol hair:

Lishne yamim velayla echad. devivchor hu omer uvesaram yihye lecha kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin, hikkisho hakkatuv lechaze veshok, ma chaze veshok shel shelamim lishne yamim velayla echad, af bechor lishne yamim velayla echad, umaaser kivchor:
Limnuyav. leotam shennimnu bidme lekichato, kedichtiv (Shemot 12) ish lefi achlo tachossu:
Ed shehu natun tachat hakkar. habbeged shemmekannachat bo et atzmah bishat tashmish, karuy ed:
Dam agol tahor. dedam maacholet hu:
Mashuch tame. veim tippa meshucha hi, temea, shechezkatah shehi mimmenna, uveet shekkinnecha atzmah nitla ze haddam baed:
Divre rabbi eliezer bar rabbi tzadok. vechen halacha:
Veim hitchilu. sheggazru hattaaniyyot kodem lachen vehitchilu lehitannot al hatztzara afillu yom echad ufaga bahen echad meellu hayyamim, en mafsikin:
Mode hu sheen mashlimin. lehitannot bahen kol hayyom, ella ochel baerev samuch lishkiat hachamma:

Vechen tisha veav shechal lihyot beerev shabbat. kegon bizman shehayu vet din kovim al pi hariyya, ochel baerev samuch lishkiat hachamma, mippene chevod hashshabbat shello yikkanes lashshabbat keshehu raev. veen halacha kerabbi meir, ella mitannin umashlimin. vechen tisha veav shechal lihyot beerev shabbat mitanne umashlim:
Ezehu mekoman shel zevachim, kadshe kadashim. olot chattaot vaashamot:

Shechitatan batztzafon. ola, behedya chetiv beh (sham 1) veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona. chattat, ketiv beh (sham 6) bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat. asham, ketiv beh (sham 7) bimkom asher yishchatu et haola yishchatu et haasham:

Shechitatan batztzafon. veha dela tane hacha vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, af al gav dechullehu kabbalat daman batztzafon bimkom shechita, desamuch lashshechita ketiv velakach middam happar, ella mishshum deikka ashamo shel metzora shehakkohen haya mekabbel miktzat damo bechappo, dichtiv (sham 14) velakach hakkohen middam haasham venatan, ma netina beatzmo shel kohen, beetzbao, af lekicha beatzmo shel kohen, mishshum hachi lo chatav hacha vekibbul daman, sheen kibbul daman shave. umishshum delo saggi leh belo kabbalat keli, shelleachar shekkibbel kohen echad lemiktzat dam beyado haya chohen acher mekabbel haddam bakkeli, mishshum hachi hadar tane behedya asham metzora asham taluy shechitatan batztzafon vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon:

Par vesair shel yom hakkippurim. af al gav detzafon beola hu dichtiv, hikdim tanna lechattaot baresha, deayde deatya midderasha chaviva leh. vechattaot penimiyyot ayde denichnas daman lifnay velifnim chaviva leh veakdeminhu lishar chattaot. veinhu nammi shechitatan batztzafon, dichtiv (sham 4) veshachat et hachattat bimkom haola, ukera yetera hu, deha chetiv bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat, ella ze bana av lechol hachattaot sheyyehu teunot tzafon:
Vekibbul daman bichli sharet. dichtiv beolat sinay (Shemot 24) vayyasem baagganot, umimmennu lamdu kol hazzevachim lihyot teunim keli:
Hazzaya al ben habbaddim. omed ben shene vadde aron umazze achat lemala vesheva lematta keneged avyah shel kapporet, velo hayu nogim bah:
Veal happarochet. dichtiv (Vayikra 16) vechen yaase leohel moed:
Veal mizbach hazzahav. kedichtiv veyatza el hammizbeach. beseder avodat yom hakkippurim befarashat achare mot:

Mattana achat meakkavet. kedaamaran beferek bet shammay [daf lo] divfar helem davar ketiv veasa lappar kaasher asa lefar hachattat ken yaase lo, ukera yetera hu, leakkev sheim chissar achat min hammattanot lo chipper. vedarshinan veasa lappar, ze par yom hakkippurim, divdideh nammi mattana achat meakkevet kemo par helem davar:
Sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi. kedichtiv (Vayikra 4) el yesod mizbach haola asher petach ohel moed, veohel moed lemaaravo shel mizbeach hachitzon haya:
Im lo natan. sheyare haddam laysod, lo ikkev hakkappara. devatar hazzaot umattan damim lifnim ketiv (sham 16) vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh, demashma shekkevar shalmu chol hakkapparot kullan:

Bevinyan uvintia. vedavka binyan shel simcha kegon bet chatnut laasot bo chuppato, unetia shel simcha kegon ilan gadol hammesech al haaretz letayyel hammelachim tachtav. aval bayit ladur bo unetiat ilan leferotav muttar:

Yatza nisan. haggeshamim siman kelala keshello yardu kelal kodem [sheyyatza] nisan. vechol haddinim hallalu beeretz yisrael vechayyotze vah, aval haiyyim harchokim shezzeman haggeshamim shellahem eno chizman haggeshamim shel eretz yisrael, kol echad veechad shoel haggeshamim bazzeman shehu tzarich lahem, veim avar oto hazzeman hayyadua lahen velo yardu geshamim, bet din shel oto makom gozrim taaniyyot al hatztzibbur achar shehitannu hayechidim kasseder hashshanuy bematnitin:

Meara mayim lappesach. mikkeli el keli lirchotz bam et besar happesach. aval bammayim enah nogaat, shehi tevulat yom, shettavla lesof shevuayim veen lah haarev shemesh ad yom shemonim shehu techef lahavaat kapparatah, vehakkatuv asaah tevulat yom, dichtiv (Vayikra 12) bechol kodesh lo tigga, vekayma lan bechol kodesh, lerabbot et hatteruma, utevul yom, sheni hu, ucheshehi meara, enah nogaat bammayim ella bakkeli, vesheni eno metamme keli. aval bammayim lo tigga, hoil vehem asuyin lirchotz bahem et happesach, dechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kekodesh dame:

Chazru lomar hare hi chemagga teme met. tevul yom dino kenogea bitme met, shehu rishon, davka lakkadashim, aval lechullin, lo have tevul yom kenogea bitme met lihyot rishon, ella sheni, hilkach yechola hi ligga afillu bammayim, shehammayim chullin hen, utevul yom, sheni hu, veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin. veaf al pi shehammayim hallalu naasim al tohorat hakkodesh shehare lirchitzat pesach asuyot, lo mahane sheni behu, dechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh lav kekodesh damu:
Bet shammay omrim af kitme met. shehu av hattuma veose maggao rishon. kach maggao shel tevul yom, rishon hu:

Seder taaniyyot haellu. haamurin bapperakin dilel, eno ella birvia rishona, im avru shelosha zemannin shel revia shel yore, shehem shelishi bemarcheshvan ushevii veshiva asar, velo yardu geshamim, az hayu mitannin yechidim, veachar kach mitannin hatztzibbur shelosh esre taaniyyot al hasseder sheamar:
Aval. yardu geshamim beittan vetzamchu hazzeraim venishtannu, kemo tachat chitta yatza choach, tachat seora basha, o shinnuy acher:
Matriin alehem miyyad. betaaniyyot rishonot. shekkol chomer haamur battaaniyyot haacharonot nohagin miyyad barishonot:
Ben geshem legeshem. ben revia rishona lishniyya:
Makkat batztzoret. siman batztzoret hu:
Leshem zevach. laafoke shinnuy kodesh, kegon leshem zevach acher:
Leshem zoveach. laafoke shinnuy bealim. kidyalfinan leel beresh perek kamma mimmotza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta laAdonai‏ elohecha nedava kulei:
Leshem ishshim. laafoke im shechato al menat laasoto chatichot tzeluyot begechalim:
Leshem reach. laafoke im tzelaan techilla chutz lammaaracha, detu lo maske recha:
Leshem hannachat ruach. nachat ruach lehakkadosh baruch hu sheamar venaasa retzono. vechol hane yalfinan lehu middichtiv ishshe reach nichoach:
Leshem chet. leshem cheto shehu mevio alav:
Af mi shello haya velibbo leshem echad mikkol ellu. ella shechato setam, kasher:
Shehu tenay bet din. sheyyishchot setam velo lema lishman, dilma ate lememar shello lishman:

Sheen hammachshava holechet ella achar haoved. hilkach i hava omer shello lishman af ki amru habbealim lishman, lav mide hu, delav bedidhu talya milleta, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) hammakriv oto lo yechashev. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Bime rabbi chalafta. betzippori haya:

Velo anu acharav amen garsinan. lefi shebbammikdash lo hayu onin amen achar kol beracha ella baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed, kidamrinan baggemara bivrachot perek haroe. veellu lo vammikdash hayu veasu kederech sheosim bammikdash:
Tiku vene aharon tekau. chazzan hakkeneset omer lahem kach al kol beracha uveracha:
Lo hayinu nohagin ken. shello laanot amen ella baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed:

Ella veshaar mizrach. shaar mizrach shel har habbayit veshaar hammizrach shel azara. lefi shehayu mazkirin shem hameforash bachatimat habberacha, velo saggi baaniyyat amen. veen lomar lo hayu nohagin litkoa ella vammikdash, devadday tokin baggevulin, kidmuchach behach massechta uverosh hashshana. vahalacha kachachamim:

Haroa yom achad asar. shehu sof yeme ziva, veen yom shelleacharav mitztaref immo leziva. sheim raata yom shenem asar ushelosha asar, enah zava gedola bishvil ken, lefi shehen techillat yeme nidda veenan mitztarfin im yeme ziva:

Bet shammay omrim metammein mishkav umoshav. vaafillu habboel metamme mishkav umoshav letamme ochalin umashkin, mippene shehu keva al shomeret yom keneged yom, desavre bet shammay yom achad asar bae shimmur. uvet hillel potrim min hakkarban, desavre, yom achad asar hoil veen yom shelleacharav mitztaref immo leziva, lo bae shimmur. mihu leinyan tuma modu devoalah metamme midderabbanan, gezera yom achad asar attu toch achad asar, dimtammea boalah middeorayta, aval leinyan karban, lehavi chullin laazara, lo:

Tavla vayyom shelleacharav. deavda shimmur ketzat. veshimmur mealleya hu, ella shettoch achad asar yom asur laasot ken, shello tavo lide safek, shemma tire leachar tashmish umitztarfin hayyamim leziva:
Metammein mishkav umoshav. midderabbanan metamme afillu boalah mishkav umoshav. gezera attu toch achad asar:
Ufeturin min hakkarban. deha avda shimmur. veaf al pi shechazra veraata, en mitztarfin leziva, shehare techillat nidda hi:
Gargeran. memaher lachato. shemma yargil bechach toch achad asar. aval leinyan tuma, tahor:
Vechayyavin bakkarban. afillu lo tire lemachar, deha baya shimmur, vezot lo shamra kelal, venimtza shebbaal zava ketanna:
Tavla vayyom shelleacharav. deavda ketzat shimmur, veshimmesha:
Hare zo tarbut raa. shemma tire achare chen vetitztaref leshellefanav veen tevilatah tevila:
Umaggaan. leinyan tuma vetohora:
Uveilatan. leinyan karban:
Teluyin. sheim tire, maggaan magga zava vechayyavin karban bivilatan. veim lo tire, maggaan tahor, ufeturin min hakkarban al beilatan:
Haola damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach. dichtiv (sham 1) vezarku et haddam, vahadar vearchu:
Veet orah lakkohanim. dichtiv (sham 7) or haola asher hikriv, en lo ella leachar zerika:
Chattat haof. shehi neechelet lakkohanim. nafka lan middichtiv lechol chattatam, lerabbot chattat haof, delo tema nevela hi:
Parim hannisrafim. par kohen mashiach ufar helem davar shel tzibbur ufar yom hakkippurim:

Useirim hannisrafim. sair shel yom hakkippurim, useire avoda zara. shekkol ellu daman taun hazzaya lifnim, veemurehen kerevin al mizbach haola ushear habbasar nisraf bevet haddeshen. vehoil vedaman mattir et emurehen likkarev, im piggel bahen veachal et emurehen chayyav alehen mishshum piggul:

Kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim. defiggul, bishlamim hu dichtiv, ma shelamim meyuchadim shemattan daman al mizbeach hachitzon, af kol sheddaman natun al mizbeach hachitzon. laafoke parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim sheddaman taun hazzaya umattan damim bifnim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Zichronot veshofarot. kol happesukim kemo sheomrim berosh hashshana:
Veomer chotmehen. achar zichronot chatimat zichronot, veachar shofarot chatimat shofarot, vechen achar kullam kedimfaresh veazel:

Hashsheni matkia. hammitpallel tefillat hammusafin matkia, velo hammitpallel tefilla shel shacharit. uvishat hashshemad tiknu kach, sheggazru shello yitkeu, vehayu orvim lahem kol shesh shaot shel zeman tefillat hashshachar, lechach heeviru hattekia mittefillat hashshachar litfillat hammusafim:
Uvishat hahallel. mishshum deen omrim hallel berosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim, katane uvishat hahallel, kelomar bishar yom tov sheomrim hallel:

Venitkalkelu haleviyyim bashshir. shel tamid shel ben haarbayim, velo amru bo shir kelal. lefi sherov peamim hayu haedim baim kodem hammincha, lefichach tikkenu shir shel yom tov betamid shel ben haarbayim. uvetamid shel shachar sherov peamim adayin lo bau edim velo yadu im yitkaddesh hayyom im lav, lo tikkenu lo shir shel yom tov, ella shir shel chol hayu omrim. veoto paam shehiggia sheat hakeravat tamid shel ben haarbayim vaadayin lo bau edim, lo yadu haleviyyim im yomru shir shel chol o shir shel yom tov, velo amru shir kelal:

Nohagin oto hayyom kodesh. demishshechashecha layil shelleachar 29 beelul nahagu bo kodesh, shemma yavou edim machar vikaddeshuhu bet din, venimtza shebballayla lel yom tov hu, vechen lemachar kol hayyom ad hammincha, veim bau edim kodem hammincha bet din mekaddeshin et hachodesh venoda sheyyafe nahagu bo kodesh. veim min hammincha ulemala bau edim, af al pi sheen bet din mekaddeshin oto hayyom, viabberu et elul vikaddeshuhu lemachar, af al pi chen nohagin oto bikdushsha veasur bimlacha, dilma atu lezilzule beh lashshana habbaa veyaasu bo melacha kol hayyom, veamre eshtakad nahagnu bo kodesh bechinnam, umin hammincha ulemala chazarnu venahagnu bo chol:

Sheafillu rosh bet din bechol makom. shennitzrach lifrosh mimmekom havvaad lemakom acher. vahare ikkar mitzvat [kiddush] hachodesh teluya bo, keditnan leel [perek 2] rosh bet din omer mekuddash, mikkol makom lo yihyu tzerichin edim lelech acharav ella limkom havvaad shehassanhedrin yoshvin sham yelchu, vesanhedrin mekaddeshin oto belo rosh bet din:

Kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayyah sheatah. leel beferek kamma tenena la, vehatam mayre bivsatot deyome kegon mechamishsha asar yom lachamishsha asar yom, o mechodesh lechodesh, vehacha mayre bivsatot divgufah, shekkol zeman sheyyerau bah simanim hallalu regila lirot bahen, aval en lah zeman kavua lirot:
Mefaheket. yesh mefarshim, potachat piha bechol kochah. 249 belaaz. veyesh mefarshim, poshetet zerooteha vegufah. 570 331 belaaz:
Befi cheresah. neged tabburah:
Shippule meeha. bet harechem:

Veshofaat. mefaresh baggemara sheshshofaat dam tame mittoch dam tahor, kegon shehi regila lirot dam tahor techilla, dehaynu dam sheeno mechamishsha damim temein, veachar kach dam tame. vehay nammi have veset. vechol shaa shettire dam tame achar dam tahor, dayyah shatah:
Tzemarmoret. leshon samar mippachdecha vesari (tehillim kayit). 410 belaaz:
Ochazin otah. kach lemuda lihyot bechol et shehi roa:

Vechen kayyotze vahen. mishshear simanim shehannashim haroot dam lemudot lihyot bechach. kegon sheroshah kaved aleha, o ochazah retet varaad, o keev lev, vechayyotze baze, im kava lah shalosh peamim hare ze veset:
Yesh gefen sheyyenah adom veyesh gefen sheyyenah shachor. kach yesh ishsha sheddam shellah adom, veyesh sheddam shellah shachor:
Kol gefen yesh bah yayin. kol ishsha yesh lah dam nidda vedam betulim:
Vesheen bah hare ze dorketi. dor katua. kelomar ketua banim, akara sheenah yoledet:
Zivche shalme tzibbur. kivse atzeret:
Asham gezelot. haamur bishvuat happikkadon:
Asham meilot. hannehene min hahekdesh:
Asham shifcha charufa. habba al shifcha shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin hameyoedet leeved ivri shemmuttar beshifcha uvevat chorin:
Asham nazir. shennitma bemet, dichtiv beh (Bamidbar 6) vehizzir laAdonai‏ et yeme nizro [vegomer]:
Asham taluy. safek shagag bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet, safek lo shagag. vehu chetiv bevayyikra etzel asham meilot:
Asham vadday. lo garsinan. shekkol ellu asham vadday hen, chutz measham taluy:
Shete mattanot shehen arba. divasham nammi chetiv zerika uchetiv saviv:

Veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim. dichtiv beasham (Bamidbar 18) bekodesh hakkodashim tochalennu. vezivche shalme tzibbur samach otan hakkatuv lechattat dichtiv (Vayikra 23) vaasitem seir izzim echad lechattat ushene chevasim bene shana lezevach shelamim, lomar lecha sheddinan kachattat, sheen neechalin ella lifnim min hakkelaim ulezichre chehunna. aval en teunim arba mattanot kachattat, sheen lecha bechol hakkarbanot mi shettaun arba mattanot ella chattat bilvad:
Seder tekiot shalosh. achat lemalchuyot, veachat lezichronot, veachat leshofarot:

Shel shalosh shalosh. tekia uterua utekia lechol achat veachat. lefi shenneemar shete teruot bammikra berosh hashshana, uterua achat beyom hakkippurim shel yovel, veyalfinan shevii shevii ligzera shava litten et haamur shel ze baze, uterua haamura beyom hakkippurim shel yovel anu notnin otah lerosh hashshana, nimtzeu berosh hashshana shalosh teruot, ushete teruot haamurot berosh hashshana notnin otan leyom hakkippurim, nimtzeu shalosh teruot beyom hakkippurim. vechol terua, peshuta lefaneha ufeshuta leachareha, detanya minnayin sheppeshuta lefaneha, talmud lomar (Vayikra 25) vehaavarta shofar terua, uminnayin sheppeshuta leachareha, talmud lomar (sham) taaviru shofar, hare haavara techilla vesof uterua bentayim. uleshon haavara peshuta mashma haavarat kol echad pashut, hare leshalosh teruot shel rosh hashshana shesh tekiot, vahare lecha shalosh shel shalosh shalosh:
Shiur tekia. shiur kol hattekiot, shehem shesh tekiot:
Keshalosh teruot. nimtza shiur tekia achat kachatzi terua:

Shiur terua keshalosh yevavot. shelosha kolot bealma shel kol shehen. veyesh mefarshim shekkol yevava hi shelosha kochot shel kol shehen, nimtza shiur terua tisha kochot shel kol shehen, vehachi mistabbera:

Taka barishona. peshuta shellifne hatterua taka kedarkah. umashach bashsheniyya, tekia shelleachar hatterua mashach kishtayim, latzet bah yede shetayim shehaya tzarich laasot zo achar zo, peshuta shellaachareha demalchuyot ufeshuta shellefaneha dezichronot:
En beyado ella echat. deafsoke tekia achat lishtayim lo mafsekinan:
Mi shebberach. hitpallel tefillat hammusafin uverech tesha berachot:

Keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyav. ben bivrachot shel rosh hashshana ben bitfillot shel kol hashshana, veeno yotze yede chovato ella bitfilla shemmitpallel hu beatzmo, kach kol yachid veyachid habbaki veyodea lehitpallel eno yotze yede chovato ella bitfillat atzmo, ben berosh hashshana ben bishar kol yemot hashshana. veen sheliach tzibbur yored lifne hatteva ella lehotzi et sheeno baki:

Sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatam. ben baki ben sheeno baki, ben bivrachot shel rosh hashshana ben bitfillot shel kol hashshana. velamma tzibbur mitpallelin belachash, kede lehasedir sheliach tzibbur et tefillato. vahalacha kachachamim bivrachot shel kol hashshana sheen sheliach tzibbur motzi ella et sheeno baki, aval bivrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim veshel yovel shehen tesha berachot arukkot veen hakkol bekiin bahen, halacha karabban gamliel shekkeshem shemmotzi et sheeno baki kach motzi et habbaki:
Kol mashke shettechillato leratzon. denicha leh behanach mashkin, bishvil shettudach hakkeara o lishar tashmishin:

Af al pi sheen sofo leratzon. keshennaflu al happerot lo nicha leh, afillu hachi have hechsher. i nammi, sofo leratzon, keshennaflu al happerot. aval bitchillat biatan haya haddavar kashe beenav, hakkol have hechsher:

Hare ze vechi yuttan. kelomar, hoochalin shennaflu alehen mashkin hallalu, muchsharin lekabbel tuma mikkan vaelach. sheen shum ochel mekabbel tuma ad sheyyavo alav mayim o echad mishshiva mashkin, shehem, mayim, yayin, shemen, chalav, devash, dam, tal. dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechi yuttan mayim al zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu, ketiv yitten vekarinan yuttan, ma yitten denicha leh, af yuttan denicha leh:

Metammein leratzon veshello leratzon. kevan ditmein hen, tumatan vehechsheran baim keechad, veim naflu al happerot afillu shello leratzon, metammein otam, delo vainan denicha leh ella cheshebba hammashke kodem lattuma, dichtiv vechi yuttan mayim al zera, vahadar venafal minnivlatam alav. aval keshehammashke vehattuma bain keechad kegon shehammashkin temein, lo vainan denicha leh:

Metammein bemassa. baggemara parech, attu kol met mi lo metamme bemassa. ella may bemassa, beeven mesama. kelomar even gedola ucheveda sheenah mittaltelet. veim hi munnachat al gabbe kelim umet natun aleha en ze massa, hoil veenah reuya lehittaltel immo, ushear metim lo metammu, vehane metammu midderabbanan, hoil umechayyim metammu beeven mesama middeorayta shehare metammeim moshav kol shettachtehen, gazzur behu rabbanan leachar mita shemma yitallefu vedome lemet, vei amarat zav met eno metamme, bezav chay shennitallef ate letahore:
Ad sheyyimmok habbasar. dimehashta have met vadday:
Nachri shemmet. af al gav demechayyim hare hu kazzav lechol devarav umetamme beeven mesama, mishshemmet, tahor milletamme beeven mesama, hoil vetumat ziva shealav mechayyim enah ella middivre sofrim:

Kol hannashim. machzekinan lehu keniddot, umatbilin kelim shehayu alehen samuch litziat neshama af al pi shello nagu bahen leachar mita. lefi shebbarishona hayu matbilin kelim al gabbe niddot metot, vehayu niddot chayyot mitbayyeshot, sheafillu bemitatan hen meshunnot mishshear nashim, hitkinu sheyyihyu matbilin al gabbe kol hannashim, mippene kevodan shel niddot chayyot:
Uvet hillel omrim en nidda ella shemmeta nidda. delet lehu levet hillel hay takkanta:

Tachat happenimit. otah shel tzad hakkir keruya penimit, vechitzona keruya otah shel tzad derech aliyyat hammitta. veha dimfalleg tanna hacha ben keshennimtza tachat happenimit lenimtza tachat hachitzona, uleel katane venimtza dam tachat achat mehen kullan temeot, velo mefalleg ben nimtza tachat penimit lenimtza tachat chitzona, mefaresh baggemara dilel ayre keshehen techufot udevukot yachad, hilkach ikka lesappoke bachitzona afillu keshennimtza haddam tachat happenimit:
Ematay. amru nimtza tachat hachitzona penimit tehora:
Bizman sheavru derech margelot hammitta. delo avra penimit al mekom metziat haddam:
Aval avru shelashtan derech aleha. shehen dorsot veovrot al hachitzona:
Kullan temeot. vaafillu penimit, deshemma kesheavra penimit derech sham nafal mimmenna:
Legal tame. shehaya sham kazzayit min hammet:

Ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula. karka betula. veim lo matza, haggal tahor, deemur ba orev venatal et hattuma. aval hacha keshebbadku shelashtan umatzu tehorot, modu rabbanan lerabbi meir dechullan temeot, dehay dam mehecha ata, al karchach mechada minnayhu hu. vahalacha kachachamim:
Tinoket. notnin lah arbaa lelot. vaafillu roa, amrinan dam betulim hu vetahor:

Ad shettichye hammakka. shettitrappe hammakka shel beila. vechol zeman shehaddam shotet mimmenna keshehi omedet, ucheshehi yoshevet eno shotet, o sheshshotet keshehi yoshevet al gabbe davar kashe, uchesheyyoshevet al gabbe davar rach kegon al gabbe karim uchesatot eno shotet, beyadua shello chayta hammakka, umechamat hammakka shel betulim ba haddam. aval im haddam shotet ben keshehi omedet ben keshehi yoshevet uven kesheyyoshevet al davar rach uven kesheyyoshevet al davar kashe, en ze dam makka ella dam nidda:
Higgia zemannah lirot. velo raata, venisset:
Ad motzae shabbat arbaa lelot. shehare hi nisset birvii. divtula nisset leyom revii venivelet lel chamishi:
Beilat mitzva. beila rishona:

Kol hallayla kullah. vaafillu boel beilot harebe. vechol haddevarim hallalu, baddorot harishonim bilvad, aval achar sheppashta hachumra shehechmiru benot yisrael al atzman sheafillu root dam tippa kechardal yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim, kol hannose betula afillu ketanna shello higgia zemannah lirot velo raata meolam, leachar shebbaal beilat mitzva en muttar lo lavo aleha ad shettispor shiva nekiyyim achar sheyyifsok haddam, kedin shear nashim sheroot dam:

Haola kadshe kadashim. hi. lippasel beyotze, uvitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, umoalim bah. umishshum delo chetiv bah bakkera kodesh kadashim hi kemo bechattat veasham, ashmeinan tanna hacha dehi nammi kadshe kadashim kechattat veasham, shehare hi shava lahem limkom shechitatan vekabbalat daman:

Shete mattanot. bekeren mizrachit tzefonit, uvekeren maaravit deromit shekkenegdah baalachson. vetaama, mishshum dekeren mizrachit deromit lo haya lo yesod lefi shello haya bechelko shel binyamin shennitnabbe yaakov alav (Bereshit 49) babboker yochal ad, beachasanteh yitbene mikdasha, davar hamekuddash ledamim lo yehe ella bechelko shel binyamin, veoto hakkeren lo haya bechelko, shehammizbeach haya tofes bechelko shel yehuda amma bemizracho veamma bidromo kol orech mizrach vedarom boovi amma, ella shello hayta amma shebbammizrach al pene kol hammizrach, shekkeshemmaggia lekeren mizrachit tzefonit hayta chulla betoch amma lakkeren, vechen achilat haamma hadderomit lo hayta mehallechet al pene chol haddarom, shekkeshemmaggia lekeren deromit maaravit hayta chulla samuch lakkeren amma. nimtza yesod lishlash hakkeranot. hilkach haya matchil bekeren tzefonit mizrachit. hoil vekeren deromit mizrachit en lah yesod lefi shello haya bechelko shel toref shennitnabbe alav yaakov. veola teuna techillat mattan damah keneged hayesod, hilkach bae hanach tarte daamaran. dishte mattanot shehen arba bainan, kede sheyyehe mattan haddam bearba ruchot hammizbeach, dichtiv (Vayikra 1) vezarku et haddam al hammizbeach saviv, i vezarku yachol yizrekennu bizrika achat, talmud lomar saviv, vei efshar lehakkif bizrika achat. i saviv yachol yakkifennu kechut, talmud lomar vezarku, veen zerika ella merachok, uchechut i efshar lehakkif ella beetzba. ha ketzad, noten shete mattanot shehen arba:
Uteuna hefshet venittuach. kedichtiv (sham) vehifshit et haola venittach otah lintacheha:
Vechalil laishshim. kullah nisrefet al gabbe haesh:
Shiva sammanim maavirin al hakketem. sheen haddam batel ad sheyyaavir kullan alav:
Rok tafel ume gerisin. mefaresh lekamman bematnitin:
Neter. 77 belaaz. umin karka hu umazhir. uvaaravi korin lo 312:
Borit. min tzemach hu shemmenakke umetaher:
Kemuneya. esev shemmeyabbeshim oto vetochanim oto umenakkin baafaro et hayyadayim lehaavir et hazzuhama. uvilshon gemara karuy shelof dotz:
Eshlag. lo itparash li:
Hitbilo. labbeged sheyyesh bo ketem kodem sheheevir alav hassammanim hallalu:
Hare ze tzeva. dei hava dam hava avar:
Sheddeha. nishtanna meadmimuto:

Bet shammay omrim kol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon. yesh mehen shetteunin arba mattanot. veyesh mehen shetteunin shetayim shehem arba. veyesh shetteunim mattana achat, keditnan beidach pirkin. vehasheta kaamar dechullan shello natan ella mattana achat bediavad kipper, dichtiv (Devarim 12) vedam zevachecha yishshafech, sheficha achat mashma, middelo chetiv saviv demashma shete mattanot shehen arba:

Uvechattat shete mattanot. shalosh parashiyyot neemru bachattaot hachitzonot bevayyikra, achat bisir nasi, ushetayim bechattat yachid, achat bechivsa veachat bisira. bishtayim ketiv al karnot chaser, vehaachat male. uvet shammay yesh lahen yesh em lemikra, hare kan shishsha, veen bammizbeach ella arba, vehashshetayim yeterot lo neemru ella sheshshenaan hakkatuv leakkev. uvet hillel savre ahane mikra demashma shesh, veahane massoret demashma arba, hilkach tefe chada ammassoret uvetzar chada mimmikra vehavu lehu chamesh, arba lemitzva vechad leakkev, veim natan mattana achat kipper:

Lefichach. chattat vechol hazzevachim levet hillel, ulevet shammay shear hazzevachim chutz mechattat, natan et harishona chetikkena veet hashsheniyya bemachashevet achilat basar chutz lizmannah, kipper, vechasher hakkarban likkarev al yede mattana rishona, deen hashsheniyya matteret habbasar, shehare huttar al yede mattana rishona, hilkach enah mefaggelet:
Natan et harishona chutz lizmannah kulei‏ piggul vechayyavin alav karet. sheen machashevet chutz limkomo dishniyya motziato mide figgul, shehare hukba barishona shekkarvu kol mattirav:
Measara malchuyot. shelosha pesukim mishshel tora, ushelosha mishshel ketuvim, ushelosha mishshel neviim, veechad mishshel tora shemmashlim bo:
Shalosh shalosh. echad shel tora, veechad shel ketuvim, veechad shel neviim. vahalacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:

Malchuyot vezichronot veshofarot shel puranut. kegon im lo beyad chazaka emloch alechem (Yechezkel 20), vayyizkor ki basar hemma (tehillim 78), tiku shofar baggiva (Hoshea 5), vechayyotze bahen. vezichron yachid, kegon zachra li elohay letova (Nechemya 5), af al pi shehu letova en mazkirin oto. vechen halacha:
Rabbi yose omer im hishlim battora yatza. baggemara meforash lemilleteh derabbi yose hachi, umashlim battora, veim hishlim bannavi yatza. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
En maavirin alav et hattechum. lelech chutz lattechum kede lehavi shofar, o lelech lishmoa hattekiot:
Bedavar shehu mishshum shevut. kegon lechatcho besakkin:

Bedavar shehu mishshum lo taase. kegon lechatcho bimgera, dehavya melacha gemura shel charishat etz. veikka dematni ippecha, davar shehu mishshum shevut, maggal sheen derech lachtoch bo. davar shehu mishshum lo taase, sakkina deorcheh hu:
Im ratza litten letocho yayin [yitten]. velo amrinan metakken mana hu:
En meakkevin et hattinokot. shehiggiu lechinnuch, vaafillu beshabbat, kede lechannechan bemitzvot, sheyyihyu melummadin litkoa beyom tov shel rosh hashshana:

Umitassekim bahem. velekka lemigzar dilma atu laatoye arba ammot birshut harabbim, deha eno tarud bammitzva ella mitassek bealma. velo gazru shemma yeviennu arba ammot birshut harabbim ella bazzeman shehu chayyav bitkiat shofar, shemmittoch shehu tarud latzet yede chovato yishkach et hashshabbat:
Ellu devarim sheen chayyavim alehem. karet baachilatan mishshum piggul:

Hakkometz. im kamatz al menat leechol shirayim lemachar, venitpaggela hammincha sheenah neechelet ella leyom velayla, en haochel et hakkometz becharet, sheen piggul chal ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin acherim. defiggul mishshelamim yalfinan leh dichtiv (Vayikra 7) veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav vegomer, ma shelamim meyuchadim sheyyesh lahem mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach, shehaddam mattir lehaketir haemurin lammizbeach, vehaemurin mattirin habbasar laadam, vechayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, af kol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, laafoke kol hanach dachashiv bematnitin, sheen lahem mattirin ella hen atzman mattirin laacherim, shehaochel mehen eno chayyav mishshum piggul:
Vehallevona. en acher mattirah. ella hi matteret et hammincha, kemo hakkometz:
Minchat nidvat kohanim. kullah kalil veenah nikmetzet. hilkach en acher mattirah:
Minchat kohen mashiach. dehaynu chavitte chohen gadol shehi kereva bechol yom machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baerev:
Uminchat nesachim. lo garsinan deha maflig pelige vah. veyesh chilluk ben baa im hazzevach levaa bifne atzmah:
Vehaddam. hu hammattir:

Vehannesachim habbaim bifne atzman. kegon shehitnaddev minchat nesachim belo zevach, kidamrinan bimnachot mitnaddev adam minchat nesachim bifne atzmah. i nammi heviah bishvil hazzevach, ella shehevi zivcho hayyom unesachav lemachar, deamar mar uminchatam veniskehem, afillu lemachar. aval im hevian im zivcho ufiggel bazzevach, nitpaggelu hannesachim:
Vachachamim omrim af habbaim im habbehema. dechevan deyachol lehakeriv nesachim lemachar, nimtza sheen hazzevach mattiran likkarev, ella hen mattirin et atzman. vahalacha kachachamim:
Log shemen shel metzora. sheyarav neechalin:

En chayyavin alav mishshum piggul. im piggel baasham lo nifgal hallog. veaf al pi shehallog taluy baasham, dichtiv (sham 14) al dam haasham, deim lo natan middam haasham techilla en netinat hashshemen kelum, afillu hachi kevan deadam mevi ashamo achshav veluggo ad asara yamim, nimtza sheen haasham mattiro. vechevan deen lo mattirim, en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul:
Verabbi meir omer. log habba im haasham bo vayyom, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul im piggel baasham. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Ben laadam ben lammizbeach. o laze o laze:
Hattoda veel nazir kadashim kallim. en moalin bahen:
Shechitatan bechol makom. en teunin shechita batztzafon:

Veneechalim bechol hair. degabbe chattat ketiv (sham 10) vaachaltem otah bemakom kadosh, veen shelamim bemakom kadosh ella vemakom tahor, dehaynu bechol hair shehu makom tahor millikkanes sham metzoraim:
Lechol adam. lezarim:
Leyom valayla. betoda chetiv (sham 7) beyom karbano yeachel lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker. vetanya, todat shelamav, lerabbot shalme nazir:

Hammuram mehem. chaze veshok shennatan mehen lakkohen kishar shelamim, detoda lishlamim itkush dichtiv (sham) vezot torat zevach hashshelamim vegomer‏ im al toda vegomer. vearba challot mearba minim shebbah kedichtiv (sham) echad mikkol karban lakkohen hazzorek vegomer, umuram meel nazir, zeroa beshela vechaze veshok vechallat matztza achat urekik echad:
Kayyotze vahen. neechalim bechol hair leyom valayla:
Lakkohanim linshehem. kedichtiv (sham 10) veet chaze hattenufa vegomer‏ tochlu bemakom tahor atta uvanecha uvenotecha:
Avot. magen avraham:
Ugevurot. atta gibbor:
Kedushshat hashshem. kadosh kadosh kadosh:
Kedushshat hayyom. atta vechartanu:

Zichronot vetokea shofarot vetokea. mikkerae yalfinan lehu, dichtiv (Vayikra 23) zichron terua, vedarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha zikkaron ellu zichronot, terua ellu shofarot, veamar kera (Bamidbar 10) vehayu lachem lezikkaron lifne elohechem ani Adonai‏ elohechem, ma talmud lomar ani Adonai‏ elohechem, limmed al kol makom sheyyesh sham zichronot veshofarot, yihyu malchuyot immahem:
Amar rabbi akiva vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Anshe mishmar muttarim lishtot yayin. lav gabbe taanit kae, ella ayde deayre bivne mishmar mayte la hacha:
Ballelot. sheen lachush shemma tichbad haavoda al anshe vet av ballayla veyitztarchu ellu lavo lesayyeam:
Lo vayyom velo vallayla. lefi shehayu tzerichin lehaalot kol hallayla evarim ufedarim sheppaku meal hammizbeach:

Anshe maamad. hem yisreelim hakkevuim birushalayim veomdim al karban achehem umitpallelin sheyyehe mekubbal beratzon. veomdim sham bishat haavoda sheluchim mikkol yisrael, deheach karbano shel adam karev vehu eno omed al gabbav, vehakkatuv omer (Bamidbar 28) tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado, leyisrael metzavve sheyyaamdu al hakkohanim bishat avoda:
Asurim lesapper ulechabbes. mishshennichnesu lemishmartam, kol otah shabbat, kede sheyyesapperu kodem lachen velo yikkansu lemishmartan keshehen menuvvalim:
Uvachamishi. shebbetoch mishmartan muttarim, shedderech [rov] bene adam lesapper bachamishi veen mamtinin lesapper beerev shabbat mippene hattorach:
Hannofeach. befiv:
Baadashim. veyatza alehen rok mippiv binfichato, veharok hayyotze min happe mittoldot hammayim hu chashuv:
Enan bechi yuttan. kevan delo nitkavven lechach:
Vachachamim omrim bechi yuttan. kevan denitkavven lenappeach, vederech harok latzet al yede neficha. vahalacha kachachamim:

Haochel shumshemin beetzbao. kegon shehinniach shumshemin beyado achat, veetzbao shebbeyado hashshenit machnisah letoch piv lelachlechah barok venotnah bashshumshemin shebbeyado hashshenit vehen nidbakin bah umachnis befiv veochel, umechamat ken nitlachlecha hayyad shehashshumshemin bah, veyesh bah mashke tofeach:

Rabbi shimon omer enan bechi yuttan. dillachleach etzbao nitkavven, velo lelachleach hayyad shehashshumshemin bah. verabbanan savre, kevan deachsheveh beetzbao, machshir afillu shello leratzon, keditnan beresh pirkin kol mashke shettechillato leratzon, af al pi sheen sofo leratzon, hare ze bechi yuttan. verabbi shimon savar, delo haya mittechillato leratzon ella hammashke hamelachleach haetzba bilvad. vehannishar shennitlachlecha vo hayyad, lo haya leolam leratzon. veen halacha kerabbi shimon bechulla matnitin:

Hasserikin. vayyitlakketu el yiftach anashim rekim (Shoftim 11) metargeminan guvrin serikin. leshon ilan serak sheeno ose ferot. perush acher, serikin, gannavim. shekken bilshon yishmael korin legannave serakin. veyesh gorsin sikarin, leshon lo haya sikrikon bihuda baharuge hammilchama, beferek hannizzakin, perush gazlanin veannasin:
Beshibbolet hannahar. shevil hannahar umerutzat memav. leshon veshibbolet shetafatni (tehillim 69):
Lahavian immo. shello haya yachol lenasan, umeshitan bannahar:
Hazzav vehazzava. shetztzerichin lispor shiva nekiyyim, ufasku meriyyatan vehitchilu lispor, uvadku yom rishon ushevii kulei:
En lahem ella yom rishon ushevii vilvad. utzerichin lispor od chamishsha, yamim nekiyyim, kede lehashelim leshiva:
Rabbi akiva omer en lahem ella shevii. shemma rau bentayim vesatru sefiratan harishona. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:

Umakkifim derech semol. makkifim et hammizbeach bishvil tzarche avoda. kegon lemattan deme chattaot ulesiddur maaracha o lehappech evarim betzinnora, veyordim bemaaravo shel kevesh shehi semol haolin lammizbeach baaliyyatan:

Chutz min haole lishlosha devarim ellu. hannaasim bekeren maaravit deromit, shehen nissuch hammayim vehayyayin veolat haof, shekkeshehu ole lammizbeach pone lassovev lismol beotah hakkeren, uchesheggamar chozer al akev derech aliyyato. benissuch hammayim vehayyayin, shemma yitashshenu baashan hammizbeach beod shehu fone derech yamin umakkif lismol veyafigu taaman verechan, vaanan bainan temimim yihyu lachem veniskehem, sheyihyu hannesachim temimim. veolat haof nammi shemma titashshen vetamut:
Haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha. mashtenet mayim:
Im omedet temea. deamrinan me raglayim hadur lammakor vaata dam min hammakor bahadayhu:

Yoshevet tehora. baggemara mokminan la beyoshevet al sefat hassefel umekallachat me raglayim letocho bechozek. ucheshehi mekallachat bechozek, en derech dam hammakor latzet im me raglayim. vei levatar detammu mayya ba dam ze min hammakor, lo haya haddam nimtza betoch hassefel ella al sefat hassefel, sheddam habba min hammakor, shotet veyored veeno mekalleach. vedam ze shennimtza betoch hassefel, al karchach mimmekom me raglayim ba umakka yesh bah sham, velo min hammakor. uveomedet al sefat hassefel umekallachat betoch hassefel, lo haya efshar lehaamidah, deomedet i efshar lah lekalleach, ulehachi itzterich tanna leminkat yoshevet:
Rabbi yose omer ben kach uven kach tehora. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Umodim sheochelet bammaaser. kedin tevul yom, detaval veala ochel bammaaser:
Vekotza lah challa. veenah kora lah shem, umannichatah bichli. veaf al pi shehi nogaat bechullin hattevulin lechalla, lav kachalla dame, veen sheni posel bahen:
Umakkefet. mekarevet hakkeli shehinnicha bo hachalla etzel haissa. lefi shemmitzva litrom min hammukkaf, min hakkarov laddavar shehu torem alav:
Veim nafal merukkah umiddam tohorah. dahavu lehu mashkin hayyotzin min hattevul yom, utehorin hen:

Tzericha tevila baacharona. lel shemonim tzericha tevila leechol batteruma im kohenet hi. veim yisreelit hi, tzericha tevila leviat mikdash, mippene shettevulat yom aroch hi vehissicha datah min hatteruma umin hammikdash:

Enah tzericha tevila baacharona. vesomechet al hattevila shel sof shevuayim. vedavka litruma uleviat mikdash. aval laachilat kadashim, modu bet hillel shehi tzericha tevila acheret lesof shemonim, dekayma lan haonen umechussar kippurim tzerichim tevila lakkodesh, hilkach, leachar shehevia kapparatah, tovelet lakkadashim:

Kol hakkatuv bimgillat taanit. yamim shennaasu vahem nissim leyisrael bevayit sheni vekavu yamim tovim. it yomaya delo lehitannaa vehon bilvad. veit yome dachamire tefe delo lemispad behon. veotan shehen chamurim vaasurim behesped.
Lefanav asur behesped dilma ate lemebad hachi beyom tov gufe.

Leacharav muttar dechevan deavar yom tov lo chayshinan. vaanan kayma lan devatla megillat taanit, vechol otan hayyamim hakketuvim sham delo lehitannaa udelo lemispad, kullan muttarin behesped vetaanit, chutz mechanukka ufurim sheasurin behesped vetaanit. veyamim shellifnehem veacharehem muttar:

Bishlosha vemarcheshvan shoalin et haggeshamim. omrim veten tal umatar bevirkat hashshanim. vehanne mille beeretz yisrael, aval baggola en shoalim ad shishshim yom litkufat tishre, uveyom shishshim atzmo matchilin lishol haggeshamim:
Haacharon shebbeyisrael linhar perat. otan shealu laregel hachozrim levattehen, velo yafsikum haggeshamim:
Rabbi eliezer omer moalim bah. deha ola hi umi hotziah mimmeilatah, vahalo sheat hetter lakkohanim lo haya lah:
Rabbi yehoshua omer en moalim bah. dechevan deshinna shemah umaaseha umekomah leshem chattat, naaset chattat:
Uma chattat haof sheen moalim bah. kesheshshachatah lishmah, shehare neechelet lakkohanim:
Shinna et shemah. nifsela velo vaa lichlal hetter:
Moalim bah. deha rabbi yehoshua gufeh lo paleg aleha:
Ledavar sheyyesh bo meila. leshem ola:
Sheshshachatan baddarom. leshem shelamim, yochichu:
Sheshshinna sheman umaasehen ledavar sheen bo meila. shekkadashim kallim en meila ella beemurehen:
Umoalim bahen. mippene shennifselu beshinnuy mekoman velo hotziatan zerikatan mide meila:
Issur vehetter. kadashim kallim yesh beemurehen mishshum meila veen bivsaran mishshum meila:
Bedavar shekkullo hetter. bechattat haof sheen bo tzad meila. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
